items.title: CytoBERT: A Foundation Model for Cytometry Data
items.updateType: 新预印本；历史 arXiv 缺口补检
items.summary: 标准化 15 个人类流式数据集的 marker，在超过五千万细胞上自监督预训练。 作者报告可微调作样本级分类，并声明开源开放权重，支持异质面板迁移。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
细胞计数测量单个细胞的复杂特征（例如免疫细胞的计数和蛋白质表达），并广泛应用于免疫学研究和临床环境。然而，由于实验方案和测量特征的选择，细胞计数数据高度异质且不标准化。虽然机器学习方法有可能更深入地了解细胞生物学，但这些挑战使得它们难以在研究中应用和转移。基础模型的最新进展可以缓解这些问题，但该领域仍然缺乏相应的方法。为了解决这个问题，我们提供了 CytoBERT，这是一种公开的、开源的、开放权重的基础模型，用于具有可变标记面板的单细胞细胞计数数据。 CytoBERT 在通过标记标准化管理的大规模细胞计数语料库（15 个具有异质标记组和超过 5000 万个细胞的人类数据集）上以自我监督的方式进行预训练，使其能够学习细胞内可转移的标记间关系。针对样本级分类微调 CytoBERT 表明，跨异构细胞计数数据集的迁移学习是可行的，为可扩展、通用的细胞计数分析提供了起点。代码可在 GitHub 上获取。

details.abstractOriginal: Cytometry measures the complex characteristics of single cells (e.g., counts and protein expression of immune cells) and is widely used across immunological research and clinical settings. However, cytometry data is highly heterogeneous and unstandardized due to experimental protocols and the choice of measured features. While machine learning methods hold the potential to gain deeper insights into cell biology, these challenges make them difficult to apply and transfer across studies. Recent advances in foundation models can alleviate these issues, but corresponding approaches are still scarce in this field. To address this, we provide CytoBERT, a publicly available, open-source, open-weight foundation model for single-cell cytometry data with variable marker panels. CytoBERT is pretrained in a self-supervised manner on a large-scale cytometry corpus (15 human datasets with heterogeneous marker panels and more than 50 million cells) curated through marker standardization, enabling it to learn transferable inter-marker relationships within cells. Fine-tuning CytoBERT for sample-level classification demonstrates that transfer learning across heterogeneous cytometry datasets is feasible, providing a starting point for scalable, generalizable cytometry analysis. Code is available at GitHub.

items.title: The lifelong transcriptomic landscape of human blood cells
items.summary: 整合五个发育阶段、207 个健康样本约一百万细胞，并投射九类血液恶性肿瘤的 116 个样本。 识别 96 个血细胞簇及年龄相关亚群，并以健康参考分析 MYC、MHC II 和亚型特异程序。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
单细胞技术改变了我们对正常和恶性造血的看法，但将终生稳态造血与血液生态系统中的血液疾病联系起来的框架仍然不完整。在这里，我们通过整合来自跨越五个发育阶段（胎儿、新生儿、儿童、成人、老年）的 207 个健康样本的约 100 万个细胞的转录组，构建了整个造血系统的高分辨率景观，并鉴定了 96 个血细胞簇，包括胎儿中 VNN2 标记的单核细胞亚群和表现出不同年龄依赖性动态的 TSHZ2 标记 T 细胞亚群。我们发现了儿童期造血干细胞/多能祖细胞 (HSC/MPP) 干性的逆转，以及出生后淋巴偏向从早期 B/T 谱系潜力降低到自然杀伤 (NK) 细胞毒性增强的转变，这是由细胞内转录因子活性和细胞间相互作用协调协调的。将 116 个泛恶性肿瘤样本（9 种血液系统恶性肿瘤）投影到我们精制的血细胞参考中，我们发现 MYC 和 MHC II 信号传导的上调是与不良预后相关的相对保守的特征，而造血相关模块则表现出具有不同临床意义的亚型特异性分布。重要的是，我们开发了一个预后框架，包含血液恶性肿瘤和亚型特异性特征共享的两个核心特征。我们进一步揭示了恶性肿瘤中炎症和细胞毒性程序之间的拮抗作用。我们共同建立了人类造血系统的全景图，并详细阐述了其终生行为，其中稳态参考使得能够描绘血液恶性肿瘤的病理标志。

details.abstractOriginal: Single-cell technologies have transformed our view of normal and malignant hematopoiesis, yet a framework linking lifelong homeostatic hematopoiesis to hematological diseases in blood ecosystem remains incomplete. Here, we constructed a high-resolution landscape of the entire hematopoietic system by integrating transcriptomes of ∼1 million cells from 207 healthy samples spanning five developmental stages (fetal, neonatal, childhood, adult, elderly), and identified 96 blood cell clusters, including a VNN2-marked monocyte subset in the fetus and TSHZ2-marked T cell subsets exhibiting distinct age-dependent dynamics. We uncovered a reversal in hematopoietic stem cell/multipotent progenitor (HSC/MPP) stemness around childhood and a postnatal lymphoid bias shift from reduced early B/T lineage potential to enhanced natural killer (NK) cytotoxicity, coordinately orchestrated by intracellular transcription factor activity and intercellular interactions. Projecting 116 pan-malignancy samples (9 hematological malignancies) to our refined blood cell reference, we identified the upregulation of MYC and MHC II signaling as relatively conserved features correlating with poor prognosis, while hematopoiesis-related modules exhibited subtype-specific distributions with divergent clinical implications. Importantly, we developed a prognostic framework incorporating two core signatures shared across hematological malignancies and subtype-specific features. We further revealed an antagonism between inflammatory and cytotoxic programs across malignancies. Together, we established a panoramic landscape of the human hematopoietic system and elaborated its lifelong behaviors, in which a steady-state reference enabled the delineation of pathological hallmarks across hematological malignancies.

items.title: High‐Content CRISPR Screening: Methods and Applications
items.summary: 梳理 pooled 扰动结合单细胞测序、高内涵成像和空间转录组的技术演变。 归纳多维表型读出的应用与规模、成本和体内实施瓶颈。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
成簇规则间隔短回文重复序列 (CRISPR)-Cas9 筛选已成为功能基因组学的核心技术，通过汇集扰动实现基因组规模的询问。早期的 CRISPR 筛选采用生存或简单的表型读数来识别重要基因和耐药机制。然而，随着生物学问题转向理解调控网络、细胞异质性和背景依赖性基因功能，对能够捕获超出细胞适应性的复杂细胞表型的筛选策略的需求不断增加。单细胞测序、高内涵成像和空间转录组学的最新进展通过实现遗传扰动后的多维表型表征，扩大了 CRISPR 筛选的分辨率。通过将汇集的扰动与不同的读数相结合，这些方法系统地将目标基因编辑映射到转录状态、细胞表型和微环境背景。同时，文库设计、交付和计算流程方面的创新进一步提高了高内涵筛选平台的稳健性和可解释性。这篇综述综合了 CRISPR 筛选方法的演变，强调了扰动策略、递送系统和多模式读数方面的进展。描述了跨越肿瘤学、免疫治疗、发育生物学、神经生物学和传染病的代表性应用，以展示精细的基因网络注释。此外，还严格评估了现有的技术瓶颈，例如可扩展性、成本限制和体内限制。最后提出了促进精准医疗发展的未来方向。

方法与数据：梳理 pooled 扰动结合单细胞测序、高内涵成像和空间转录组的技术演变。

结果及适用范围：归纳多维表型读出的应用与规模、成本和体内实施瓶颈。

details.abstractOriginal: Clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR)-Cas9 screening has become a central technology in functional genomics, enabling genome-scale interrogation via pooled perturbations. Early CRISPR screens employed survival or simple phenotypic readouts to identify essential genes and drug resistance mechanisms. However, as biological questions have shifted toward understanding regulatory networks, cellular heterogeneity, and context-dependent gene functions, there has been increasing demand for screening strategies capable of capturing complex cellular phenotypes beyond cell fitness. Recent advances in single-cell sequencing, high-content imaging, and spatial transcriptomics have expanded the resolution of CRISPR screening by enabling multidimensional phenotypic characterization following genetic perturbation. By integrating pooled perturbations with diverse readouts, these approaches systematically map targeted gene edits to transcriptional states, cellular phenotypes, and microenvironmental contexts. Meanwhile, innovations in library design, delivery, and computational pipelines have further improved the robustness and interpretability of high-content screening platforms. This review synthesizes the methodological evolution of CRISPR screening, emphasizing advances in perturbation strategies, delivery systems, and multimodal readouts. Representative applications spanning oncology, immunotherapy, developmental biology, neurobiology, and infectious diseases are delineated to demonstrate refined gene network annotations. Additionally, existing technical bottlenecks, such as scalability, cost constraints, and in vivo limitations, are critically assessed. Finally, future directions are proposed to facilitate the development of precise medicine.

items.title: Toward trustworthy virtual cells: a roadmap for perturbation-resolved, context-aware, and experimentally validated cell models
items.source: Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology
items.summary: 综述分子状态、干预、生物背景和正交表型四层证据，并结合结构化先验。 提出背景适配、分布外泛化、解释/机制保真、校准不确定性和实验闭环五项要求。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
单细胞扰动技术、多模式组学、空间分析和生成建模正在将虚拟细胞从理论概念转变为细胞生物学的实际目标。然而，当前的努力往往强调模型规模、数据量或预测广度，而科学和转化使用所需的可信度仍未得到充分解决。我们认为，只有当连接数据、模型设计、基准测试和实验验证的证据链变得明确时，虚拟细胞模型才变得与决策相关。我们引入了值得信赖的虚拟细胞，这是一种扰动解决、上下文感知和经过实验验证的系统，能够支持生物推理、实验设计和临床前决策。我们围绕四个经验层组织最新进展，即分子细胞状态、干预、生物背景和正交表型，并​​辅以结构化先验。该框架解释了为什么静态图谱、仅转录组读数和分布内基准不足以预测新条件下的细胞行为。在机械模型、深度生成模型、基础模型和混合模型中，我们讨论了可解释性、可扩展性和外推法之间的权衡。我们进一步认为，评估应该超越保留的重建准确性，转向具有生物学意义的标准，包括推广到未见的细胞类型和扰动、剂量、时间和组合反应外推、不确定性校准和机械一致性。然后我们提出一个闭环验证阶梯连接
计算机模拟
对 CRISPR 扰动、成像、类器官和组织水平分析的预测。我们的目标是审查当前模型可以做什么和不能做什么，并制定一个证据框架，指定虚拟细胞在对其输出采取行动之前必须展示什么，并指出哪些要求今天可以实现，哪些仍然是长期目标。

方法与数据：综述分子状态、干预、生物背景和正交表型四层证据，并结合结构化先验。

结果及适用范围：提出背景适配、分布外泛化、解释/机制保真、校准不确定性和实验闭环五项要求。

details.abstractOriginal:
Single-cell perturbation technologies, multimodal omics, spatial profiling, and generative modeling are transforming the virtual cell from a theoretical concept into a practical objective for cell biology. Yet current efforts often emphasize model scale, data volume, or predictive breadth, while the trustworthiness required for scientific and translational use remains insufficiently addressed. We argue that virtual-cell models become decision-relevant only when the evidential chain connecting data, model design, benchmarking, and experimental validation is made explicit. We introduce the trustworthy virtual cell, a perturbation-resolved, context-aware, and experimentally validated system capable of supporting biological inference, experimental design, and preclinical decision-making. We organize recent progress around four empirical layers, namely, molecular cell state, intervention, biological context, and orthogonal phenotype, complemented by structured priors. This framework explains why static atlases, transcriptome-only readouts, and in-distribution benchmarks are insufficient for predicting cellular behavior under new conditions. Across mechanistic, deep generative, foundation, and hybrid models, we discuss trade-offs among interpretability, scalability, and extrapolation. We further argue that evaluation should move beyond held-out reconstruction accuracy toward biologically meaningful criteria, including generalization to unseen cell types and perturbations, dose, time, and combination response extrapolation, uncertainty calibration, and mechanistic consistency. We then propose a closed-loop validation ladder connecting
                     in silico 
                    predictions to CRISPR perturbation, imaging, organoid, and tissue-level assays. Our aim is to review what current models can and cannot yet do, and to set out an evidential framework specifying what a virtual cell must demonstrate before its outputs are acted upon, noting which requirements are attainable today and which remain longer-term goals.

items.title: A single-nucleus multiomic and spatial atlas of gene regulation in human spermatogenesis
items.summary: 同核测量可及性与表达并整合睾丸空间转录组；关联不育遗传变异及隐匿精子症临床样本。 构建阶段特异调控网络，连接候选增强子、靶基因和局部信号。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
配子发生，即卵母细胞和精子的产生，确保遗传物质忠实地传递给下一代。在男性中，精子发生发生在睾丸内，其中生殖细胞通过与支持体细胞密切相关的高度有序的发育程序进行进展。这一过程的缺陷会导致不育，但协调正常和功能失调的人类精子发生的基因调控机制仍未完全确定。在这里，我们通过分析同一核中的染色质可及性和基因表达并将这些数据与完整睾丸组织的空间转录组学整合来生成人类精子发生的单核多组学和空间图谱。我们推断出高置信度的基因调控网络，该网络可以解析生殖系和体细胞区室中已知和新型候选调控因子的阶段特异性活性，并绘制生精小管生态位内空间受限的信号相互作用图。与不孕相关遗传变异的整合将非编码风险位点与细胞类型特异性调控环境中的候选增强子和靶基因联系起来。最后，将临床隐精症样本分析为体内扰动，支持该网络捕获疾病相关调节破坏的下游转录后果的能力。这些数据共同为人类精子发生提供了空间分辨的调控框架，并为解释男性不育的分子基础奠定了基础。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：配子发生，即卵母细胞和精子的产生，确保遗传物质忠实地传递给下一代。在男性中，精子发生发生在睾丸内，其中生殖细胞通过与支持体细胞密切相关的高度有序的发育程序进行进展。

方法与数据：同核测量可及性与表达并整合睾丸空间转录组；关联不育遗传变异及隐匿精子症临床样本。

结果及适用范围：构建阶段特异调控网络，连接候选增强子、靶基因和局部信号。
details.findings: 结果解读：构建阶段特异调控网络，连接候选增强子、靶基因和局部信号。

预印本；疾病样本并非随机干预；网络边与风险位点映射主要是推断，不视为逐一因果验证。

details.abstractOriginal: Gametogenesis, the production of oocytes and sperm, ensures the faithful transmission of genetic material to the next generation. In males, spermatogenesis occurs within the testis, where germ cells progress through a highly ordered developmental programme in close association with supporting somatic cells. Defects in this process cause infertility, yet the gene regulatory mechanisms coordinating normal and dysfunctional human spermatogenesis remain incompletely defined. Here we generate a single-nucleus multiomic and spatial atlas of human spermatogenesis by profiling chromatin accessibility and gene expression in the same nuclei and integrating these data with spatial transcriptomics of intact testicular tissue. We infer high-confidence gene regulatory networks that resolve stage-specific activity of known and novel candidate regulators across germline and somatic compartments, and map spatially restricted signalling interactions within the seminiferous tubule niche. Integration with infertility-associated genetic variation links non-coding risk loci to candidate enhancers and target genes in cell-type-specific regulatory contexts. Finally, profiling clinical cryptozoospermia samples as in vivo perturbations supports the ability of this network to capture downstream transcriptional consequences of disease-associated regulatory disruption. Together, these data provide a spatially resolved regulatory framework for human spermatogenesis and a foundation for interpreting the molecular basis of male infertility.

items.title: scFLAME: a unified generative model for interpretable clustering, hierarchical structure discovery and marker-gene identification in single-cell RNA-seq data
items.summary: 原始计数的负二项因子分析结合高斯混合潜先验，共享线性解码器及分区合并程序，可调整批次。 作者报告聚类匹配或超过所测方法，跨平台稳健，并近线性扩展到数十万细胞。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
从单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 数据中识别细胞类型通常需要几个单独且通常无法解释的步骤：降维、批次校正、聚类、标记基因识别和更细粒度结构的发现。在这里，我们介绍 scFLAME（带有混合嵌入的单细胞因子潜在分析），这是一种统一这些任务的概率生成模型：原始计数的负二项式因子分析（可以针对批次进行调整）与潜在空间上的高斯混合先验耦合，共同学习嵌入和聚类，而共享线性解码器直接从拟合模型提供特定于簇的标记基因，并且合并过程恢复更细粒度分区的概率层次结构。在模拟和真实数据上，scFLAME 达到或超过了最先进的聚类精度，在整个测序平台上都很强大，并且可以近乎线性地扩展到数十万个细胞。因此，scFLAME 用单个可解释的单细胞分析模型取代了一系列单独的工具。

方法与数据：原始计数的负二项因子分析结合高斯混合潜先验，共享线性解码器及分区合并程序，可调整批次。

details.abstractOriginal: Identifying cell types from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data typically requires several separate and often uninterpretable steps: dimensionality reduction, batch-correction, clustering, marker-gene identification and the discovery of finer-grained structure. Here we introduce scFLAME (single-cell Factor Latent Analysis with Mixture Embeddings), a probabilistic generative model that unifies these tasks: a negative binomial factor analysis of the raw counts - which can be adjusted for batch - is coupled to a Gaussian mixture prior over the latent space, learning the embedding and clustering jointly, while a shared linear decoder provides cluster-specific marker genes directly from the fitted model, and a merging procedure recovers a probabilistic hierarchy of finer-grained partitions. On simulated and real data, scFLAME matches or exceeds state-of-the-art clustering accuracy, is robust across sequencing platforms, and scales near-linearly to hundreds of thousands of cells. scFLAME thus replaces a chain of separate tools with a single, interpretable model for single-cell analysis.

items.title: Comparative analysis of whole genome amplification kits for single-cell genome analysis
items.updateType: 预印本修订 v2（首次收录）
items.summary: 比较 REPLI-g 的 MDA 与 ResolveDNA 的 PTA，结合低深度测序和 SNP 阵列。 作者报告 PTA 覆盖广度/均匀性与 CNV 检出更好，阵列 CNV 表现接近低深度测序。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
全基因组扩增 (WGA) 能够在细胞水平上详细分析基因组异质性。在这里，我们系统地比较了两种商用单细胞 WGA 技术； Qiagen REPLI-g 试剂盒 (MDA/REPLI-g) 中的多重置换扩增和 BioSkryb ResolveDNA 试剂盒 (PTA/ResolveDNA) 中的初级模板定向扩增。除了质量控制和基因组分析之外，我们还评估了一种经济高效的基于阵列的方法，作为低通测序的补充。与现有基准一致，PTA/ResolveDNA 测序文库在质量指标（包括基因组覆盖广度和均匀性）方面始终优于 MDA/REPLI-g。 PTA 细胞的 CNV 识别显示出更高的准确性和灵敏度，包括在低测序深度下可靠地检测小 CNV。基于 SNP 阵列的分析证实了基于测序的发现，并另外提供了等位基因信息。值得注意的是，SNP 阵列的 CNV 检测与低通测序的性能相匹配，支持其作为 WGA 质量控制和单细胞 CNV 分析的经济高效方法的实用性。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：全基因组扩增 (WGA) 能够在细胞水平上详细分析基因组异质性。在这里，我们系统地比较了两种商用单细胞 WGA 技术； Qiagen REPLI-g 试剂盒 (MDA/REPLI-g) 中的多重置换扩增和 BioSkryb ResolveDNA 试剂盒 (PTA/ResolveDNA) 中的初级模板定向扩增。

方法与数据：比较 REPLI-g 的 MDA 与 ResolveDNA 的 PTA，结合低深度测序和 SNP 阵列。

结果及适用范围：作者报告 PTA 覆盖广度/均匀性与 CNV 检出更好，阵列 CNV 表现接近低深度测序。
details.findings: 结果解读：作者报告 PTA 覆盖广度/均匀性与 CNV 检出更好，阵列 CNV 表现接近低深度测序。

details.abstractOriginal: Whole genome amplification (WGA) enables detailed analysis of genomic heterogeneity at the cellular level. Here, we systematically compare two commercially available WGA technologies on single cells; Multiple Displacement Amplification in the Qiagen REPLI-g kit (MDA/REPLI-g) and Primary Template-directed Amplification in the BioSkryb ResolveDNA kit (PTA/ResolveDNA). Consistent with available benchmarks, PTA/ResolveDNA sequencing libraries consistently outperformed MDA/REPLI-g across quality metrics, including genome coverage breadth and uniformity. CNV calls from PTA-cells showed higher accuracy and sensitivity, including reliable detection of small CNVs at low sequencing depth. SNP array-based analysis corroborated sequencing-based findings, and additionally provided allelic information. Notably, CNV detection from SNP arrays matched the performance of low-pass sequencing, supporting its utility as an cost-effective approach for WGA quality control and single-cell CNV profiling.

items.title: Hi-M imaging of chromatin architecture in adult Drosophila brain cryosections
items.summary: 结合 Oligopaint、连续 RNA/DNA-FISH、微流控成像及计算重建，保留组织结构与细胞身份。 给出从文库到配准、条码检测和轨迹重建的操作要点。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
Hi-M 结合了荧光原位杂交 (FISH)、自动微流体、连续成像和计算染色质追踪，以测量单细胞中选定基因组区域的三维组织。本章介绍了适用于成年果蝇大脑冷冻切片的 Hi-M 工作流程，可在保留组织结构和细胞身份的同时进行染色质追踪。该协议涵盖 Oligopaint 文库设计和扩增、固定、脑解剖、冷冻保护、冷冻切片、用于细胞类型识别的连续 RNA-FISH、连续 DNA-FISH 标记、自动采集和染色质迹线重建。我们还为实验设计、样品制备、组织处理、图像采集和数据分析提供实用指导，重点介绍影响组织完整性、杂交效率、图像配准、条形码检测和染色质迹线重建的关键步骤。该工作流程可轻松适应不同的基因组位点和细胞类型，为研究完整成人组织中的 3D 基因组组织提供了可靠的方法。

details.abstractOriginal: Hi-M combines fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH), automated microfluidics, sequential imaging, and computational chromatin tracing to measure the three-dimensional organization of selected genomic regions in single cells. This chapter describes a Hi-M workflow adapted for cryosections of adult Drosophila melanogaster brains, enabling chromatin tracing while preserving tissue architecture and cell identity. The protocol covers Oligopaint library design and amplification, fixation, brain dissection, cryoprotection, cryosectioning, sequential RNA-FISH for cell-type identification, sequential DNA-FISH labeling, automated acquisition, and chromatin trace reconstruction. We also provide practical guidance for experimental design, sample preparation, tissue handling, image acquisition, and data analysis, highlighting critical steps that influence tissue integrity, hybridization efficiency, image registration, barcode detection, and chromatin trace reconstruction. The workflow is readily adaptable to different genomic loci and cell types, providing a robust approach for studying 3D genome organization in intact adult tissues.

items.title: Large-scale spatial variable gene atlas for spatial transcriptomics
items.summary: 在STimage-1K4M的662张人类切片、超过18种组织上比较20种SVG检测方法。 作者报告性能随组织、分辨率及设计变化，并提供跨组织SVG参考与肿瘤空间程序比较。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
空间可变基因 (SVG) 揭示有关组织结构、细胞相互作用和疾病微环境的关键信息。随着空间转录组学 (ST) 技术的激增，跨不同平台、组织类型和疾病背景准确识别 SVG 已成为重大机遇和重大计算挑战。在这里，我们使用来自 STimage-1K4M 的人体切片对 20 种最先进的 SVG 检测方法进行了全面的基准测试研究，STimage-1K4M 是一个大规模的 ST 数据资源，包含来自超过 18 种组织类型的 662 张切片。我们根据一系列生物学和技术上有意义的标准评估每种方法，包括病理学家注释的特定领域标记的恢复、交叉幻灯片的再现性、高分辨率数据的可扩展性以及对技术变化的稳健性。我们的结果显示，根据组织类型、空间分辨率和研究设计，性能存在显着差异。除了基准测试之外，我们还构建了第一个 SVG 跨组织图谱，从而能够对癌症和正常组织的空间基因程序进行比较分析。我们观察了反映发育和功能关系的组织对之间的相似性，例如胸腺和淋巴结之间的高度重叠，并揭示了与癌症转移、免疫浸润和组织起源身份相关的空间基因程序。我们的工作共同定义了一个评估和解释空间基因表达的框架，并为 ST 社区建立了参考资源。

details.abstractOriginal: Spatial variable genes (SVGs) reveal critical information about tissue architecture, cellular interactions, and disease microenvironments. As spatial transcriptomics (ST) technologies proliferate, accurately identifying SVGs across diverse platforms, tissue types, and disease contexts has become both a major opportunity and a significant computational challenge. Here, we present a comprehensive benchmarking study of 20 state-of-the-art SVG detection methods using human slides from STimage-1K4M, a large-scale resource of ST data comprising 662 slides from more than 18 tissue types. We evaluate each method across a range of biologically and technically meaningful criteria, including recovery of pathologist-annotated domain-specific markers, cross-slide reproducibility, scalability to high-resolution data, and robustness to technical variation. Our results reveal marked differences in performance depending on tissue type, spatial resolution, and study design. Beyond benchmarking, we construct the first cross-tissue atlas of SVGs, enabling comparative analysis of spatial gene programs across cancer and normal tissues. We observe similarities between pairs of tissues that reflect developmental and functional relationships, such as high overlap between thymus and lymph node, and uncover spatial gene programs associated with metastasis, immune infiltration, and tissue-of-origin identity in cancer. Together, our work defines a framework for evaluating and interpreting spatial gene expression and establishes a reference resource for the ST community.

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
从稀疏时间快照推断连续系统演化是生成建模和单细胞组学中的一个关键挑战。虽然最优传输（OT）很流行，但现有框架在很大程度上仅限于一阶动力学，假设无记忆速度场。这限制了表达能力，因为一阶系统无法考虑细胞分化等过程中固有的调节动量和延时反应。在这里，我们介绍 TracingFlow，一个推广到二阶动力学的免仿真流匹配框架。通过使用神经网络对加速度场进行回归，TracingFlow 为动态最优加速度传输 (DOAT) 问题提供了精确、高效的解决方案。与产生过度平滑轨迹的一阶方法不同，我们的二阶公式通过学习潜在的力场来捕获高曲率转变和非线性演化。在复杂的合成和大规模 scRNA-seq 数据集上进行评估后，TracingFlow 在分布重建和轨迹忠实度方面实现了卓越的准确性。此外，通过整合谱系追踪先验，它恢复了数学上最优且生物学上合理的动态结构。

details.abstractOriginal: Inferring continuous system evolution from sparse temporal snapshots is a key challenge in generative modeling and single-cell omics. While Optimal Transport (OT) is popular, existing frameworks are largely restricted to first-order dynamics, assuming memoryless velocity fields. This limits expressiveness, as first-order systems fail to account for regulatory momentum and time-delayed responses inherent in processes like cell differentiation. Here, we introduce TracingFlow, a simulation-free Flow Matching framework generalizing to second-order dynamics. By using neural networks to regress the acceleration field, TracingFlow provides an exact, efficient solution to the Dynamical Optimal Acceleration Transport (DOAT) problem. Unlike first-order methods yielding over-smoothed trajectories, our second-order formulation captures high-curvature transitions and nonlinear evolutions by learning the underlying force fields. Evaluated on complex synthetic and large-scale scRNA-seq datasets, TracingFlow achieves superior accuracy in distributional reconstruction and trajectory faithfulness. Moreover, by integrating lineage tracing priors, it recovers dynamical structures that are both mathematically optimal and biologically plausible.

items.title: Joint Flow Matching Enables Continuous Dose-Conditioned Cell Morphing
items.updateType: 新预印本；历史 arXiv 缺口补检
items.summary: 双时间步同时建模细胞潜变量与药物浓度，测试两种化合物和留出剂量。 作者报告有竞争力的分剂量指标，并支持由形态估计浓度。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
生成模型在预测化合物处理下的细胞扰动效应方面显示出越来越大的前景。现有方法要么将扰动模型化为分布到分布映射，而无需明确的浓度处理，要么将浓度视为离散类别标签，从而排除连续剂量控制。我们引入了一种联合流量匹配方法，通过双时间步长公式同时模拟细胞潜伏期和药物浓度，通过流量匹配的可逆性实现剂量调节的单细胞变形。该联合配方在潜在空间中诱导单调的剂量反应几何形状，并另外支持根据细胞形态进行浓度估计。作为概念证明，我们进一步证明了对训练期间未见过的剂量的泛化。根据经验，与代表性基线相比，我们的方法在两种化合物上实现了有竞争力或改进的每浓度指标，同时实现了离散类方法在结构上不可用的功能。

研究问题与设计：生成模型在预测化合物处理下的细胞扰动效应方面显示出越来越大的前景。现有方法要么将扰动模型化为分布到分布映射，而无需明确的浓度处理，要么将浓度视为离散类别标签，从而排除连续剂量控制。

方法与数据：双时间步同时建模细胞潜变量与药物浓度，测试两种化合物和留出剂量。

结果及适用范围：作者报告有竞争力的分剂量指标，并支持由形态估计浓度。

details.abstractOriginal: Generative modeling has shown increasing promise for predicting cellular perturbation effects under chemical compound treatments. Existing approaches either model perturbation as a distribution-to-distribution mapping without explicit concentration handling, or treat concentration as a discrete class label, precluding continuous dose control. We introduce a joint flow matching approach that simultaneously models cell latents and drug concentration via a dual-timestep formulation, enabling dose-conditioned single-cell morphing through the invertibility of flow matching. The joint formulation induces a monotonic dose-response geometry in latent space and additionally supports concentration estimation from cell morphology. As proof of concept, we further demonstrate generalization to an unseen dose held out during training. Empirically, our method achieves competitive or improved per-concentration metrics on two compounds compared with representative baselines, while enabling capabilities structurally unavailable to discrete-class methods.

items.title: Program-space Diffusion for Morphology-to-Transcriptomics Prediction
items.updateType: 新预印本；历史 arXiv 缺口补检
items.summary: 训练数据 cNMF 提取协同转录程序，以病理图像为条件生成程序激活。 原始摘要确认低维程序空间的条件生成设计。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
空间转录组学 (ST) 能够在保留组织结构的同时进行全基因组基因表达谱分析，但其成本和有限的可扩展性仍然是主要瓶颈。这激发了直接从常规组织学预测空间表达的模型。尽管结果有希望，但大多数现有方法在基因水平上操作，没有利用已建立的转录组建模实践，并且依赖于异质基因选择策略，这使得方法之间的公平比较变得复杂。我们建议将形态学到转录组学的预测重新表述为转录程序空间中的条件生成，从而利用协调的转录变异而不是独立预测基因。使用一致非负矩阵分解（cNMF），我们提取一组低维转录程序，捕获训练数据中的协调表达变化，并训练条件扩散模型以从组织学生成程序激活。该公式利用了协调的转录变异，并大大降低了条件生成任务的维度。

details.abstractOriginal:
Spatial transcriptomics (ST) enables genome-wide gene expression profiling while preserving tissue architecture, but its cost and limited scalability remain major bottlenecks. This has motivated models that predict spatial expression directly from routine histology. Despite promising results, most existing approaches operate at the gene level without leveraging established transcriptomic modeling practices and rely on heterogeneous gene selection strategies, which complicates fair comparison across methods.
  We propose to reformulate morphology-to-transcriptomics prediction as conditional generation in transcriptional program space, thereby exploiting coordinated transcriptional variation instead of predicting genes independently. Using consensus non-negative matrix factorization (cNMF), we extract a low-dimensional set of transcriptional programs capturing coordinated expression variation in the training data, and train a conditional diffusion model to generate program activations from histology. This formulation exploits coordinated transcriptional variation and substantially lowers the dimensionality of the conditional generative task.

items.title: Human-Guided Causal Knowledge Injection for Virtual Cells
items.updateType: 新预印本；历史 arXiv 缺口补检
items.summary: 可视化基因相似性与概念因果图，结合反事实分析和路径视图支持专家修订。 作者以两个案例及专家反馈展示用途。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
虚拟细胞采用机器学习模型来模拟和预测细胞行为，作为研究健康和疾病的关键计算框架。将因果图注入虚拟细胞可以提高可解释性，但此类图通常在现实应用中不可用。最近，人们提出了许多从数据构建因果图的方法，这些方法根据基因的相似性对基因进行分组，以形成概念并提取它们的因果关系。然而，由于这个自动过程是无人监督的，因果图通常包含错误。在本文中，我们提出了一种人工引导的虚拟细胞因果知识注入方法。我们开发了一种由混合优化算法支持的基因相似性因果图可视化，以帮助探索概念之间的因果关系和基因之间的相似性。基于探索，我们进一步开发了由反事实可视化和因果路径可视化支持的反事实分析策略，以帮助验证和细化因果图。我们的方法的有效性通过两个现实世界的案例研究、提取具有科学意义的因果见解以及领域专家的积极反馈得到了证明。

研究问题与设计：虚拟细胞采用机器学习模型来模拟和预测细胞行为，作为研究健康和疾病的关键计算框架。将因果图注入虚拟细胞可以提高可解释性，但此类图通常在现实应用中不可用。

方法与数据：可视化基因相似性与概念因果图，结合反事实分析和路径视图支持专家修订。

details.abstractOriginal: Virtual cells employ machine learning models to simulate and predict cellular behaviors, serving as a critical computational framework for investigating health and disease. Injecting causal graphs into virtual cells can improve the interpretability, but such graphs are usually not available in real-world applications. Recently, many methods have been proposed to construct causal graphs from data, which group genes based on their similarities to form concepts and extract their causal relationships. However, since this automatic process is unsupervised, the causal graphs usually contain errors. In this paper, we propose a human-guided causal knowledge injection method for virtual cells. We developed a gene-similarity-aware causal graph visualization supported by a hybrid optimization algorithm to help explore both the causal relationships between concepts and the similarities between genes. Based on the exploration, we further developed a counterfactual analysis strategy supported by a counterfactual visualization and a causal path visualization to help validate and refine causal graphs. The effectiveness of our method is demonstrated through two real-world case studies, the extraction of scientifically meaningful causal insights, and positive feedback from domain experts.

items.title: A systematic comparison of single-cell perturbation response prediction models
items.summary: 在 25 个数据集比较 13 种代表方法与基线，以 24 项指标评估未见单基因扰动、组合扰动和跨细胞类型迁移。 作者报告微调基础模型压缩响应方差、低估组合协同；PerturbNet 在前两类任务的差异表达恢复较好，跨细胞类型没有稳定优胜者。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
预测单细胞转录对扰动的反应对于剖析基因调控和加速治疗设计至关重要，但该领域缺乏对模型行为的严格的、跨任务的评估。我们提出了涵盖不同扰动模式和物种的 25 个数据集的 13 种代表性方法和基线的大规模基准，其中包括两种主要的免疫细胞药物反应资源。我们使用涵盖表达水平准确性、相对变化、差异表达 (DE) 恢复和分布相似性的 24 个指标评估了三个核心任务——对未见的单基因扰动的泛化、组合相互作用的预测以及跨细胞类型的转移。在各个任务中，性能在很大程度上取决于扰动效应的大小和评估角度：对于类似于对照的小效应扰动，表达水平一致性最高，而基于 delta 和 DE 的指标随着更大的效应而改进，提供更清晰的信号。模型都存在保守偏差，微调的基础模型会压缩方差并低估组合中的协同效应。 PerturbNet 在任务 1 和 2 中显示出 DE 特征的出色恢复，而在任务 3 中，没有方法一致地跨细胞类型推广，其中生物一致性主导结果。该基准建立了当前的方法学限制，阐明了不同的指标探测不同的生物信号，而不是同一预测问题的冗余摘要，并为开发更忠实地捕获异质扰动响应的虚拟细胞模型提供了基础。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：预测单细胞转录对扰动的反应对于剖析基因调控和加速治疗设计至关重要，但该领域缺乏对模型行为的严格的、跨任务的评估。我们提出了涵盖不同扰动模式和物种的 25 个数据集的 13 种代表性方法和基线的大规模基准，其中包括两种主要的免疫细胞药物反应资源。

方法与数据：在 25 个数据集比较 13 种代表方法与基线，以 24 项指标评估未见单基因扰动、组合扰动和跨细胞类型迁移。

结果及适用范围：作者报告微调基础模型压缩响应方差、低估组合协同；PerturbNet 在前两类任务的差异表达恢复较好，跨细胞类型没有稳定优胜者。
details.findings: 结果解读：作者报告微调基础模型压缩响应方差、低估组合协同；PerturbNet 在前两类任务的差异表达恢复较好，跨细胞类型没有稳定优胜者。

结论受任务、效应强度及指标影响；正式摘要写 13 种方法与基线，项目页旧口径为 12 模型加 3 基线，不混用版本计数。
简报证据边界：本次补充依据原始摘要；原文未报告的输入输出细节、完整基线、切分和训练设置均未补造。摘要译文采用机器辅助翻译并作术语、数值和身份检查；未逐篇全文精读。原有局限为简报分析，不能一概视为作者自述。
details.abstractOriginal: Predicting single-cell transcriptional responses to perturbations is central to dissecting gene regulation and accelerating therapeutic design, yet the field lacks a rigorous, task-spanning assessment of model behavior. We present a large-scale benchmark of 13 representative methods and baselines across 25 datasets spanning diverse perturbation modalities and species, including two primary immune-cell drug-response resources. We evaluated three core tasks-generalization to unseen single-gene perturbations, prediction of combinatorial interactions, and transfer across cell types-using 24 metrics covering expression-level accuracy, relative changes, differential expression (DE) recovery, and distributional similarity. Across tasks, performance depended strongly on perturbation effect size and evaluation perspective: Expression-level agreement was the highest for small-effect perturbations resembling controls, whereas delta- and DE-based metrics improved with larger effects, providing clearer signals. Models shared a conservative bias, with fine-tuned foundation models compressing variance and underestimating synergistic effects in combinations. PerturbNet showed superior recovery of DE signatures in Tasks 1 and 2, while no method consistently generalized across cell types in Task 3, where biological consistency dominated outcomes. This benchmark establishes current methodological limits, clarifies that different metrics probe distinct biological signals rather than redundant summaries of the same prediction problem, and provides a foundation for developing virtual-cell models that more faithfully capture heterogeneous perturbation responses.

items.title: UniCure: A multi-modal model for predicting personalized cancer therapy response
items.summary: 训练数据为 190 万扰动转录谱，覆盖超过 2.2 万化合物、166 种细胞类型和 24 种组织；另在 345 个患者来源肿瘤样细胞簇转录谱上微调。 作者报告剂量与组合响应预测、bulk/单细胞迁移，以及 396 个真实世界临床谱上的验证；还包括细胞系和患者来源模型实验。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
预测不同患者背景下的药物疗效仍然是肿瘤学的一个重大挑战，因为在癌细胞系上训练的模型通常无法捕获患者特异性的生物学特性。新兴的生物基础模型和患者衍生技术提供了一个有前途的解决方案。在这里，我们提出了 UniCure，这是一种多模式模型，它结合了生物和化学基础模型，可以预测不同细胞和组织背景下药物诱导的转录组反应，从而实现个性化药物排名。 UniCure 经过 190 万个转录组扰动图谱（涵盖超过 22,000 种化合物、166 种细胞类型和 24 种组织）的训练，可以准确预测剂量依赖性和组合反应，并概括大量数据和单细胞数据。我们进一步对 345 个患者来源的肿瘤样簇 (PTC) 转录组图谱进行微调 UniCure，并验证了 396 个真实临床图谱的性能，证明了有效的患者水平预测。该模型支持基于反应的患者分层，并在细胞系和患者衍生模型中经过实验验证。总体而言，UniCure 提供了一个实用框架，可将临床前数据转化为个性化治疗策略。

研究问题与设计：预测不同患者背景下的药物疗效仍然是肿瘤学的一个重大挑战，因为在癌细胞系上训练的模型通常无法捕获患者特异性的生物学特性。新兴的生物基础模型和患者衍生技术提供了一个有前途的解决方案。

details.abstractOriginal: Predicting drug efficacy across diverse patient contexts remains a major challenge in oncology, as models trained on cancer cell lines often fail to capture patient-specific biology. Emerging biological foundation models and patient-derived technologies offer a promising solution. Here, we present UniCure, a multi-modal model that combines biological and chemical foundation models to predict drug-induced transcriptomic responses across diverse cell and tissue contexts, enabling individualized drug ranking. Trained on 1.9 million transcriptomic perturbation profiles spanning >22,000 compounds, 166 cell types, and 24 tissues, UniCure accurately predicts dose-dependent and combination responses and generalizes across bulk and single-cell data. We further fine-tune UniCure on 345 patient-derived tumor-like cluster (PTC) transcriptomic profiles and validate performance on 396 real-world clinical profiles, demonstrating effective patient-level prediction. The model supports response-based patient stratification and is experimentally validated in cell line and patient-derived models. Overall, UniCure provides a practical framework for translating preclinical data into personalized therapeutic strategies.

items.title: Independent benchmark of H&E-based gene expression prediction in skin
items.summary: 三个皮肤疾病背景、两套 Xenium panel；比较三类已发表方法及多种基础模型表示上的线性对照，共 16 个模型。 作者报告多数基因预测准确性接近零，可靠信号主要限于角质形成细胞；岭回归匹配或超过复杂架构，预测难以保留其他细胞类型和空间组织。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
鉴于 H&E 玻片的广泛可用性，人们对确定是否可以直接从组织形态推断分子信息非常感兴趣，这可能会减少对昂贵的空间转录组分析的需求。我们评估了三种最先进的方法，用于根据三种皮肤病背景和两个 Xenium 面板的 H&E 图像预测单细胞基因表达。作为对照，我们纳入了在多个基础模型的嵌入上进行训练的简单线性回归模型，本研究中总共评估了 16 个模型。我们发现所有模型都表现不佳：对于大多数基因来说，预测精度接近于零，可靠的预测很大程度上局限于角质形成细胞相关基因。预测的表达未能保留细胞类型身份和空间组织，只有角质形成细胞形成连贯的簇，而免疫细胞、成纤维细胞和其他真皮群体广泛混合。值得注意的是，预训练嵌入的简单岭回归匹配或优于更复杂的已发布架构，这表明预测信号主要源自图像表示而不是模型设计。我们的结果表明，当前基于 H&E 的基因表达预测方法尚不适合皮肤组织空间转录组学的单细胞水平解释。

研究问题与设计：鉴于 H&E 玻片的广泛可用性，人们对确定是否可以直接从组织形态推断分子信息非常感兴趣，这可能会减少对昂贵的空间转录组分析的需求。我们评估了三种最先进的方法，用于根据三种皮肤病背景和两个 Xenium 面板的 H&E 图像预测单细胞基因表达。

方法与数据：三个皮肤疾病背景、两套 Xenium panel；比较三类已发表方法及多种基础模型表示上的线性对照，共 16 个模型。

结果及适用范围：作者报告多数基因预测准确性接近零，可靠信号主要限于角质形成细胞；岭回归匹配或超过复杂架构，预测难以保留其他细胞类型和空间组织。

details.abstractOriginal: Given the widespread availability of H&E slides, there is considerable interest in determining whether molecular information can be inferred directly from tissue morphology, potentially reducing the need for costly spatial transcriptomic profiling. We assessed three state-of-the-art methods for predicting single-cell gene expression from H&E images across three skin disease contexts and two Xenium panels. As controls, we included simple linear regression models trained on embeddings from multiple foundation models, totalling 16 models evaluated in this study. We show that all models performed poorly: for most genes, prediction accuracy was near zero, and reliable predictions were largely restricted to keratinocyte-associated genes. Predicted expression failed to preserve cell-type identity and spatial organisation, with only keratinocytes forming coherent clusters, while immune, fibroblast, and other dermal populations were extensively mixed. Notably, simple ridge regression on pretrained embeddings matched or outperformed the more complex published architectures, indicating that the predictive signal originates primarily from image representations rather than model design. Our results demonstrate that current H&E-based gene expression prediction methods are not yet suitable for single-cell-level interpretation of spatial transcriptomics in skin tissue.

items.title: Learning stochastic dynamics and cell-fate landscapes from single-cell snapshots via optimal transport
items.summary: 将随机微分方程转化为常微分方程，以最优传输和神经网络估计高维景观与随机力；在模拟及四个真实数据集（含 Stereo-seq）评测。 框架支持轨迹、速度、群体增长、调控网络与景观推断，并提供谱系分析及计算敲除/过表达模块。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
基因表达的时间动态和随机性对于细胞命运决策至关重要，但跨多个时间点整合快照组学数据仍然是一个重大挑战。在这里，我们介绍 DiffusionOT，这是一种动态机器学习框架，它通过结合随机效应从多时间点单细胞转录组学推断细胞轨迹。 DiffusionOT 将随机微分方程转换为常微分方程，使用最优传输和神经网络来求解高维景观模型。通过对数据中随机力的无监督学习，DiffusionOT 可以对细胞状态转换的潜在随机动力学进行稳健推断。该框架包括用于谱系追踪的随机轨迹分析模块和用于计算机敲除和过度表达实验的基因扰动模块。模拟数据集和四个真实数据集（包括空间 Stereo-seq 数据集）的基准证明了 DiffusionOT 在推断状态转换速度、细胞轨迹、群体增长、基因调控网络和细胞命运景观方面的准确性和效率。

方法与数据：将随机微分方程转化为常微分方程，以最优传输和神经网络估计高维景观与随机力；在模拟及四个真实数据集（含 Stereo-seq）评测。

details.abstractOriginal: The temporal dynamics and stochasticity of gene expression are critical to cell fate decisions, yet integrating snapshot omics data across multiple time points remains a major challenge. Here, we introduce DiffusionOT, a dynamic machine learning framework that infers cellular trajectories from multi-time point single-cell transcriptomics by incorporating stochastic effects. DiffusionOT transforms stochastic differential equations into ordinary differential equations, using optimal transport and neural networks to solve a high-dimensional landscape model. Through an unsupervised learning of the stochastic force in the data, DiffusionOT allows robust inference of the underlying stochastic dynamics of cell-state transitions. The framework includes a stochastic trajectory analysis module for lineage tracing and a gene perturbation module for in silico knockout and overexpression experiments. Benchmarks on simulated and four real-world datasets, including a spatial Stereo-seq dataset, demonstrate DiffusionOT's accuracy and efficiency in inferring state-transition velocities, cellular trajectories, population growth, gene regulatory networks, and cell-fate landscape.

items.title: SPRINT enables spatial proteomic profile reconstruction through multimodal fusion of histology and transcriptomics
items.summary: 分辨率自适应图像编码器和 token 自注意力融合 H&E 与空间转录组；测试人扁桃体、小鼠脾脏及人脑，含跨切片、供者和空间分离区域。 作者报告多模态融合补偿单模态弱相关蛋白的重建，支持部分跨物种预测与组织域恢复；直接用代谢测量训练时也重建独立切片代谢分布。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
摘要 空间分辨的蛋白质表达对于表征组织组织和免疫微环境至关重要，但现有的计算推理方法主要依赖于组织学图像或单独的基因表达，限制了它们恢复与单一模态弱相关的蛋白质的能力。在这里，我们提出了 SPRINT，这是一个多模式框架，它通过联合利用空间基因表达和随附的 H&E 染色组织学图像来重建空间蛋白质组图谱。 SPRINT 将分辨率自适应图像编码器与标记级自注意力相结合，以融合形态和转录信息。在人类扁桃体、小鼠脾脏和人类脑组织中，SPRINT 重建了跨切片、供体和空间不相交区域的蛋白质特异性空间模式。它与不同图像分辨率、转录组基因和测定配置的兼容性拓宽了其在空间转录组数据集上的适用性。消融分析表明，多模式融合补偿了与组织形态或转录本丰度关联较弱的蛋白质，从而扩大了可以可靠推断的免疫微环境蛋白质的范围。 SPRINT进一步支持跨物种蛋白质重建，重建的图谱改善了空间组织域的恢复。该框架还可以扩展到蛋白质组学之外，当直接进行代谢组学测量训练时，可以重建独立组织切片中的空间代谢物分布。总之，这些结果将 SPRINT 确立为一个通用框架，用于完成跨组织切片、数据集、图像分辨率和物种的空间分子概况，同时实现组织组织的下游表征。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：摘要 空间分辨的蛋白质表达对于表征组织组织和免疫微环境至关重要，但现有的计算推理方法主要依赖于组织学图像或单独的基因表达，限制了它们恢复与单一模态弱相关的蛋白质的能力。在这里，我们提出了 SPRINT，这是一个多模式框架，它通过联合利用空间基因表达和随附的 H&E 染色组织学图像来重建空间蛋白质组图谱。

方法与数据：分辨率自适应图像编码器和 token 自注意力融合 H&E 与空间转录组；测试人扁桃体、小鼠脾脏及人脑，含跨切片、供者和空间分离区域。

结果及适用范围：作者报告多模态融合补偿单模态弱相关蛋白的重建，支持部分跨物种预测与组织域恢复；直接用代谢测量训练时也重建独立切片代谢分布。
details.findings: 结果解读：作者报告多模态融合补偿单模态弱相关蛋白的重建，支持部分跨物种预测与组织域恢复；直接用代谢测量训练时也重建独立切片代谢分布。
details.limitations:
预印本；预测不是实测蛋白；代谢物实验有专门训练，不是无训练跨模态泛化；需核查配对、切分和平台偏差。
简报证据边界：本次补充依据原始摘要；原文未报告的输入输出细节、完整基线、切分和训练设置均未补造。摘要译文采用机器辅助翻译并作术语、数值和身份检查；未逐篇全文精读。原有局限为简报分析，不能一概视为作者自述。
details.abstractOriginal: Abstract    Spatially resolved protein expression is essential for characterizing tissue organization and immune microenvironments, yet existing computational inference methods predominantly rely on either histological images or gene expression alone, limiting their ability to recover proteins that are weakly associated with a single modality. Here we present SPRINT, a multimodal framework that reconstructs spatial proteomic profiles by jointly leveraging spatial gene expression and accompanying H&E-stained histological images. SPRINT combines resolution-adaptive image encoders with token-level self-attention to fuse morphological and transcriptional information. Across human tonsil, mouse spleen and human brain tissues, SPRINT reconstructed protein-specific spatial patterns across sections, donors and spatially disjoint regions. Its compatibility with different image resolutions, transcriptomic gene and assay configurations broadens its applicability across spatial transcriptomics datasets. Ablation analyses showed that multimodal fusion compensated for proteins with weak associations to either tissue morphology or transcript abundance, thereby expanding the range of immune-microenvironment proteins that could be reliably inferred. SPRINT further supported cross-species protein reconstruction, and the reconstructed profiles improved the recovery of spatial tissue domains. The framework was also extendable beyond proteomics, reconstructing spatial metabolite distributions in an independent tissue section when trained directly on metabolomic measurements. Together, these results establish SPRINT as a general framework for completing spatial molecular profiles across tissue sections, datasets, image-resolution and species, while enabling downstream characterization of tissue organization.

items.title: Two largely independent axes of drug transcriptional response in Tahoe-100M
items.updateType: 预印本修订 v2（首次收录）
items.summary: 使用覆盖 50 个癌细胞系、379 种小分子和三个浓度的资源，对药物 pseudobulk 响应做保守核心/背景特异外围与剂量出现分解。 作者报告两轴在 268 个药物上的 Spearman 相关为 −0.03；靶点相对转录机器的位置与剂量出现有中等关联，但与背景稳健性的早期关联未通过更正。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
摘要 有些药物在每个细胞系中产生几乎相同的转录指纹。其他人只在生物环境允许的情况下才会采取行动，因此他们的反应会从一种背景转移到另一种背景。大规模药物扰动图谱主要用于训练和基准预测模型，而不是审核反应结构本身；我们采取描述性立场。使用 Tahoe-100M（最大的单细胞药物扰动图谱，涵盖 50 个癌细胞系、379 个小分子和 3 个浓度），我们显示药物的伪整体反应解析到两个几乎独立的轴上（Spearman ρ = -0.03，n = 268）。背景稳健性是药物反应中独立于背景的保守“核心”而不是细胞系特异性“外围”的部分；其排名符合药理学预期，并且在全库排列检查下经过良好校准（91% 的药物具有零经验假核心基因；相对于报告的排名，ρ = 0.99）。剂量出现根据每种药物的基因开启浓度对其进行排序，在基因水平上恢复已知的机制，并将“压力”分解为具有相反剂量行为的两个程序。靶点转录深度——药物靶点与转录机制的距离——对上下文稳健性没有显着的直接影响（通过核心通路一致性的初始读数无法通过校正），但对剂量出现有真正的、中等的影响：近端靶点药物比远端靶点药物显示出更少的低剂量出现基因（p = 0.0013，ΔR² = 6.3%， n = 157）。 III 型方差划分显示，应激反应主要由药物特性和标称剂量下的细胞系背景决定（部分 η² ≈ 0.53–0.66 vs 0.02），并具有显着的药物×剂量相互作用。反应强度还跟踪已知的临床耐药机制：KRAS 突变株系对 EGFR 抑制剂西莫替尼的反应更弱 (FDR = 0.001)。贡献是响应结构的可解释坐标系，代码和派生表公开可用（CC0 源数据）。

方法与数据：使用覆盖 50 个癌细胞系、379 种小分子和三个浓度的资源，对药物 pseudobulk 响应做保守核心/背景特异外围与剂量出现分解。

结果及适用范围：作者报告两轴在 268 个药物上的 Spearman 相关为 −0.03；靶点相对转录机器的位置与剂量出现有中等关联，但与背景稳健性的早期关联未通过更正。

details.abstractOriginal: Abstract      Some drugs produce nearly the same transcriptional fingerprint in every cell line; others act only where biological context permits, so their response shifts from one background to the next. Large-scale drug-perturbation atlases are used mainly to train and benchmark predictive models, not to audit response structure itself; we take the descriptive stance instead. Using Tahoe-100M — the largest single-cell drug-perturbation atlas, spanning 50 cancer cell lines, 379 small molecules and 3 concentrations — we show a drug’s pseudobulk response resolves onto two nearly independent axes (Spearman ρ = −0.03, n = 268).   Context-robustness   is the fraction of a drug’s response that is a background-independent conserved “core” rather than a cell-line-specific “periphery”; its ranking matches pharmacological expectation and is well-calibrated under a full-library permutation check (91% of drugs with zero empirical false-core genes; ρ = 0.99 against the reported ranking).   Dose-emergence   orders each drug’s genes by the concentration at which they turn on, recovers known mechanism at the gene level, and resolves “stress” into two programs with opposite dose behaviour.   Target transcriptional depth   — how close a drug’s target sits to the transcription machinery — has no significant direct effect on context-robustness (an initial reading via core pathway coherence did not survive correction), but a real, moderate effect on dose-emergence: proximal-target drugs show fewer low-dose-emergent genes than distal-target drugs (p = 0.0013, ΔR² = 6.3%, n = 157). A Type III variance partition shows the stress response is dominated by drug identity and cell-line background over nominal dose (partial η² ≈ 0.53–0.66 vs 0.02), with a substantial drug×dose interaction. Response strength also tracks a known clinical resistance mechanism: KRAS-mutant lines respond more weakly to the EGFR inhibitor Simotinib (FDR = 0.001). The contribution is an interpretable coordinate system for response structure, with code and derived tables openly available (CC0 source data).

方法与数据：使用覆盖 50 个癌细胞系、379 种小分子和三个浓度的资源，对药物 pseudobulk 响应做保守核心/背景特异外围与剂量出现分解。

结果及适用范围：作者报告两轴在 268 个药物上的 Spearman 相关为 −0.03；靶点相对转录机器的位置与剂量出现有中等关联，但与背景稳健性的早期关联未通过更正。

items.title: scCGC 2 T: Curriculum-Guided Contrastive Co-Training Framework for scRNA-Seq Data Clustering
items.source: IEEE Transactions on Computational Biology and Bioinformatics
items.summary: 双分支跨视图对比协同训练，先纳入高置信样本，再用动态阈值逐步纳入低置信样本，以缓解早期伪标签错误累积。 作者报告多个基准上的聚类提升并公开 scCGCT 源码；官方 release 列表为空，未将代码可用性计为新版本发布。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 可实现细胞异质性的高分辨率分析。准确的 scRNA-seq 数据聚类对于细胞类型识别和亚群发现至关重要。然而，现有的聚类方法经常受到通过静态阈值生成的错误伪标签的影响，从而在训练过程中逐渐积累错误。为了应对这些挑战，在本文中，我们提出了一种用于 scRNA-seq 数据聚类的新型课程引导对比协同训练 (scCGC$^{2}$T) 框架。它设计了用于交叉视图对比协同训练的双分支架构，从而增强了其对 scRNA-seq 数据的表示能力。此外，还引入了渐进式课程学习策略来动态过滤伪标签。具体来说，将使用静态阈值的高置信度样本应用于初始训练，然后基于动态阈值进行指导。低置信度样本逐渐纳入训练过程，从而减轻噪声干扰问题。因此，所提出的scCGC$^{2}$T方法有效地减轻了早期训练阶段的误差积累，并大大增强了对复杂细胞亚群的判别能力。对多个基准的大量实验表明，所提出的方法在 scRNA-seq 数据聚类任务上实现了优异的聚类性能和强大的泛化能力。

details.abstractOriginal: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables high-resolution analysis of cellular heterogeneity. Accurate scRNA-seq data clustering is crucial for cell type identification and subpopulation discovery. However, existing clustering methods are frequently affected by erroneous pseudo-labels generated through the static threshold, thus progressively accumulating errors during training. To address these challenges, in this paper, we propose a novel curriculum-guided contrastive co-training (scCGC$^{2}$T) framework for scRNA-seq data clustering. It designs a dual-branch architecture for cross-view contrastive co-training, thereby strengthening its representation ability for scRNA-seq data. Additionally, a progressive curriculum learning strategy is introduced to filter pseudo-labels dynamically. Specifically, high-confidence samples using the static threshold are applied to initial training, followed by guidance based on dynamic thresholding. Low-confidence samples are gradually incorporated into the training process, thereby mitigating the noise interference problem. Therefore, the proposed scCGC$^{2}$T method effectively mitigates error accumulation in the early training stage and greatly enhances the discriminative capability for complex cell subpopulations. Extensive experiments on several benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior clustering performance and strong generalization on scRNA-seq data clustering tasks.

items.title: AI virtual cells for drug discovery and pharmacology
items.summary: 梳理扰动图谱、单细胞与成像技术和干预条件化模型，讨论机制、疗效、安全性、耐药及联合用药。 作者将肿瘤学视为可能的早期验证场景，并提出扰动特异、机制和决策层面的验证要求。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
药物发现依赖于细胞测定来确定候选药物是否产生所需的反应、揭示其机制或引起毒性，但只有一小部分化合物-剂量-时间-背景组合可以通过实验测量。最近的扰动图谱、单细胞和成像技术以及干预条件人工智能模型现在使预测未测量的细胞反应成为可测试的目标。因此，人工智能虚拟细胞可以通过优先考虑化合物、背景和后续实验来补充传统发现，而不是取代实验室分析。在这里，我们回顾支持这种能力的资源和建模进展，评估它们对作用机制分析、功效、安全性、耐药性和联合研究的价值，并定义药理学用途的证据要求。数据覆盖范围使肿瘤学（包括免疫肿瘤学）成为可能的早期试验场，并将安全性评估作为交叉用例；更广泛的部署需要特定于扰动的、机械的和决策级的验证。

details.abstractOriginal: Drug discovery relies on cellular assays to determine whether a candidate produces a desired response, reveals its mechanism, or causes toxicity, but only a small fraction of compound-dose-time-context combinations can be measured experimentally. Recent perturbation atlases, single-cell and imaging technologies, and intervention-conditioned AI models now make prediction of unmeasured cellular responses a testable objective. AI virtual cells could therefore complement conventional discovery by prioritizing compounds, contexts, and follow-up experiments rather than replacing laboratory assays. Here, we review the resources and modeling advances supporting this capability, assess their value for mechanism-of-action analysis, efficacy, safety, resistance, and combination studies, and define evidence requirements for pharmacological use. Data coverage makes oncology, including immuno-oncology, plausible early proving grounds, with safety assessment as a crosscutting use case; broader deployment requires perturbation-specific, mechanistic, and decision-level validation.

items.title: PhenoMapR: scalable mapping of sample phenotypes to single-cell, spatial, and bulk transcriptomics data
items.summary: 半监督框架提取 bulk 表达签名，映射至单细胞和空间数据；支持二分类、连续及生存表型。 原始摘要确认跨模态表型映射与可扩展设计，旨在定位候选细胞群和空间微环境。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
单细胞和空间转录组研究通常缺乏足够的样本量来计算样本水平表型与细胞类型或空间位置之间的稳健统计关联。相比之下，低分辨率方法（例如批量基因表达谱分析）已在大型注释数据集中大规模应用，为表型关联提供可靠的签名。我们推出 PhenoMapR，这是一种半监督方法，旨在将大规模批量表达研究的表型严谨性与单细胞和空间转录组学的细胞和空间粒度相结合。 PhenoMapR 通过以计算高效且可扩展的方式导出大量基因表达特征并将其映射到细胞和空间位置来实现这一目标。该框架广泛适用于整个生物环境，支持从跨转录组数据模式的大量表达研究中得出的二元、连续和生存表型的映射。这使得能够识别生物学相关的细胞群和空间利基，以进行实验验证和治疗干预。

details.abstractOriginal: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomic studies often lack sufficient sample size to compute robust statistical associations between a sample-level phenotype and cell types or spatial locations. In contrast, lower resolution methods such as bulk gene expression profiling have been applied at scale in large, annotated datasets, providing reliable signatures for phenotype associations. We introduce PhenoMapR, a semi-supervised method designed to integrate the phenotypic rigor of large-scale bulk expression studies with the cellular and spatial granularity of single-cell and spatial transcriptomics. PhenoMapR achieves this by deriving and mapping bulk gene expression signatures onto cells and spatial locations in a computationally efficient and scalable manner. The framework is broadly applicable across biological contexts, supporting the mapping of binary, continuous, and survival phenotypes derived from bulk expression studies across transcriptomic data modalities. This enables the identification of biologically-relevant cellular populations and spatial niches for experimental validation and therapeutic intervention.

items.title: Highly resolved tumor architecture via matched spatial and nucleus transcriptomics from a single tissue section
items.summary: 同一张 5 微米 FFPE 切片生成空间和单核基因表达；展示小鼠脑、乳腺癌与前列腺癌组织。 作者报告解析带有不同空间签名的细粒度细胞状态，提高稀缺切片的信息利用。

摘要中文翻译：

details.abstractOriginal: Spatial transcriptomics often relies on reference-based deconvolution to infer cell types in a tissue context; however, public single-cell datasets can miss patient-specific biology. By extracting both spatial and nuclear layers, SIMPlex maximises the information recovered from a single tissue section, an advantage for scarce archival and clinical specimens.

items.title: PHAROS: turning single-cell perturbation models into target-directed drug-combination screens
items.summary: 不重训底层模型，串联单药预测并按目标细胞状态评分；测试两个独立组合扰动数据集。 作者报告在已见及未见细胞系恢复精确或机制匹配的双药响应；目标相关排名不能简单由单药或加和效应解释。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
联合疗法是癌症治疗的核心，但详尽的筛查是不切实际的。我们引入了 PHAROS，这是一个框架，可将预训练的单细胞扰动模型转变为药物组合的靶向搜索引擎。 PHAROS 预测细胞群在药物作用下如何变化，一次一种药物，然后将这些预测链接在一起以模拟药物组合。它根据所需的目标状态对每个模拟结果进行评分，并使用搜索算法来查找最有希望的组合，所有这些都无需重新训练底层模型。在两个独立的组合扰动数据集中，PHAROS 恢复了细胞系中精确或机制匹配的两种药物反应，无论是在模型训练期间看到的还是未看到的。其排名特定于所要求的转化，并且不通过单一药物效应、附加效应或共同作用机制来解释。在对患者来源的转移性 HR+/HER2- 乳腺肿瘤和基底细胞癌 (BCC) 的探索性分析中，PHAROS 优先考虑 FDA 批准的治疗方案，根据预测的肿瘤与免疫客观特征区分组合，并提名途径水平假设，同时明确将两个肿瘤队列识别为模型支持的分布之外。 PHAROS 提供了从预训练虚拟细胞模型到逆向单细胞组合筛选平台的模块化路线。

方法与数据：不重训底层模型，串联单药预测并按目标细胞状态评分；测试两个独立组合扰动数据集。

details.abstractOriginal: Combination therapies are central to cancer treatment, but exhaustive screening is impractical. We introduce PHAROS, a framework that turns a pretrained single-cell perturbation model into a target-directed search engine for drug combinations. PHAROS predicts how a cell population changes under a drug, one drug at a time, then chains these predictions together to simulate drug combinations. It scores each simulated outcome against the desired target state and uses a search algorithm to find the most promising combinations, all without retraining the underlying model. Across two independent combinatorial perturbation datasets, PHAROS recovered exact or mechanism-matched two-drug responses in cell lines, both seen and unseen during model training. Its rankings were specific to the requested conversion and were not explained by single-drug effects, additive effects, or shared mechanism of action. In exploratory analyses of patient-derived metastatic HR+/HER2- breast tumors and basal cell carcinoma (BCC), PHAROS prioritized FDA-approved regimens, distinguished combinations by their predicted tumor-versus-immune objective profiles, and nominated pathway-level hypotheses, while explicitly identifying both tumor cohorts as outside the model's supported distribution. PHAROS provides a modular route from pretrained virtual-cell models to inverse, single-cell combination-screening platforms.

items.title: Analysis of multicellular anatomical structures from spatial omics data using sosta
items.summary: 以多细胞结构为直接分析对象，在两个公开数据集演示，并提供 Bioconductor 开源软件。 原始摘要确认可分析组织结构层次的空间分子特征。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：

方法与数据：以多细胞结构为直接分析对象，在两个公开数据集演示，并提供 Bioconductor 开源软件。

details.abstractOriginal: Spatial omics technologies enable high-resolution, large-scale quantification of molecular features while preserving the spatial context within tissues. Existing analysis methods largely focus on spatial arrangements of single cells, whereas biological function often emerges from multicellular arrangements. Here, we introduce structure-based analysis of spatial omics data, which focuses on the direct analysis of multicellular, anatomical structures. We illustrate this type of analysis using two publicly available datasets and provide sosta, an open-source Bioconductor package for broad community use.

items.title: spaCraft: calibrated power analysis and sample-size planning for multi-sample spatial transcriptomics
items.summary: 用有重复的先导数据拟合表达、域几何与组成，经生成—重建域—检验循环估计功效；四个队列覆盖 Visium、Stereo-seq、Visium HD。 作者报告三样本先导数据可在独立真实样本上预测样本量需求；差异表达及组成终点使用重建域。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
比较空间转录组学现在已成为常规，但每组组织切片的数量很少通过正式的功效分析来确定。功效共同取决于样本变异和通过聚类恢复的域之间的关系，这是现有工具无法表示的组合。我们提出了 spaCraft，它将重复的试点转换为特定于端点的每组样本大小建议。它适合空间表达、域几何和组成的模型，然后通过生成、恢复、测试循环来估计功率，该循环重新估计每个合成样本中的域，从而允许聚类不确定性进入推荐。其差异表达和组成终点是在恢复的域而不是假设的域上进行测试，产生校准的功效而不是检测率。我们将 spaCraft 应用于 Visium、Stereo-seq 和 Visium HD 的四个队列。在保留验证中，三样本试点预测了独立真实样本中的样本量要求，支持从试点拟合到域恢复再到端点测试的完整链条。因此，样本大小成为计划分析的明确的、可重复的属性，而不是非正式的猜测。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：比较空间转录组学现在已成为常规，但每组组织切片的数量很少通过正式的功效分析来确定。功效共同取决于样本变异和通过聚类恢复的域之间的关系，这是现有工具无法表示的组合。

方法与数据：用有重复的先导数据拟合表达、域几何与组成，经生成—重建域—检验循环估计功效；四个队列覆盖 Visium、Stereo-seq、Visium HD。

结果及适用范围：作者报告三样本先导数据可在独立真实样本上预测样本量需求；差异表达及组成终点使用重建域。
details.findings: 结果解读：作者报告三样本先导数据可在独立真实样本上预测样本量需求；差异表达及组成终点使用重建域。
details.limitations:
预印本；校准依赖先导数据和生成模型；不能把三样本先导结果解释为所有实验只需三个样本。
简报证据边界：本次补充依据原始摘要；原文未报告的输入输出细节、完整基线、切分和训练设置均未补造。摘要译文采用机器辅助翻译并作术语、数值和身份检查；未逐篇全文精读。原有局限为简报分析，不能一概视为作者自述。
details.abstractOriginal: Comparative spatial transcriptomics is now routine, yet the number of tissue sections per group is rarely determined by formal power analysis. Power depends jointly on between sample variation and domains recovered by clustering, a combination not represented by existing tools. We present spaCraft, which converts a replicated pilot into endpoint-specific per-group sample-size recommendations. It fits models of spatial expression, domain geometry and composition, then estimates power through a generate, recover, test loop that reestimates domains in every synthetic sample, allowing clustering uncertainty to enter the recommendation. Its differential-expression and composition endpoints are tested on recovered rather than assumed domains, yielding calibrated power rather than detection rates. We applied spaCraft to four cohorts spanning Visium, Stereo-seq, and Visium HD. In held-out validation, three-sample pilots predicted sample-size requirements in independent real samples, supporting the full chain from pilot fitting through domain recovery to endpoint testing. Sample size thereby becomes an explicit, reproducible property of the planned analysis rather than an informal guess.

items.title: highSpaClone enables copy number alteration inference and tumor subclone analysis for high-resolution spatial transcriptomics
items.summary: 在 CNA 估计与克隆聚类中共享相邻位置的信息，分析多个 Xenium 和 Visium HD 数据集。 作者报告解析克隆相关表达、演化轨迹和微环境，并在结直肠癌组织学正常上皮区推断 CNA。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
高分辨率空间分辨转录组学（SRT）为研究肿瘤异质性提供了前所未有的机会，但也带来了巨大的计算和分析挑战。在这里，我们提出了 highSpaClone，这是一种计算框架，用于从跨多个空间尺度的高分辨率 SRT 数据进行拷贝数改变 (CNA) 推断和肿瘤亚克隆识别。通过将空间约束集成到 CNA 估计和克隆聚类中，highSpaClone 使相邻空间位置能够共享信息，从而提高基因组信号的鲁棒性和亚克隆描绘的准确性。在多个 Xenium 和 Visium HD 数据集中，highSpaClone 揭示了独特的转录程序、克隆进化轨迹以及独特的肿瘤微环境相互作用。此外，在人类结直肠癌样本中，highSpaClone 检测到组织学正常上皮区域中的 CNA 事件，突出显示与现场癌化相关的早期基因组改变。这些发现将 highSpaClone 确立为研究克隆结构和肿瘤进化的可扩展框架。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：高分辨率空间分辨转录组学（SRT）为研究肿瘤异质性提供了前所未有的机会，但也带来了巨大的计算和分析挑战。在这里，我们提出了 highSpaClone，这是一种计算框架，用于从跨多个空间尺度的高分辨率 SRT 数据进行拷贝数改变 (CNA) 推断和肿瘤亚克隆识别。

方法与数据：在 CNA 估计与克隆聚类中共享相邻位置的信息，分析多个 Xenium 和 Visium HD 数据集。

结果及适用范围：作者报告解析克隆相关表达、演化轨迹和微环境，并在结直肠癌组织学正常上皮区推断 CNA。
details.findings: 结果解读：作者报告解析克隆相关表达、演化轨迹和微环境，并在结直肠癌组织学正常上皮区推断 CNA。
details.limitations:
表达推断的 CNA 不等于直接 DNA 测量；摘要未给独立基因组验证规模，不能据此确认所有早期癌变。
简报证据边界：本次补充依据原始摘要；原文未报告的输入输出细节、完整基线、切分和训练设置均未补造。摘要译文采用机器辅助翻译并作术语、数值和身份检查；未逐篇全文精读。原有局限为简报分析，不能一概视为作者自述。
details.abstractOriginal: High-resolution spatially resolved transcriptomics (SRT) offers unprecedented opportunities to investigate tumor heterogeneity but poses substantial computational and analytical challenges. Here, we present highSpaClone, a computational framework for copy number alteration (CNA) inference and tumor subclone identification from high-resolution SRT data across multiple spatial scales. By integrating spatial constraints into CNA estimation and clonal clustering, highSpaClone enables neighboring spatial locations to share information, thereby improving the robustness of genomic signals and the accuracy of subclone delineation. Across multiple Xenium and Visium HD datasets, highSpaClone revealed unique transcriptional programs, clonal evolutionary trajectories, and distinct tumor-microenvironment interactions. Furthermore, in human colorectal cancer samples, highSpaClone detected CNA events in histologically normal epithelial regions, highlighting early genomic alterations associated with field cancerization. These findings establish highSpaClone as a scalable framework for studying clonal architecture and tumor evolution.

items.title: scMustree: a multi-scale functional hierarchy for single-cell transcriptomic analysis
items.summary: 先自顶向下分解，再以差异表达和 isolation forest 功能评分自底向上合并；使用 11 个基准数据集。 作者报告有竞争力的聚类精度，并展示癌症成纤维/T 细胞及阿尔茨海默病微胶质的功能层次。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
动机解决细胞异质性需要捕获离散细胞类型及其功能关系的方法。现有的单细胞聚类方法通常会产生平坦的分区，限制了它们揭示罕见细胞状态和连续生物转变的能力。在这里，我们介绍了 scMustree，这是一种计算框架，可构建单细胞转录组的多尺度层次结构，从而实现细胞组织和功能关系的综合分析。 scMustree 采用自上而下的迭代分解来分离转录同质群体，然后采用自下而上的合并策略，该策略由来自差异表达的簇特定功能排名和量化功能差异性的基于隔离林的评分机制引导。这种统一的方法捕获了谱系结构、功能相似性和过渡状态。结果 在 11 个基准数据集上，scMustree 实现了有竞争力的聚类准确性，同时提供了显着增强的生物可解释性。在不同的生物系统中，它揭示了生物学上一致的层次结构，并识别了以前未表征的细胞状态，包括癌症中的成纤维细胞和 T 细胞亚群以及阿尔茨海默病中的脂质相关小胶质细胞群。通过整合结构和功能信息，scMustree 为单细胞生态系统的多分辨率探索提供了一个可扩展且基于生物学的框架，从而能够在不同的生物环境中发现罕见和与疾病相关的细胞状态。可用性和实施​​可在 Github (https://github.com/xuyp-csu/scMustree) 和 Zenodo (https://zenodo.org/records/17480562) 上免费获取。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：动机解决细胞异质性需要捕获离散细胞类型及其功能关系的方法。现有的单细胞聚类方法通常会产生平坦的分区，限制了它们揭示罕见细胞状态和连续生物转变的能力。

方法与数据：先自顶向下分解，再以差异表达和 isolation forest 功能评分自底向上合并；使用 11 个基准数据集。

结果及适用范围：作者报告有竞争力的聚类精度，并展示癌症成纤维/T 细胞及阿尔茨海默病微胶质的功能层次。
details.findings: 结果解读：作者报告有竞争力的聚类精度，并展示癌症成纤维/T 细胞及阿尔茨海默病微胶质的功能层次。

摘要未提供完整效果量；推断层次不等同实测谱系，稀有细胞状态需外部验证。

details.abstractOriginal: Motivation Resolving cellular heterogeneity requires methods that capture both discrete cell types and their functional relationships. Existing single-cell clustering approaches often produce flat partitions, limiting their ability to reveal rare cell states and continuous biological transitions. Here, we introduce scMustree, a computational framework that constructs a multi-scale hierarchy of single-cell transcriptomes, enabling integrated analysis of cellular organization and functional relationships. scMustree employs a top-down iterative decomposition to isolate transcriptionally homogeneous populations, followed by a bottom-up merging strategy guided by cluster-specific functional rankings-derived from differential expression and an isolation-forest-based scoring mechanism that quantifies functional distinctness. This unified approach captures lineage structures, functional similarities, and transitional states. Results Across 11 benchmark datasets, scMustree achieves competitive clustering accuracy while offering substantially enhanced biological interpretability. In diverse biological systems, it uncovers biologically consistent hierarchies and identifies previously uncharacterized cell states, including fibroblast and T-cell subsets in cancer and lipid-associated microglial populations in Alzheimer's disease. By integrating structural and functional information, scMustree provides a scalable and biologically grounded framework for multi-resolution exploration of single-cell ecosystems, enabling discovery of rare and disease-relevant cell states across diverse biological contexts. Availability and implementation Freely available at Github (https://github.com/xuyp-csu/scMustree) and Zenodo (https://zenodo.org/records/17480562).

items.title: Causal assessment of Bayesian gene regulatory networks from single-cell transcriptomics
items.summary: R 软件包含适配单细胞转录组的贝叶斯网络算法、结构评估与条件间调控比较；不要求已有分子互作网络。 作者报告识别具有生物学关联的组间差异调控关系。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
基因调控网络 (GRN) 推断是从单细胞转录组 (SCT) 数据揭示不同细胞类型中基因之间失调关系的重要工具。基于从 SCT 数据学习的贝叶斯网络 (BN) 的 GRN 可以通过图形建模阐明代表复杂疾病机制及其相互作用的定向调控关系。然而，用于从 SCT 数据学习 BN 的软件尚未广泛使用，用于评估 BN 在表示基因之间因果关系方面的结构准确性的软件也尚未广泛使用。在这里，我们描述 scstruc R 包。该软件包提供了一套专门设计用于处理 SCT 数据的 BN 结构学习算法，无论已建立的分子相互作用网络是否可用，都可以根据它们所代表的因果关系来评估生成的网络，并比较条件之间的调节关系。我们证明了 scstruc 可以在每个细胞的基础上识别群体之间生物学相关的差异调节关系。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：基因调控网络 (GRN) 推断是从单细胞转录组 (SCT) 数据揭示不同细胞类型中基因之间失调关系的重要工具。基于从 SCT 数据学习的贝叶斯网络 (BN) 的 GRN 可以通过图形建模阐明代表复杂疾病机制及其相互作用的定向调控关系。

方法与数据：R 软件包含适配单细胞转录组的贝叶斯网络算法、结构评估与条件间调控比较；不要求已有分子互作网络。

结果及适用范围：作者报告识别具有生物学关联的组间差异调控关系。
details.findings: 结果解读：作者报告识别具有生物学关联的组间差异调控关系。
details.limitations:
观测转录组中的有向图依赖模型假设；结构评估不能替代真实干预，不将标题中的因果评估解释为已证实因果。

details.abstractOriginal: Gene regulatory network (GRN) inference is an essential tool for revealing dysregulated relationships between genes in different cell types from single-cell transcriptomic (SCT) data. GRNs based on Bayesian networks (BNs) learned from SCT data can elucidate directed regulatory relationships representing complex disease mechanisms and their interplay through graphical modeling. However, software for learning BNs from SCT data is not widely available, nor is software for evaluating the BNs' structural accuracy in representing causal relationships between genes. Here, we describe the scstruc R package. This package provides a suite of BN structure learning algorithms specifically designed to handle SCT data, to evaluate the resulting networks based on the causal relationships they represent regardless of the availability of established molecular interaction networks, and to compare regulatory relationships between conditions. We demonstrated that scstruc can identify biologically relevant differential regulatory relationships between groups on a per-cell basis.

items.title: scOLAR: Ontology-Anchored Open-Set Annotation of Single-Cell RNA-seq Data
items.summary: 在细胞本体上学习原型，同时使用参考与目标表达，结合层级约束和决策边界正则；未知群不预设聚类数。 作者报告新颖性检测 AUROC 0.9726、平均精确率 0.9871，并支持未知群的谱系层级解释。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
单细胞 RNA 测序可在图谱范围内分析细胞异质性，因此自动化注释至关重要。然而，目标数据集通常包含不完整参考文献中缺失的新细胞类型。我们提出了 scOLAR，一个本体引导的开放集框架，它通过细胞本体学习原型，并使用参考和目标表达来注释已知类别，同时检测不熟悉的群体。在本体层次结构和决策边界正则化的指导下，scOLAR 会惩罚粗谱系错误分类，并对新细胞进行分组，而无需预定义的簇计数。在各个基准测试中，scOLAR 实现了 0.9726 的新颖性检测 AUROC 和 0.9871 的平均精度，从而能够对参考中缺少的人群进行结构化的事后谱系级别解释。

研究问题与设计：单细胞 RNA 测序可在图谱范围内分析细胞异质性，因此自动化注释至关重要。然而，目标数据集通常包含不完整参考文献中缺失的新细胞类型。

方法与数据：在细胞本体上学习原型，同时使用参考与目标表达，结合层级约束和决策边界正则；未知群不预设聚类数。

结果及适用范围：作者报告新颖性检测 AUROC 0.9726、平均精确率 0.9871，并支持未知群的谱系层级解释。
details.findings: 结果解读：作者报告新颖性检测 AUROC 0.9726、平均精确率 0.9871，并支持未知群的谱系层级解释。

details.abstractOriginal: Single-cell RNA sequencing profiles cellular heterogeneity at atlas scale, making automated annotation essential. However, target datasets often contain novel cell types missing from incomplete references. We present scOLAR, an ontology-guided open-set framework that learns prototypes over the Cell Ontology and uses both reference and target expression to annotate known classes while detecting unfamiliar populations. Guided by ontology hierarchies and decision-boundary regularization, scOLAR penalizes coarse-lineage misclassification and groups novel cells without requiring predefined cluster counts. Across benchmarks, scOLAR achieves a novelty-detection AUROC of 0.9726 and an average precision of 0.9871, enabling structured post-hoc lineage-level interpretation of populations absent from the reference.

details.abstractOriginal: Summary dictyExpress 3.0 is a React/TypeScript reimplementation of the Dictyostelium discoideum transcriptomics web server, first introduced in 2009, that unifies bulk and single-cell exploration. A long-standing gene-expression resource for the Dictyostelium community, dictyExpress is also accessible through dictyBase, the central organism database for Dictyostelium. The new release preserves the curated bulk RNA-seq dashboards of earlier versions while adding an interactive module for a developmental scRNA-seq time course of wild-type AX4 and two cAMP-signalling mutants. Following visual analytics principles, interactive visualizations are coordinated through brushing and linking, with bulk time courses, differential expression, gene-ontology enrichment and the UMAP workspace sharing a common gene selection, enabling bookmarkable and exportable cross-modal analysis in one interface for Dictyostelium transcriptomics. Availability and implementation dictyExpress is available at https://app.dictyexpress.org/. Source code: https://github.com/biolab/dictyexpress-js. Contact [作者联系方式略], [作者联系方式略]

items.title: ScGraphTrans: Pathway-Guided Graph Learning and Domain Adaptation for Cell Type Annotation in Single-Cell RNA-seq
items.source: IEEE Transactions on Computational Biology and Bioinformatics
items.summary: 14 个癌症相关通路的活动分数作为伪标签，结合图结构学习和域适配；三类癌症、15 人、38667 个细胞。 作者报告平均注释准确率 84.28%，并在不使用配体—受体先验监督时恢复部分疾病相关互作。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
肿瘤微环境（TME）是一个复杂的生态系统，其中细胞间通讯调节肿瘤进展和治疗反应。然而，由于配体-受体数据库不完整和细胞类型注释不准确，从非空间 scRNA-seq 推断细胞-细胞相互作用仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出了 scGraphTrans，这是一种图神经网络框架，它集成了功能状态伪标签、图结构学习和图域适应，以改进细胞类型注释和通信推理。 14 个癌症相关过程（例如血管生成、细胞凋亡、细胞周期）的通路活性评分被用作伪标签来细化细胞-细胞图，捕获超越几何相似性的功能接近性。领域适应模块进一步调整患者之间的嵌入，增强跨个体泛化。 scGraphTrans 对来自 15 个人的三种癌症的 38,667 个细胞进行了评估，平均准确率达到 84.28%，超越了最先进的基线，同时保持了跨异构数据集的稳健性。统计验证表明，在没有事先配体-受体监督的情况下，疾病特异性基因相互作用（例如乳腺浸润性癌中的 LGALS1-SUSD2 和结直肠癌中的 BIRC5-CASP6）恢复。本文使用的源代码和数据可以在https://github.com/LiYuechao1998/scGraphTrans找到。因此，我们的框架为 TME 分析提供了可解释且可推广的解决方案，为生物标志物发现和治疗策略提供了见解。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：肿瘤微环境（TME）是一个复杂的生态系统，其中细胞间通讯调节肿瘤进展和治疗反应。然而，由于配体-受体数据库不完整和细胞类型注释不准确，从非空间 scRNA-seq 推断细胞-细胞相互作用仍然具有挑战性。

方法与数据：14 个癌症相关通路的活动分数作为伪标签，结合图结构学习和域适配；三类癌症、15 人、38667 个细胞。

结果及适用范围：作者报告平均注释准确率 84.28%，并在不使用配体—受体先验监督时恢复部分疾病相关互作。

数据规模和结论限于所测癌症；非空间表达推断的通讯并非直接细胞接触或干预证据。
简报证据边界：本次补充依据原始摘要；原文未报告的输入输出细节、完整基线、切分和训练设置均未补造。摘要译文采用机器辅助翻译并作术语、数值和身份检查；未逐篇全文精读。原有局限为简报分析，不能一概视为作者自述。
details.abstractOriginal: The tumor microenvironment (TME) is a complex ecosystem in which intercellular communication regulates tumor progression and therapeutic response. Yet inferring cell-cell interactions from non-spatial scRNA-seq remains challenging due to incomplete ligand-receptor databases and inaccurate cell type annotations. Here, we propose scGraphTrans, a graph neural network framework that integrates functional state pseudo-labels, graph structure learning, and graph domain adaptation to improve both cell type annotation and communication inference. Pathway activity scores across 14 cancer-relevant processes (e.g., angiogenesis, apoptosis, cell cycle) are used as pseudo-labels to refine cell-cell graphs, capturing functional proximity beyond geometric similarity. A domain adaptation module further aligns embeddings across patients, enhancing cross-individual generalization. Evaluated on 38,667 cells from 15 individuals across three cancers, scGraphTrans achieved an average accuracy of 84.28%, surpassing state-of-the-art baselines while maintaining robustness across heterogeneous datasets. Statistical validation demonstrated recovery of disease-specific gene interactions (e.g., LGALS1-SUSD2 in breast invasive carcinoma and BIRC5-CASP6 in colorectal cancer) without prior ligand-receptor supervision. The source code and data used in this paper can be found in https://github.com/LiYuechao1998/scGraphTrans. Our framework thus provides an interpretable and generalizable solution for TME analysis, offering insights into biomarker discovery and therapeutic strategies.

items.title: DMGRN: Enhancing Diffusion Models for Gene Regulatory Network Inference
items.source: IEEE Transactions on Computational Biology and Bioinformatics
items.summary: 改进 DDPM 的逆过程结合结构方程模型，加入基因相似性对齐损失；测试 28 个 BEELINE 基准配置。 作者报告 28 个配置中的 18 个取得最高 Early Precision Ratio。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
基因调控网络（GRN）编码转录因子（TF）与其靶基因之间复杂的相互作用，在协调细胞代谢、增殖和分化中发挥着关键作用，从而阐明疾病发生和进展的分子机制。单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 数据的可用性不断增加，为计算 GRN 推断提供了前所未有的机会。然而，scRNA-seq 数据固有的高噪声和稀疏性极大地损害了现有推理方法的性能。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了 DMGRN，这是一种基于改进的去噪扩散概率模型 (DDPM) 构建的新型 GRN 推理框架。我们的方法首先应用正向扩散过程逐步将高斯噪声引入原始表达数据中，随后采用与结构方程模型（SEM）集成的反向过程来预测噪声，从而准确地恢复基因调控关系。为了进一步提高推理保真度，我们引入了基因相似性对齐损失，它鼓励预测噪声和基因水平的扰动数据之间的相关一致性，使模型能够同时捕获细胞水平的噪声残差和基因水平的调控共表达模式。 28 个 BEELINE 基准数据集上的实验结果表明，DMGRN 在 28 个 BEELINE 基准配置中的 18 个上实现了最高的早期精度比 (EPR)，与最先进的方法相比，展示了卓越的稳定性和计算效率。

方法与数据：改进 DDPM 的逆过程结合结构方程模型，加入基因相似性对齐损失；测试 28 个 BEELINE 基准配置。

结果及适用范围：作者报告 28 个配置中的 18 个取得最高 Early Precision Ratio。

details.abstractOriginal: Gene regulatory networks (GRNs) encode the intricate interactions between transcription factors (TFs) and their target genes, playing a pivotal role in orchestrating cellular metabolism, proliferation, and differentiation, thereby illuminating the molecular mechanisms underlying disease onset and progression. The increasing availability of single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data offers unprecedented opportunities for computational GRN inference. However, the inherent high noise and sparsity of scRNA-seq data considerably impair the performance of existing inference methods. To overcome these limitations, we propose DMGRN, a novel GRN inference frame work built upon an improved Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM). Our approach first applies a forward diffusion process to progressively introduce Gaussian noise into the raw expression data, and subsequently employs a reverse process integrated with a structural equation model (SEM) to predict the noise, thereby accurately recovering gene regulatory relationships. To further enhance inference fidelity, we introduce a gene similarity alignment loss that encourages correlation consistency between the predicted noise and the perturbed data at the gene level, enabling the model to simultaneously capture cellular-level noise residuals and gene-level regulatory co-expression patterns. Experimental results on 28 BEELINE benchmark datasets demonstrate that DMGRN achieves the highest Early Precision Ratio (EPR) on 18 out of 28 BEELINE benchmark configurations, demonstrating superior stability and computational efficiency compared to state-of-the-art methods.

items.title: Benchmarking methods integrating GWAS and single-cell transcriptomic data for mapping trait-cell type associations
items.updateType: 预印本修订 v3（首次收录）
items.summary: 以 PubMed 与 LLM 辅助综述构建证据基准，比较 20 个性状—细胞类型映射方法及模拟/实数据。 作者报告 Cauchy 组合 CATCH 总体最稳健，并指出细胞特异性度量、GWAS 功效和参考多样性的影响。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
全基因组关联研究（GWAS）发现了许多与性状相关的变异，但它们的生物学背景仍不清楚。将 GWAS 摘要统计数据与单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 数据相结合，可以对这些变异影响性状的细胞类型进行优先排序。现有的方法大致遵循两种策略：“单细胞到 GWAS”，它识别细胞类型特异性基因并测试它们在 GWAS 信号中的富集度；“GWAS 到单细胞”，它从 GWAS 优先的基因开始，根据细胞或细胞类型的表达谱对细胞或细胞类型进行评分。在这里，我们通过将 PubMed 证据与大型语言模型辅助文献合成相结合，开发了一个基于文献的基准，以评估 20 种性状细胞类型映射方法。我们将 CATCH（柯西互补方法的组合）确定为最稳健的整体方法，能够始终如一地实现高统计功效，同时在模拟和真实数据基准上保持有效的误报控制。我们进一步确定了性能的关键决定因素，包括细胞类型特异性指标、GWAS 统计功效和 scRNA-seq 参考数据集的多样性，为性状细胞类型映射方法的开发和应用提供实用指导。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：全基因组关联研究（GWAS）发现了许多与性状相关的变异，但它们的生物学背景仍不清楚。将 GWAS 摘要统计数据与单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 数据相结合，可以对这些变异影响性状的细胞类型进行优先排序。

方法与数据：以 PubMed 与 LLM 辅助综述构建证据基准，比较 20 个性状—细胞类型映射方法及模拟/实数据。

结果及适用范围：作者报告 Cauchy 组合 CATCH 总体最稳健，并指出细胞特异性度量、GWAS 功效和参考多样性的影响。
details.findings: 结果解读：作者报告 Cauchy 组合 CATCH 总体最稳健，并指出细胞特异性度量、GWAS 功效和参考多样性的影响。

预印本；v3 首次收录；文献辅助真值会受研究偏倚影响，作者总体排名不保证所有性状均最佳。
简报证据边界：本次补充依据原始摘要；原文未报告的输入输出细节、完整基线、切分和训练设置均未补造。摘要译文采用机器辅助翻译并作术语、数值和身份检查；未逐篇全文精读。原有局限为简报分析，不能一概视为作者自述。
details.abstractOriginal: Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have discovered numerous trait-associated variants, but their biological context remains unclear. Integrating GWAS summary statistics with single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) data enables prioritization of cell types in which these variants influence traits. Existing methods broadly follow two strategies: "single cell to GWAS", which identifies cell-type-specific genes and tests their enrichment in GWAS signals, and "GWAS to single cell", which begins with GWAS-prioritized genes and scores cells or cell types according to their expression profiles. Here, we developed a literature-informed benchmark by integrating PubMed evidence with large language model-assisted literature synthesis to evaluate 20 trait-cell type mapping methods. We identify CATCH, a Cauchy combination of complementary methods, as the most robust overall approach, consistently achieving high statistical power while maintaining effective false-positive control across simulations and real-data benchmarks. We further identify key determinants of performance, including cell-type specificity metrics, GWAS statistical power, and the diversity of scRNA-seq reference datasets, providing practical guidance for the development and application of trait-cell type mapping methods.

items.title: Disagreement-Informed Arbitration for Gene Regulatory Network Inference: A Score-Level Meta-Classifier and a Diagnostic Typology of Inter-Method Conflict
items.summary: 以十种推断方法的边分数训练梯度提升分类器；六个单细胞扰动筛选、四类细胞，比较按边与按目标基因切分。 作者报告目标分组下相对均值集成 AUROC 增益为 0.056/0.083；图注意力模型从按边切分 0.930 降至目标留出 0.533。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
基因调控网络推理方法通常对各个边存在分歧，实践者通过选择一种方法或对所有方法取平均值来解决这些冲突。我们询问冲突是否可以按边进行仲裁。梯度增强分类器根据十种推理方法（基于相关、信息论、稀疏回归和树集成，包括 GENIE3、GRNBoost2、CLR 和 ARACNe）分配给每个候选调节器-目标对的原始分数进行训练，因此赋予每种方法的权重因边而异。在跨越四种细胞类型的六个单细胞扰动屏幕中，在目标分组交叉验证下，仲裁将 Adamson 上的平均集成提高了 +0.056 AUROC，在 Shifrut 上提高了 +0.083。事实证明，评估协议比模型更重要。边级交叉验证是本文献中的标准，通过目标基因泄漏将表观收益夸大了 0.060 AUROC，与整个诚实的改进相当。对于隐式表示基因的方法来说，效果要大得多：在相同折叠上训练的监督图注意链接预测器在边水平交叉验证下得分 AUROC 0.930，比我们评估的任何其他方法都要好，一旦目标基因被保留，得分为 0.533。任何参数化基因的方法都是公开的，其中涵盖了大多数基于图和嵌入的方法。方法间冲突的五类类型学局部化了仲裁的效果，在方法不一致的边收益最大，在方法一致的边收益最小，同时不添加任何模型输入；因此，我们将其报告为诊断工具而不是建模贡献。我们还描述了真实测量的特征：广泛使用的屏幕中大多数受干扰的基因不是转录因子，并且中介屏幕限制了有多少扰动反应可以是直接的。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：基因调控网络推理方法通常对各个边存在分歧，实践者通过选择一种方法或对所有方法取平均值来解决这些冲突。我们询问冲突是否可以按边进行仲裁。

方法与数据：以十种推断方法的边分数训练梯度提升分类器；六个单细胞扰动筛选、四类细胞，比较按边与按目标基因切分。

结果及适用范围：作者报告目标分组下相对均值集成 AUROC 增益为 0.056/0.083；图注意力模型从按边切分 0.930 降至目标留出 0.533。

details.abstractOriginal: Gene regulatory network inference methods routinely disagree about individual edges, and practitioners resolve those conflicts by choosing one method or averaging them all. We ask whether the conflict can instead be arbitrated per edge. A gradient-boosted classifier is trained on the raw scores that ten inference methods-correlation-based, information-theoretic, sparse-regression and tree-ensemble, including GENIE3, GRNBoost2, CLR and ARACNe-assign to each candidate regulator-target pair, so that the weight given to each method varies from edge to edge. Across six single-cell perturbation screens spanning four cell types, arbitration improves on mean ensembling by +0.056 AUROC on Adamson and +0.083 on Shifrut under target-grouped cross-validation. The evaluation protocol turns out to matter more than the model. Edge-level cross-validation, standard in this literature, inflates apparent gains by 0.060 AUROC through target-gene leakage-comparable to the entire honest improvement. The effect is far larger for methods that represent genes implicitly: a supervised graph-attention link predictor trained on identical folds scores AUROC 0.930 under edge-level cross-validation, better than anything else we evaluate, and 0.533 once target genes are held out. Any method that parameterises genes is exposed, which covers most graph- and embedding-based approaches. A five-category typology of inter-method conflict localises where arbitration pays off, with the largest gains on edges where the methods disagree and the smallest where they already agree, while adding nothing as model input; we therefore report it as a diagnostic instrument rather than a modelling contribution. We also characterise what the ground truth measures: most perturbed genes in widely used screens are not transcription factors, and a mediation screen bounds how much of the perturbation response can be direct.
details.abstractTranslation: 基因调控网络推理方法通常对各个边存在分歧，实践者通过选择一种方法或对所有方法取平均值来解决这些冲突。我们询问冲突是否可以按边进行仲裁。梯度增强分类器根据十种推理方法（基于相关、信息论、稀疏回归和树集成，包括 GENIE3、GRNBoost2、CLR 和 ARACNe）分配给每个候选调节器-目标对的原始分数进行训练，因此赋予每种方法的权重因边而异。在跨越四种细胞类型的六个单细胞扰动屏幕中，在目标分组交叉验证下，仲裁将 Adamson 上的平均集成提高了 +0.056 AUROC，在 Shifrut 上提高了 +0.083。事实证明，评估协议比模型更重要。边级交叉验证是本文献中的标准，通过目标基因泄漏将表观收益夸大了 0.060 AUROC，与整个诚实的改进相当。对于隐式表示基因的方法来说，效果要大得多：在相同折叠上训练的监督图注意链接预测器在边水平交叉验证下得分 AUROC 0.930，比我们评估的任何其他方法都要好，一旦目标基因被保留，得分为 0.533。任何参数化基因的方法都是公开的，其中涵盖了大多数基于图和嵌入的方法。方法间冲突的五类类型学局部化了仲裁的效果，在方法不一致的边收益最大，在方法一致的边收益最小，同时不添加任何模型输入；因此，我们将其报告为诊断工具而不是建模贡献。我们还描述了真实测量的特征：广泛使用的屏幕中大多数受干扰的基因不是转录因子，并且中介屏幕限制了有多少扰动反应可以是直接的。

items.title: NCACC maps cross-sample spatial niches and reveals cIgG+ epithelial rare cells driving liver cancer invasion
items.summary: 双层框架整合空间组织与细胞组成，在肝癌图谱中识别生态位，结合机制分析和患者来源类器官验证。 作者报告侵袭前沿富集 cIgG+ 上皮群、STAT1 依赖的 cIgG-JAK-STAT 轴及两个候选调节化合物。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
背景
肝癌表现出深刻的空间和细胞异质性，导致肿瘤进展、侵袭和治疗耐药。新的证据表明，存在于离散组织微环境中的罕见低丰度恶性细胞群影响这些过程。然而，由于传统的空间和单细胞转录组分析的局限性，它们的可靠检测和识别仍然具有挑战性，这些分析通常依赖于单样本收敛且缺乏跨队列重现性。目的
开发一个强大的框架，用于识别异质空间转录组数据集中的罕见恶性细胞群，并表征它们在肝癌进展中的功能作用。设计
我们开发了带有细胞共定位的生态位聚类图谱 (NCACC)，这是一个将空间组织与细胞组成相结合的双层框架，以实现跨样本生态位发现。 NCACC 应用于综合肝癌转录组图谱，以识别罕见的生态位相关恶性细胞群。结果

NCACC 将肝癌肿瘤结构分层为可重复的多细胞生态位模块，并实现了肿瘤侵袭性前沿富集的罕见癌症衍生 IgG (cIgG)
+
上皮细胞群。这些细胞增强了增殖和侵袭特性，并与疾病进展相关。机制分析确定了 STAT1 依赖性 cIgG-JAK-STAT 信号轴维持侵入前沿表型并促进 cIgG
+
上皮细胞的攻击行为。然后，我们将结构引导的虚拟筛选与源自患者的类器官验证相结合，以确定去甲二氢愈创木酸和没食子醛作为候选调节剂。结论
我们的研究将 NCACC 建立为跨异质空间转录组队列的高可信度罕见恶性细胞识别的通用框架，强调 cIgG-JAK-STAT 作为肝癌侵袭的治疗上可行的驱动因素。

方法与数据：双层框架整合空间组织与细胞组成，在肝癌图谱中识别生态位，结合机制分析和患者来源类器官验证。

结果及适用范围：作者报告侵袭前沿富集 cIgG+ 上皮群、STAT1 依赖的 cIgG-JAK-STAT 轴及两个候选调节化合物。
