details.abstractOriginal: Spatial summary statistics based on point process theory are widely used to quantify the spatial organization of cell populations in single-cell spatial proteomics data. Among these, Ripley's K is a popular metric for assessing whether cells are spatially clustered or are randomly dispersed. However, the key assumption of spatial homogeneity is frequently violated in spatial proteomics data, leading to overestimates of cell clustering and colocalization. To address this, we propose a novel method, termed KAMP (K adjustment by Analytical Moments of the Permutation distribution), for quantifying the spatial organization of cells in spatial proteomics samples. KAMP leverages background cells in each sample along with a new closed-form representation of the first and second moments of the permutation null distribution of Ripley's K. Our method is robust to inhomogeneity, computationally efficient even in large datasets, and provides approximate p-values to test spatial clustering and colocalization. Methodological developments are motivated by a spatial proteomics study of women with ovarian cancer; in the subset with sufficient B cells and macrophages, KAMP provides exploratory, scale-specific evidence linking B cell-macrophage colocalization with overall patient survival. Notably, we also find evidence that using K without correcting for sample inhomogeneity may bias hazard ratio estimates in downstream analyses.

details.abstractOriginal: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have transformed cancer therapy; yet substantial proportion of patients exhibit intrinsic or acquired resistance, making accurate pre-treatment response prediction a critical unmet need. Transcriptomics-based biomarkers derived from bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) offer a promising avenue for capturing tumour-immune interactions, yet the cross-cohort generalisability of existing prediction models remains  this http URL  systematically benchmark nine state-of-the-art transcriptomic ICI response predictors, five bulk RNA-seq-based models (COMPASS, IRNet, NetBio, IKCScore, and TNBC-ICI) and four scRNA-seq-based models (PRECISE, DeepGeneX, Tres and scCURE), using publicly available independent datasets unseen during model development. Overall, predictive performance was modest: bulk RNA-seq models performed at or near chance level across most cohorts, while scRNA-seq models showed only marginal improvements. Pathway-level analyses revealed sparse and inconsistent biomarker signals across models. Although scRNA-seq-based predictors converged on immune-related programs such as allograft rejection, bulk RNA-seq-based models exhibited little reproducible overlap. PRECISE and NetBio identified the most coherent immune-related themes, whereas IRNet predominantly captured metabolic pathways weakly aligned with ICI biology. Together, these findings demonstrate the limited cross-cohort robustness and biological consistency of current transcriptomic ICI prediction models, underscoring the need for improved domain adaptation, standardised preprocessing, and biologically grounded model design.

单细胞图谱现在超过 6600 万个细胞，但将排序的表达谱和自由形式的生物学问题转变为可靠的、有证据支持的答案仍然悬而未决。扩展单个模型并不能解决这个问题，因为单细胞解释是一个异质的任务系列，其正确答案取决于组织、队列、扰动和注释分辨率。在这里，我们提出了 scACORN，这是整体单细胞语言模型的代理替代方案，它将专门的小语言模型与上下文工程代理编排相结合，以便在推理时进行选择和组合。每个专家都分两个阶段构建：域对齐的对比适应将预先训练的细胞到文本主干与目标数据集的转录组几何结构相匹配，而几何保留专业化则在不破坏该几何结构的情况下学习问题条件的生物完成。然后，固定编排语言模型代理在自然语言剧本下选择并组合专家，该剧本本身根据文本反馈进行了优化，而编排器没有梯度更新。在 10 个白板组织中，结构域对齐将转移宏 F1 从 0.36 提高到 0.64，将 Recall@5 从 0.87 提高到 0.97；专业专家平均精确匹配标注准确率达到0.89；剧本优化将不支持的基因引用从 14.5% 减少到 3.5%。我们的研究结果支持专业化和编排作为对单细胞分析的异质性和证据需求的补充反应。

details.abstractOriginal: Single-cell atlases now exceed 66 million cells, but turning a ranked expression profile and a free-form biological question into a reliable, evidence-grounded answer remains unsolved. Scaling a single model does not resolve this, because single-cell interpretation is a heterogeneous family of tasks whose correct answer depends on tissue, cohort, perturbation and annotation resolution. Here we present scACORN, an agentic alternative to monolithic single-cell language models that combines specialized small language models with context-engineered agent orchestration for their selection and composition at inference time. Each expert is built in two stages: domain-aligned contrastive adaptation fits a pretrained cell-to-text backbone to the transcriptomic geometry of a target dataset, and geometry-preserving specialization learns question-conditioned biological completions without eroding that geometry. A fixed orchestrating language model agent then selects and combines experts under a natural-language playbook that is itself optimized from textual feedback, with no gradient updates to the orchestrator. Across 10 Tabula Sapiens tissues, domain alignment raised transfer macro-F1 from 0.36 to 0.64 and Recall@5 from 0.87 to 0.97; specialized experts reached 0.89 mean exact-match annotation accuracy; and playbook optimization reduced unsupported gene citations from 14.5% to 3.5%. Our findings support specialization and orchestration as complementary responses to the heterogeneity and evidentiary demands of single-cell analysis.

items.title: Genome-scale perturbation signatures from primary human CD4 + T cells improve genetics-based prioritization of immune drug targets

verification.basis: Crossref DOI/题名及日期，Europe PMC core原始摘要；期刊条目另核PubMed Electronic ArticleDate。预印本未推断版本号。

items.summary: 整合2200万原代人CD4 T细胞的全基因组Perturb-seq、T辅助亚群表达与遗传先验；正例—未标记学习排序19502个编码基因。 727个在试验基因留出评测中，前50免疫靶点富集从2.7倍到4.8倍；2014年冻结标签的时间验证亦支持增益。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
虽然人类遗传证据可以提高药物项目的成功率，但靶点选择在很大程度上依赖于关联特征。即使是功能特征也主要是观察性的，捕捉疾病关联，而不是扰动与疾病相关的人类细胞类型中的基因的结果。为了超越关联，我们提出了 IGNITE（免疫基因组学和目标富集功能整合），这是一个框架，通过将人类遗传先验与 2200 万个原代人类 CD4+ T 细胞中的基因组规模扰动序列特征和极化 T 辅助子亚群差异表达相结合，优先考虑免疫药物靶点。 IGNITE 是一种半监督机器学习模型，它将积极的未标记学习应用于已批准的免疫目标，然后对 19,502 个蛋白质编码基因进行排名，以优先考虑新的候选基因。在经过训练的 727 个试验基因中，功能基因组学将任何阶段的免疫试验靶点中前 50 个提名的靶点富集度提高了 2.7 倍至 4.8 倍，将 III 期靶点的靶点富集度提高了 4.5 倍至 5.9 倍。这些性能提升是免疫特异性的，因为 IGNITE 在预测免疫排斥目标方面优于遗传比较器，但在预测心脏排斥目标方面表现不佳。使用 2014 年冻结的标签进行时间验证，IGNITE 在对随后进入免疫试验的 134 个基因进行排名时优于纯遗传学模型。功能基因组层还发现了两种新颖的、药理学上易于处理的候选药物 ELOVL6 和 RUVBL1，将它们的排名从前 1,000 名之外提升到前 50 名。这些发现强调，与疾病相关的人类细胞类型中的扰动特征包含人类遗传学之外的目标相关信号，随着扰动图谱的扩展，为特定适应症的优先级排序提供了一条通用的途径。完整的 IGNITE 分数可在 https://ignite.eecs.umich.edu/ 上公开获取

方法与数据：整合2200万原代人CD4 T细胞的全基因组Perturb-seq、T辅助亚群表达与遗传先验；正例—未标记学习排序19502个编码基因。

结果及适用范围：727个在试验基因留出评测中，前50免疫靶点富集从2.7倍到4.8倍；2014年冻结标签的时间验证亦支持增益。

details.abstractOriginal: While human genetic evidence improves drug program success, target selection largely relies on associational features. Even functional features are mainly observational, capturing disease associations rather than the consequence of perturbing genes in the disease-relevant human cell type. To move beyond association, we present IGNITE (Immune Genomics and fuNctional Integration for Target Enrichment), a framework that prioritizes immune drug targets by integrating human genetic priors with features from genome-scale perturb-seq in 22 million primary human CD4+ T cells and polarized T-helper subset differential expression. IGNITE is a semi-supervised machine learning model that applies positive-unlabeled learning to approved immune targets, then ranks 19,502 protein-coding genes to prioritize new candidates. In 727 in-trial genes held out from training, functional genomics increased target enrichment among the top 50 nominations from 2.7- to 4.8-fold for immune trial targets at any phase, and from 4.5- to 5.9-fold for targets in Phase III. These performance gains were immune-specific, as IGNITE outperformed genetic comparators on predicting immune-exclusive targets but not on cardiac-exclusive targets. Using temporal validation with labels frozen in 2014, IGNITE outperformed the genetics-only model in ranking 134 genes that subsequently entered immune trials. The functional genomics layer also surfaced two novel, pharmacologically tractable candidates, ELOVL6 and RUVBL1, elevating their rankings from outside the top 1,000 into the top 50. These findings highlight that perturbational signatures in the disease-relevant human cell type harbor target-relevant signals beyond human genetics, offering a generalizable route to indication-specific prioritization as perturbation atlases expand. Full IGNITE scores are publicly available at https://ignite.eecs.umich.edu/

items.title: Unifying multimodal single-cell data with a mixture-of-experts β-variational autoencoder framework

verification.basis: Crossref DOI/题名及日期，Europe PMC core原始摘要；期刊条目另核PubMed Electronic ArticleDate。预印本未推断版本号。

items.summary: 模态特异编码/解码、共享先验及对称跨模态对齐；评测CITE-seq、Multiome、SHARE-seq、TEA-seq及scNMT-seq概念验证。 作者报告连贯嵌入、标签迁移与跨模态重建，且可通过配对桥接AML独立队列。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
多模式单细胞分析可分析细胞状态的互补层，但由于模式不匹配、稀疏性和队列覆盖不均匀，整合变得复杂。在这里，我们提出了统一变分推理（UniVI），这是一种可扩展的专家混合 β 变分自动编码器，它可以学习共享的潜在空间，同时保留特定于模态的结构。 UniVI 将模态特定的编码器/解码器与共享的潜在先验和对称的跨模态对齐目标相结合，从而实现配对测量的一致集成，而无需策划的特征链接图或预先注释的参考图谱；当标签可用时，可以添加可选的受监督头。在跨越人类 PBMC 和小鼠背部皮肤（具有连续分化层次结构的非造血组织）的配对 RNA-蛋白质 (CITE-seq) 和 RNA-染色质（10x Genomics Multiome，SHARE-seq）数据中，UniVI 产生连贯的嵌入，改善标签转移，并实现跨模式重建和去噪。扩展到三峰测量，UniVI 在 RNA、染色质可及性和表面蛋白 (TEA-seq) 之间保持稳健的三向比对，并在 β 二项式可能性下适应配对 scNMT-seq 小鼠原肠胚形成概念验证中的 DNA 甲基化。在严重的细胞类型不平衡和存在模式排斥群体的情况下，性能会适度下降。在急性髓系白血病镶嵌设计中，配对的RNA-蛋白质桥锚定了独立的仅RNA和蛋白质+基因型队列，揭示了通过突变感知微调而锐化的基因型相关邻域。因此，UniVI 为跨配对、三模态和镶嵌研究设计的多模态集成提供了一个灵活、可解释的框架，并支持部分观察研究中实用的参考查询投影。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：多模式单细胞分析可分析细胞状态的互补层，但由于模式不匹配、稀疏性和队列覆盖不均匀，整合变得复杂。在这里，我们提出了统一变分推理（UniVI），这是一种可扩展的专家混合 β 变分自动编码器，它可以学习共享的潜在空间，同时保留特定于模态的结构。

方法与数据：模态特异编码/解码、共享先验及对称跨模态对齐；评测CITE-seq、Multiome、SHARE-seq、TEA-seq及scNMT-seq概念验证。

结果及适用范围：作者报告连贯嵌入、标签迁移与跨模态重建，且可通过配对桥接AML独立队列。

details.abstractOriginal: Multimodal single-cell assays profile complementary layers of cell state, but integration is complicated by modality mismatch, sparsity, and uneven cohort coverage. Here, we present Unified Variational Inference (UniVI), a scalable mixture-of-experts β-variational autoencoder that learns a shared latent space while preserving modality-specific structure. UniVI couples modality-specific encoders/decoders with a shared latent prior and a symmetric cross-modal alignment objective, enabling consistent integration of paired measurements without curated feature-link graphs or preannotated reference atlases; optional supervised heads can be added when labels are available. Across paired RNA-protein (CITE-seq) and RNA-chromatin (10x Genomics Multiome, SHARE-seq) data spanning human PBMCs and mouse back skin-a nonhematopoietic tissue with continuous differentiation hierarchies-UniVI produces coherent embeddings, improves label transfer, and enables cross-modal reconstruction and denoising. Extending to trimodal measurements, UniVI maintains robust three-way alignment among RNA, chromatin accessibility, and surface proteins (TEA-seq), and accommodates DNA methylation in a paired scNMT-seq mouse gastrulation proof-of-concept under beta-binomial likelihoods. Performance degrades gracefully under severe cell type imbalance and in the presence of modality-exclusive populations. In an acute myeloid leukemia mosaic design, a paired RNA-protein bridge anchors independent RNA-only and protein+genotype cohorts, revealing genotype-associated neighborhoods that sharpen with mutation-aware fine-tuning. UniVI thus provides a flexible, interpretable framework for multimodal integration across paired, trimodal, and mosaic study designs and supports practical reference-to-query projection in partially observed studies.

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
摘要 从单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 数据中发现稀有细胞群仍然具有挑战性。尽管开发了多种方法，但它们的性能和实用性仍未完全表征。在这里，我们使用通过细胞类型特异性下采样从真实 scRNA-seq 数据集生成的大规模基准数据集对 11 种已发布的方法进行系统基准测试。我们发现 aKNNO 和 RareQ 在不同条件下始终表现出更好的性能。稀有细胞群体的内在特征，包括丰度和转录可分离性，是与检测性能相关的重要因素，尽管它们的影响因方法而异。值得注意的是，在选择 scCAD 参数值时应仔细考虑稀有细胞丰度。我们发现方法之间的计算效率和可扩展性存在显着差异。最后，我们证明，顶级方法的交叉预测可以提高稀有细胞识别的精度，并促进生物应用中标记基因的发现。总之，我们的研究结果为 scRNA-seq 分析中的稀有细胞检测提供了实用指导。

研究问题与设计：摘要 从单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 数据中发现稀有细胞群仍然具有挑战性。尽管开发了多种方法，但它们的性能和实用性仍未完全表征。

方法与数据：在真实scRNA-seq数据上按细胞类型下采样，比较稀有度、可分性、效率与参数选择。

结果及适用范围：作者报告aKNNO和RareQ总体较好，顶尖方法预测交集可提高精确率。

details.abstractOriginal: Abstract    Discovery of rare cell populations from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data remains challenging. Despite the development of multiple methods, their performance and practical utility remain incompletely characterized. Here, we systematically benchmark eleven published methods using large-scale benchmarking datasets generated from real scRNA-seq datasets through cell-type-specific downsampling. We find that aKNNO and RareQ exhibit consistently better performance across diverse conditions. The intrinsic characteristics of rare cell populations, including abundance and transcriptional separability, are important factors associated with detection performance, although their effects vary across methods. Notably, rare-cell abundance should be carefully considered when selecting parameter values for scCAD. We identify substantial differences in computational efficiency and scalability among methods. Finally, we demonstrate that intersecting predictions from top-performing methods can improve the precision of rare-cell identification and facilitate marker-gene discovery in biological applications. Together, our findings provide practical guidance for rare cell detection in scRNA-seq analysis.

items.title: Cell-level random splits leak group-owned answers in single-cell benchmarks

verification.basis: Crossref DOI/题名及日期，Europe PMC core原始摘要；期刊条目另核PubMed Electronic ArticleDate。预印本未推断版本号。

items.summary: 以测试细胞是否有训练集亲属及近邻能否检索亲属两个量，在谱系条形码和患者数据中估计泄漏。 作者发现克隆姐妹表达接近时分数膨胀更明显；提供拟合预测器前计算指标的工具。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
单细胞生物学中的机器学习模型越来越多地预测早期转录组谱的分化、重编程和治疗反应。测试模型是否学会了真正的生物学需要保留细胞。然而，单细胞数据是分组的：来自同一克隆、患者或批次的细胞共享相同的标签。因此，随机分割将每个测试单元的亲属（带有其标签）放置在训练集中，并且模型可以通过记住亲属而不是学习可转移的规则来获得良好的分数。分组验证消除了这种泄漏，但在每个误差条后面留下的独立单元要少得多。在这里，我们展示了如何在训练任何模型之前根据数据的两个属性来估计这种泄漏：暴露，训练中具有亲属的测试细胞的比例，以及可检索性，最近邻搜索返回此类亲属而不是不相关细胞的频率。在谱系条形码和患者数据中，暴露决定了随机分割是否会打开泄漏通道，而可检索性则决定了它可以使分数夸大多少。当细胞状态与祖先脱钩时，膨胀可以忽略不计；当克隆姐妹在表达空间中保持接近时，以及在大到足以推翻临床结论的患者队列中，膨胀就更大。我们还提供 eakcheck，它可以在拟合结果模型之前在几秒钟内计算出这两个属性。

details.abstractOriginal: Machine learning models in single-cell biology increasingly forecast differentiation, reprogramming and therapeutic response from early transcriptomic profiles. Testing whether a model has learned real biology requires held-out cells. Single-cell data, however, are grouped: cells from the same clone, patient or batch share the same label. A random split therefore places relatives of each test cell, carrying its label, in the training set, and a model can score well by memorizing a relative instead of learning a transferable rule. Grouped validation removes this leakage but leaves far fewer independent units behind each error bar. Here we show how to estimate this leakage before training any model, from two properties of the data: exposure, the fraction of test cells with relatives in training, and retrievability, how often a nearest-neighbor search returns such a relative rather than an unrelated cell. Across lineage-barcoded and patient data, exposure determines whether a random split opens a leakage channel, and retrievability determines how much it can inflate the score. The inflation is negligible where cell state has decoupled from ancestry, much larger where clonal sisters remain close in expression space, and in a patient cohort large enough to overturn a clinical conclusion. We also provide eakcheck, which computes both properties in seconds, before the outcome model is fitted.

items.title: REN-former prioritizes candidate regulators of kidney disease-state transitions through single-cell foundation modeling and human genetics

verification.basis: Crossref DOI/题名及日期，Europe PMC core原始摘要；期刊条目另核PubMed Electronic ArticleDate。预印本未推断版本号。

items.summary: 用45名参与者GSE183276微调Geneformer，模拟删除/过表达，再结合SMR、共定位和额外KPMP数据。 TTR与CALM1的外部表达方向符合预测，IFITM3不一致，CALR差异不显著。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
背景 急性肾损伤（AKI）向慢性肾病（CKD）的转变与肾小管细胞状态的动态变化相关。然而，传统的单细胞转录组分析主要识别疾病状态之间差异表达的基因，并且不直接评估与细胞状态之间的定向转变相关的基因。方法 我们通过使用来自代表正常参考、AKI 和 CKD 状态的 45 名参与者的 GSE183276 单细胞 RNA 测序数据集对 Geneformer 进行微调来开发 REN-former。计算机基因缺失和过度表达分析用于估计定向转录组变化，重点关注近端肾小管细胞。使用基于汇总数据的孟德尔随机化 (SMR)、共定位和表达分析对未包含在 GSE183276 中的其他 KPMP 参与者评估选定的基因。结果 REN-former 的正常参考、AKI 和 CKD 召回值分别为 0.99、0.80 和 0.79。计算机扰动分析确定了与从正常参考到 AKI、从正常参考到 CKD、从 AKI 到 CKD、以及从 CKD 到正常参考转变相关的不同基因程序。常规分析显示代谢抑制以及炎症和应激反应激活增加。 SMR 识别了 IFITM3、CALR、TTR、CALM1、MUC13 和 RPL13，并且共定位支持 IFITM3、CALR、TTR 和 CALM1。在额外的 KPMP 数据中，在 CKD 近曲小管中，IFITM3 较高，而 TTR 和 CALM1 较低； CALR 没有显着差异。观察到的 TTR 和 CALM1 表达变化与 REN 之前预测的方向一致，但 IFITM3 的表达变化不一致。结论 REN-former 通过将预测的扰动效应与人类遗传和转录组证据相结合，为优先考虑肾脏疾病相关细胞状态的候选调节因子提供了一个框架。

研究问题与设计：背景 急性肾损伤（AKI）向慢性肾病（CKD）的转变与肾小管细胞状态的动态变化相关。然而，传统的单细胞转录组分析主要识别疾病状态之间差异表达的基因，并且不直接评估与细胞状态之间的定向转变相关的基因。

方法与数据：用45名参与者GSE183276微调Geneformer，模拟删除/过表达，再结合SMR、共定位和额外KPMP数据。

结果及适用范围：TTR与CALM1的外部表达方向符合预测，IFITM3不一致，CALR差异不显著。

details.abstractOriginal: Background Acute kidney injury (AKI)-to-chronic kidney disease (CKD) transition is associated with dynamic changes in tubular cell state. However, conventional single-cell transcriptomic analyses primarily identify genes differentially expressed between disease states and do not directly evaluate genes associated with directional transitions between cellular states. Methods We developed REN-former by fine-tuning Geneformer using the GSE183276 single-cell RNA-sequencing dataset from 45 participants representing Normal Reference, AKI, and CKD states. In silico gene deletion and overexpression analyses were used to estimate directional transcriptomic shifts, with a focus on proximal tubular cells. Selected genes were evaluated using summary-data-based Mendelian randomization (SMR), colocalization and expression analysis in additional KPMP participants not included in GSE183276. Results REN-former achieved recall values of 0.99, 0.80, and 0.79 for Normal Reference, AKI, and CKD, respectively. In silico perturbation analyses identified distinct gene programs associated with transitions from Normal Reference to AKI, from Normal Reference to CKD, from AKI to CKD, and from CKD to Normal Reference. Conventional analysis showed metabolic suppression and increased inflammatory and stress-response activation. SMR identified IFITM3, CALR, TTR, CALM1, MUC13, and RPL13, and colocalization supported IFITM3, CALR, TTR, and CALM1. In additional KPMP data, IFITM3 was higher, whereas TTR and CALM1 were lower, in CKD proximal tubules; CALR did not differ significantly. The observed expression changes were concordant with the REN-former-predicted directions for TTR and CALM1 but discordant for IFITM3. Conclusion REN-former provides a framework for prioritizing candidate regulators of kidney disease-associated cell states by integrating predicted perturbation effects with human genetic and transcriptomic evidence.

items.title: DiffGSP: reversing mRNA diffusion to unlock high-fidelity spatial transcriptomics

verification.basis: Crossref DOI/题名及日期，Europe PMC core原始摘要；期刊条目另核PubMed Electronic ArticleDate。预印本未推断版本号。

items.summary: 将Fick定律与图信号处理结合，评估小鼠脑、肾、结直肠癌和肺腺癌等数据。 作者报告恢复细空间结构、组织化基因模块及三级淋巴结构。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
空间转录组学能够在完整组织内进行基因表达谱分析，同时保留空间背景，为细胞组织和功能提供前所未有的见解。然而，组织加工过程中的 mRNA 扩散可能会导致源自相邻细胞的转录本在给定点被捕获。这种空间错位挑战了空间转录组学的一个基本前提，即测量的基因表达忠实地对应于其空间起源，从而损害了空间保真度并可能导致生物学解释产生偏差。在这里，我们提出了 DiffGSP，这是一个基于物理的框架，它将菲克定律与图形信号处理相结合，以明确地模拟扩散引起的扭曲并恢复潜在的空间基因表达景观。跨不同数据集和评估指标的综合基准测试证明了 DiffGSP 恢复空间基因表达模式的一致能力。通过计算逆转扩散引起的扭曲，DiffGSP 能够发现小鼠大脑中的精细解剖结构、肾脏中的空间组织基因模块、结直肠癌中的瘤内异质性以及肺腺癌中的三级淋巴结构。 DiffGSP 建立在物理可解释的框架之上，广泛适用于基于测序的空间转录组学技术，提高了空间基因表达重建的保真度，并实现更可靠的生物学解释。

details.abstractOriginal: Spatial transcriptomics enables gene expression profiling within intact tissues while preserving spatial context, providing unprecedented insights into cellular organization and function. However, mRNA diffusion during tissue processing can cause transcripts originating from adjacent cells to be captured at a given spot. This spatial misalignment challenges a fundamental premise of spatial transcriptomics that measured gene expression faithfully corresponds to its spatial origin, thereby compromising spatial fidelity and potentially biasing biological interpretation. Here, we present DiffGSP, a physics-informed framework that integrates Fick's law with graph signal processing to explicitly model diffusion-induced distortions and recover the underlying spatial gene expression landscape. Comprehensive benchmarking across diverse datasets and evaluation metrics demonstrates the consistent ability of DiffGSP to restore spatial gene expression patterns. By computationally reversing diffusion-induced distortions, DiffGSP enables the discovery of fine anatomical structures in the mouse brain, spatially organized gene modules in the kidney, intratumoral heterogeneity in colorectal cancer, and tertiary lymphoid structures in lung adenocarcinoma. Built on a physically interpretable framework and broadly applicable to sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics technologies, DiffGSP improves the fidelity of spatial gene expression reconstruction and enables more reliable biological interpretation.

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
细胞的身份取决于它在组织中的位置：例如，巨噬细胞在肿瘤核心与其边缘的行为不同。空间转录组学通过恢复丢失的坐标改变了我们研究这一问题的方式，但它是通过同时产生高维、多模态和不确定的数据来实现这一点的。可视化这种组合本身就是一个难题，需要评估该领域目前的表现方式、哪些有效，哪些仍然缺失。我们使用基于 Munzner 嵌套模型的 What-Why-How 编码框架调查了 148 篇论文和 1,824 个图形面板，连接了所表示的数据、激发每个可视化的生物任务以及表达它们的设计选择；调查工作的一部分还提供了专用的交互式可视化软件，这些软件不一定反映在静态图中，我们还研究了这些工具支持哪些交互功能。最后，我们概述了该领域的现状以及生物信息学和可视化研究人员需要共同应对的挑战。

details.abstractOriginal: A cell's identity depends on where it sits in tissue: for example, a macrophage behaves differently in a tumor core than at its edge. Spatial transcriptomics has transformed how we study this by recovering that lost coordinate, but it does so by producing data that is simultaneously high-dimensional, multimodal, and uncertain. Visualizing this combination is a hard problem in its own right, and one that warrants an assessment of how the field currently represents it, what has worked, and what is still missing. We surveyed 148 papers and 1,824 figure panels using a What-Why-How coding framework grounded in Munzner's nested model, connecting the data represented, the biological tasks motivating each visualization, and the design choices through which they are expressed; a subset of the surveyed work also contributed dedicated interactive visualization software that was not necessarily reflected in the static figures, and we looked at what interaction capabilities those tools supported as well. We close by outlining where the field stands and the challenges ahead for bioinformatics and visualization researchers to tackle together.

摘要中文翻译：
单细胞和空间图谱以高分辨率描述健康和患病的肝脏，包括小叶肝细胞分区、纤维化巨噬细胞星状生态位、胆管细胞反应、免疫重塑和肝细胞癌生态系统。这些图显示了细胞状态发生的位置，但它们本身并不能预测肝损伤是否会进展，或者肝脏将如何响应未经测试的药物、毒物或遗传扰动。在这篇综述中，我们将目前针对肝脏的人工智能虚拟细胞（AIVC）的方法分为三种互补的建模路线。生成模型表示细胞状态，动力学和运输模型推断状态转换，预训练或基础模型测试学习的表示是否跨供体、病因、疾病阶段和平台转移。扰动响应预测可作为跨领域评估，评估这些层是否可以预测对未经测试的遗传、化学、炎症或代谢干预措施的反应。现有证据可分为直接肝脏验证、肝脏基准、一般单细胞证据和概念应用。已发布的模型展示了各个组件，包括图谱集成、推断轨迹、可转移表示和回顾性响应程序。然而，这些模型并不构成前瞻性验证的肝脏模拟器。至少，评估应包括捐助者、病因、阶段、平台和扰动级别的保留。应使用响应方向、差异表达基因和稀有状态的恢复以及校准的不确定性来报告模型性能。关于组织或功能水平预测的主张还需要独立的空间、组织学、代谢和功能读数。近期使用应优先考虑实验选择和假设生成，而临床决策支持仍然是长期目标。

details.abstractOriginal: ``Single-cell and spatial atlases describe the healthy and diseased liver at high resolution, including lobular hepatocyte zonation, fibrotic macrophage-stellate niches, cholangiocyte reactions, immune remodeling, and hepatocellular carcinoma ecosystems. These maps show where cell states occur but do not, by themselves, predict whether liver injury will progress or how the liver will respond to an untested drug, toxicant, or genetic perturbation. In this review, we organize current approaches toward an AI Virtual Cell (AIVC) for the liver into three complementary modeling routes. Generative models represent cell states, dynamics and transport models infer state transitions, and pretrained or foundation models test whether learned representations transfer across donors, etiologies, disease stages, and platforms. Perturbation-response prediction serves as a cross-cutting assessment of whether these layers can predict responses to untested genetic, chemical, inflammatory, or metabolic interventions. Available evidence can be categorized as direct liver validation, liver-included benchmarks, general single-cell evidence, and conceptual applications. Published models demonstrate individual components, including atlas integration, inferred trajectories, transferable representations, and retrospective response programs. However, these models do not constitute a prospectively validated liver simulator. At minimum, evaluation should include donor-, etiology-, stage-, platform-, and perturbation-level hold-outs. Model performance should be reported using response direction, recovery of differentially expressed genes and rare states, and calibrated uncertainty. Claims about tissue- or function-level prediction additionally require independent spatial, histologic, metabolic, and functional readouts. Near-term use should prioritize experiment selection and hypothesis generation, whereas clinical decision support remains a longer-term objective.

items.title: Spatiotemporal single-cell profiling reveals T cell clonal dynamics and phenotypic plasticity in human graft-versus-host disease

verification.basis: 期刊原始页题名、DOI、09-17正式发表日、摘要及代码/数据可用性。

items.summary: 31名移植受者的纵向TCR、scRNA/TCR及空间转录组联合分析。 严重疾病与持续同种异体反应克隆、Hobit组织驻留程序及肠隐窝损伤区域相关；原文列GSE307215和官方复现仓库。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
同种异体造血细胞移植可以治愈血液系统疾病，但受到急性移植物抗宿主病的限制。人类 T 细胞克隆如何导致上皮损伤仍不清楚。我们研究了 31 名移植受者，将纵向 T 细胞抗原受体 (TCR) 分析与单细胞 RNA 测序/TCR 测序和空间转录组学相结合，以跟踪 T 细胞克隆动态。我们开发了 DecompTCR 来解决时间动态问题，并采用计算工具来绘制组织中的克隆表型和生态位。我们的分析表明，环磷酰胺选择性地耗尽同种反应性克隆，尽管早期扩增不足会导致不完全耗尽和严重疾病。严重的移植物抗宿主病的特点是同种异体反应性克隆的持续扩增、稳态细胞类型的重新布线以及供体来源的 CD8+ 克隆型的多样化，这些克隆型在迁移到上皮期间获得了 Hobit (ZNF683)+ 组织驻留记忆 T (TRM) 细胞程序。空间解卷积确定了靠近肠道干细胞丰富的隐窝基底和隐窝丢失区域的 CD8+ 效应器/Hobit+ TRM 中心。这种克隆型解析的框架将组织指导的 TRM 细胞重塑与局部上皮损伤联系起来，指定早期的动态和空间中枢负担作为生物标志物。

研究问题与设计：同种异体造血细胞移植可以治愈血液系统疾病，但受到急性移植物抗宿主病的限制。人类 T 细胞克隆如何导致上皮损伤仍不清楚。

方法与数据：31名移植受者的纵向TCR、scRNA/TCR及空间转录组联合分析。

结果及适用范围：严重疾病与持续同种异体反应克隆、Hobit组织驻留程序及肠隐窝损伤区域相关；原文列GSE307215和官方复现仓库。

details.abstractOriginal: Allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation cures hematologic diseases but is limited by acute graft‑versus‑host disease. How human T cell clones drive epithelial injury remains poorly mapped. We studied 31 transplant recipients, integrating longitudinal T cell antigen receptor (TCR) profiling with single-cell RNA sequencing/TCR sequencing and spatial transcriptomics to track T cell clonal dynamics. We developed DecompTCR to resolve temporal dynamics and adapted computational tools to map clone phenotypes and niches in tissue. Our analyses revealed that cyclophosphamide selectively depletes alloreactive clones, although insufficient early expansion leads to incomplete depletion and severe disease. Severe graft‑versus‑host disease is marked by persistent expansion of alloreactive clones, rewiring of homeostatic cell types and diversification of donor-derived CD8+ clonotypes that acquire Hobit (ZNF683)+ tissue‑resident memory T (TRM) cell programs during migration to epithelium. Spatial deconvolution identified CD8+ effector/Hobit+ TRM hubs near intestinal stem‑cell-rich crypt bases and crypt‑loss regions. This clonotype‑resolved framework links tissue‑instructed TRM cell remodeling to localized epithelial injury, nominating early-repertoire dynamics and spatial hub burden as biomarkers.

items.title: Dual-contrastive learning for spatial domain identification in spatial transcriptomics with STAMGC

items.summary: 图卷积网络结合高斯平滑及区域、拓扑对比目标，降低噪声同时提取局部细节。 作者在多个数据集报告更好的空间域指标，展示小鼠脑细结构及乳癌应用。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
空间转录组学（ST）已成为了解生物体生长和发育的重要方法。尽管最近出现了大量 ST 模型，但由于在保留局部细节和减少噪声之间进行权衡，准确识别空间域仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们介绍 STAMGC，它是一个基于图卷积网络构建的双对比学习框架。该模型利用区域和拓扑对比学习联合优化模型，有效降低空间域识别中的噪声，增强细节特征的提取。在这项研究中，引入最初在图像处理领域开发的高斯平滑来处理ST数据，通过减轻基因表达信号的空间不连续性为区域级对比学习提供基础。实验结果表明，根据综合评估，STAAMGC 在多个数据集上优于现有方法。此外，STAAMGC不仅鉴定出小鼠大脑中更精细的结构，还为人类乳腺癌研究带来了新发现。

details.abstractOriginal: Spatial transcriptomics (STs) have become a valuable approach for understanding the growth and development of organisms. Despite the recent emergence of numerous ST models, accurately identifying spatial domains remains challenging owing to the trade-off between preserving local details and reducing noise. Here, we introduce STAMGC, which is a dual-contrastive learning framework built upon graph convolutional networks. This model leverages regional and topological contrastive learning to jointly optimize the model, effectively reducing the noise in spatial domain identification and enhancing the extraction of detailed features. In this study, Gaussian smoothing, originally developed in the image processing field, is introduced to process ST data, providing a foundation for region-level contrastive learning by mitigating spatial discontinuities of gene expression signals. Experimental results indicate that STAMGC outperforms existing methods across multiple data sets according to comprehensive evaluations. Furthermore, STAMGC not only identifies finer structures in the mouse brain but also brings new discoveries for human breast cancer research.

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
空间转录组学（ST）的快速发展使得能够同时获取基因表达和空间位置，为探索组织组织提供了新途径。然而，有效整合空间和转录信息以进行空间域识别在现有方法中仍然具有挑战性。具体来说，大多数现有方法使用单个空间相似性度量构建图，从而使结果对度量选择敏感。即使从空间和表达视图构建对偶图的方法也常常无法系统地解开共享和查看特定信息，这限制了它们在复杂生物环境中的鲁棒性。为此，提出了一种新颖的共享特定多视图图卷积网络（SSMGCN）。 SSMGCN 首先构建空间和基因表达图。随后，为了充分利用两类图之间的共享和特定信息，提出了一种基于图卷积网络的共享特定信息解耦自动编码器框架。在这个框架中，我们首先采用共享编码器和视图特定编码器来捕获跨视图的共同和独特的知识。在解码阶段，将零膨胀负二项式（ZINB）解码器应用于表达数据以模拟零膨胀和过度离散，同时将两个结构解码器分配给空间图和表达图以同时重建它们在潜在空间中的邻接关系，从而保持局部拓扑连续性和远程功能连接性。最后，在嵌入空间中采用基于学生t分布的聚类，利用软分配和基于KL散度的自训练来增强簇内紧凑性和簇间分离，从而产生空间域划分的判别表示。对不同 ST 数据集的大量实验表明，SSMGCN 在空间域识别方面始终优于现有方法。此外，其统一嵌入支持细胞类型注释、空间定位和功能分析等下游任务，为机制探索提供了坚实的基础。本研究的代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/ddddoreen/SSMGCN 获取。

details.abstractOriginal: The rapid development of Spatial Transcriptomics (ST) enables simultaneous acquisition of gene expression and spatial locations, offering new avenues to explore tissue organization. However, effectively integrating spatial and transcriptional information for spatial domain identification remains challenging in existing methods. Specifically, most existing methods construct graphs using a single spatial similarity metric, making results sensitive to metric choice. Even methods that build dual graphs from spatial and expression views often fail to disentangle shared and view specific information systematically, which limits their robustness in complex biological contexts. To this end, a novel Shared-Specific Multi-view Graph Convolutional Network (SSMGCN) is proposed. SSMGCN first constructs spatial and gene-expression graphs. Subsequently, to fully exploit the shared and specific information between the two types of graphs, a shared-specific information decoupling autoencoder framework is proposed based on the graph convolutional network. In this framework, we first employ a shared encoder and view specific encoders to capture common and unique knowledge across views. In the decoding phase, a zero-inflated negative binomial (ZINB) decoder is applied to the expression data to model zero inflation and over-dispersion, while two structure decoders are assigned to the spatial and expression graphs to simultaneously reconstruct their adjacency relationships in the latent space, thereby preserving local topological continuity and long-range functional connectivity. Finally, a Student's t-distribution-based clustering is adopted in the embedding space, which leverages soft assignments and KL divergence-based self-training to enhance intra-cluster compactness and inter-cluster separation, thereby yielding discriminative representations for spatial domain partition. Extensive experiments on diverse ST datasets demonstrate that SSMGCN consistently outperforms existing methods in spatial domain identification. Moreover, its unified embedding supports downstream tasks such as cell-type annotation, spatial localization, and functional analysis, providing a robust foundation for mechanistic exploration. The code and dataset of this study are available at https://github.com/ddddoreen/SSMGCN.

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
我们研究了从高维不成对样本中恢复正向和反向二次最优传输图。我们引入了一个双向神经框架，其中学习的映射引起前向和后向位移插值，而训练目标结合了双向二次动作、判别器限制的 Jensen-Shannon 端点目标和两侧循环一致性。该构造既不需要预先计算的样本配对，也不需要显式的凸势参数化。对于紧凸集上支持的绝对连续概率测度，在规定的生成器逼近、判别器丰富度和最小化器达到条件下，我们证明了一个总体恢复定理：对于每个规定的精度，任何全局最小化器与正向和反向二次布雷尼尔图之间相应的 \(L^2\) 误差之和低于该精度，只要判别器水平足够大并且退火动作权重变得足够小。此外，循环损失的上限为 \(\lambda W_2^2(\mu_0,\mu_1)\)。补充结果量化了近似可逆性，并表明精确的端点 Jensen-Shannon 散度和循环一致性分别控制了缺失的目标质量和多对一图崩溃。对瑞士卷、MNIST、CelebA、单细胞扰动数据和胸部 X 射线图像进行的实验评估了端点保真度、传输成本、逆一致性和诱导插值的几何形状。

details.abstractOriginal: We study the recovery of forward and reverse quadratic optimal-transport maps from unpaired samples in high dimensions. We introduce a bidirectional neural framework in which the learned maps induce forward and backward displacement interpolants, while the training objective combines bidirectional quadratic action, discriminator-restricted Jensen-Shannon endpoint objectives, and two-sided cycle consistency. The construction requires neither precomputed sample pairings nor an explicit convex-potential parameterization. For absolutely continuous probability measures supported on a compact convex set, and under the stated generator-approximation, discriminator-richness, and minimizer-attainment conditions, we prove a population recovery theorem: for every prescribed accuracy, the sum of the corresponding \(L^2\) errors between any global minimizer and the forward and reverse quadratic Brenier maps is below that accuracy, provided the discriminator level is sufficiently large and the annealing action weight becomes sufficiently small. Moreover, the cycle loss is bounded above by \(\lambda W_2^2(\mu_0,\mu_1)\). Complementary results quantify approximate invertibility and show that exact endpoint Jensen-Shannon divergence and cycle consistency control missing target mass and many-to-one map collapse, respectively. Experiments on Swiss roll, MNIST, CelebA, single-cell perturbation data, and chest X-ray images evaluate endpoint fidelity, transport cost, inverse consistency, and the geometry of the induced interpolations.

details.abstractOriginal:
Learning the dynamics of a process given sampled observations at several time points is an important but difficult task in many scientific applications. When no ground-truth trajectories are available, but one has only snapshots of data taken at discrete time steps, the problem of modelling the dynamics, and thus inferring the underlying trajectories, can be solved by multi-marginal generalisations of flow matching algorithms. This paper proposes a novel flow matching method that overcomes the limitations of existing multi-marginal trajectory inference algorithms. Our proposed method, ALI-CFM, uses a GAN-inspired adversarial loss to fit neurally parametrised interpolant curves between source and target points such that the marginal distributions at intermediate time points are close to the observed distributions. The resulting interpolants are smooth trajectories that, as we show, are unique under mild assumptions. These interpolants are subsequently marginalised by a flow matching algorithm, yielding a trained vector field for the underlying dynamics. We showcase the versatility and scalability of our method by outperforming the existing baselines on spatial transcriptomics and cell tracking datasets, while performing on par with them on single-cell trajectory prediction.

items.title: Uncovering Cellular Resolution in scRNAseq via Unbiased Cell and Gene Network Analysis
items.updateType: 首次收录 v1（回溯补录）

items.summary: 在10x PBMC数据上集成十次GMGM-Leiden聚类，提取基因共表达模块并做NEAT富集检验。 作者报告稳定亚群与功能富集，并示范共享细胞网络及群体特异基因网络联合拟合。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 数据的传统注释在很大程度上依赖于手动、基于标记的阈值处理，这种方法可以掩盖微妙的转录组梯度，并将功能不同的细胞状态分解为广泛的异质群体。在这里，我们应用高斯多图形模型 (GmGM) 框架，该框架从单个 scRNA-seq 数据矩阵联合推断细胞-细胞和基因-基因依赖性结构到 10x Genomics PBMC 数据集。使用软集群集成方法将十个独立的 GMGM-Leiden 聚类运行集成到强大的一致性分区中，并针对参考细胞类型注释进行基准测试。该策略产生了稳定的簇分区，可以解析未通过参考注释区分的具有生物学意义的亚群。同时，对于每个簇，通过跨分辨率的共识莱顿聚类从拟合模型中提取基因共表达模块，使用标准网络指标进行评估，并使用网络富集分析测试（NEAT）进行功能验证，从而确认了非随机富集信号。在 CD4+ T 细胞群的案例研究中，展示了将网络拓扑与每个细胞、每个簇表达特征联系起来的模块评分程序，以及 GmGM 的新扩展，在单个模型运行中恢复共享的细胞-细胞网络以及群体特异性基因网络。这些结果表明，GmGM 为联合细胞聚类和基因网络推理提供了一个统一的、可重复的框架，能够揭示传统分析流程捕获之外的细胞结构。

details.abstractOriginal: Conventional annotation of single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) data relies heavily on manual, marker-based thresholding, an approach that can obscure subtle transcriptomic gradients and collapse functionally distinct cell states into broad, heterogeneous populations. Here we apply the Gaussian multi-Graphical Model (GmGM) framework, which jointly infers cell-cell and gene-gene dependency structure from a single scRNA-seq data matrix, to a 10x Genomics PBMC dataset. Ten independent GMGM-Leiden clustering runs were integrated into a robust consensus partition using a soft cluster ensemble approach and benchmarked against reference cell-type annotations. This strategy yielded stable cluster partitions that resolve biologically meaningful sub-populations not distinguished by the reference annotation. In parallel, for each cluster, gene co-expression modules were extracted from the fitted model via consensus Leiden clustering across resolutions, evaluated using standard network metrics, and validated functionally with the Network Enrichment Analysis Test (NEAT), which confirmed non-random enrichment signal. A module-scoring procedure linked network topology to per-cell, per-cluster expression signatures, and a novel extension of GmGM, recovering a shared cell-cell network together with population-specific gene networks in a single model run, was demonstrated in a case study on the CD4+ T-cell population. These results indicate that GmGM provides a unified, reproducible framework for joint cell clustering and gene-network inference, capable of revealing cellular structure beyond that captured by conventional pipelines.

details.abstractOriginal: The detection of rare disease-associated cell subsets from high-dimensional single-cell measurements is critical for understanding diseases such as leukaemia and viral infections. CellCnn, a convolutional neural network (CNN) designed for this task, has demonstrated the ability to identify phenotype-associated cell populations at frequencies as low as 0.01\%. Training such models reliably requires patient cohorts that are larger and more diverse than any single institution can typically assemble, and the underlying single-cell data is too sensitive to share across institutional boundaries under existing privacy regulations. We propose a secure multi-party computation (MPC) framework that enables the training and inference of CellCnn entirely on secret-shared data. This ensures that neither the participants nor the computing servers ever observe raw patient data or intermediate values. Evaluated on benchmark single-cell datasets for cytomegalovirus infection (CMV) and acute myeloid leukaemia (AML), our implementation preserves accuracy close to its plaintext counterpart while outperforming the prior privacy-preserving baseline. In contrast to earlier privacy-preserving approaches that removed components such as ReLU activations and bias terms, our method retains these key parts of the CellCnn architecture and supports accurate analysis without exposing raw patient data.

摘要中文翻译：
生物信息学工作流程严重依赖视觉表示。质量控制图、细胞嵌入、热图、基因组浏览器轨迹和交互式仪表板不仅仅是插图，而且是做出分析决策的工具。对于使用屏幕阅读器、盲文显示器或基于音频的界面的盲人和低视力研究人员来说，这些造成了障碍：用于证明分析合理性的证据通常以视觉形式编码，而基本决策仍然没有记录。我们认为，非视觉可访问性和计算可重复性密切相关，因为它们都要求分析透明并记录做出决策的原因。我们提出了非视觉生物信息学的十个简单规则，涵盖作为决策记录的图、谨慎使用人工智能生成的图形描述、可访问的计算环境、文本优先的识字编程、结构化数据和元数据、紧凑的对象摘要、可访问的出版格式、协作实践、共享社区基础设施以及作为 FAIR 研究一部分的可访问性。目标受众是计算生物学家和开发人员。使用单细胞 RNA-seq 作为运行示例，我们表明绘图的可访问等效项是结构化决策记录。也就是说，一个情节伴侣不仅可以存储基础数据，还可以说明分析的目的以及由此产生的定量证据和不确定性。我们认为，以这种方式处理可访问性使得生物信息学更具包容性，也更加透明和可审计。

details.abstractOriginal:
Bioinformatics workflows rely heavily on visual representations. Quality-control plots, cell embeddings, heatmaps, genome-browser tracks, and interactive dashboards are not merely illustrations, but instruments for making analytical decisions. For blind and low-vision researchers who use screen readers, braille displays, or audio-based interfaces, these create a barrier: the evidence used to justify an analysis is often encoded in visual form, while the underlying decision remains undocumented.
 We argue that non-visual accessibility and computational reproducibility are closely aligned, as they both require analyses to be transparent and to record why decisions were made. We present ten simple rules for non-visual bioinformatics, covering plots as decision records, cautious use of AI-generated figure descriptions, accessible computing environments, text-first literate programming, structured data and metadata, compact object summaries, accessible publication formats, collaboration practices, shared community infrastructure, and accessibility as part of FAIR research. The intended audience is computational biologists and developers.
 Using single-cell RNA-seq as a running example, we show that the accessible equivalent of a plot is a structured decision record. That is, a plot companion that goes beyond storing the underlying data by also stating the purpose of the analysis and the resulting quantitative evidence and uncertainty. We argue that treating accessibility in this way makes bioinformatics more inclusive and also more transparent and auditable.

details.abstractOriginal: Motivation: Low-dimensional embeddings are widely used to explore cell-state heterogeneity in single-cell and other high-dimensional biological data. Although many methods preserve local neighborhoods, they may distort the apparent sampling density of processed observations, altering the visual contrast between dense and sparse regions and complicating the interpretation of rare, transitional, or continuous cell-state populations. Results: We present DMT-Dens, a parametric manifold-visualization method built on a latent-token Transformer encoder. The model integrates rank-based manifold alignment with hard-pair aggregation. To preserve density, it optimizes a loss based on the Pearson correlation between k-nearest-neighbor log-radius estimates in the processed input and two-dimensional embedding spaces. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate strong density preservation, particularly on biological datasets, while retaining competitive label separability. Availability: Source code, data-processing scripts, and resolved experiment configurations are available at  this https URL .

items.title: spaGFM is a scalable graph foundation model for spatial transcriptomics analyses
items.summary: 以随机游走将细胞图邻域转为 Transformer 输入，用增强的自监督邻域重建替代传统图消息传递；预训练数据为132个成像空间转录组数据集的4390万细胞。 作者报告表征可迁移至组织、疾病和空间技术；在癌症队列识别三级淋巴结构，在空间 CRISPR 实验刻画与 T 细胞邻近相关的转录反应。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
摘要 基础模型为空间转录组学建模提供了一种有前途的范例，但通过细胞图捕获组织背景使得大规模训练具有挑战性。我们引入了 spaGFM，这是一种图形基础模型，它通过随机游走序列化细胞邻域，以生成组织组织的Transformer兼容表示。通过用增强的自监督邻域重建替换经典的图形消息传递，spaGFM 捕获高阶空间上下文，同时允许在图谱级别进行缩放。 spaGFM 对来自 132 个基于图像的空间转录组数据集的 4390 万个细胞进行了预训练，在邻域和细胞水平上产生了强大的表示，可以跨组织、疾病背景和空间技术传输。 SpaGFM 可识别癌症群体和空间平台中的三级淋巴结构，捕获空间 CRISPR 实验中与 T 细胞附近相关的细胞水平转录组扰动反应，并表征与糖尿病肾病活检中病理分级相关的肾小球组织。总体而言，spaGFM 建立了一个图形基础模型框架，用于学习细胞组织及其功能后果。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：摘要 基础模型为空间转录组学建模提供了一种有前途的范例，但通过细胞图捕获组织背景使得大规模训练具有挑战性。我们引入了 spaGFM，这是一种图形基础模型，它通过随机游走序列化细胞邻域，以生成组织组织的Transformer兼容表示。

方法与数据：以随机游走将细胞图邻域转为 Transformer 输入，用增强的自监督邻域重建替代传统图消息传递；预训练数据为132个成像空间转录组数据集的4390万细胞。

结果及适用范围：作者报告表征可迁移至组织、疾病和空间技术；在癌症队列识别三级淋巴结构，在空间 CRISPR 实验刻画与 T 细胞邻近相关的转录反应。
details.findings: 结果解读：作者报告表征可迁移至组织、疾病和空间技术；在癌症队列识别三级淋巴结构，在空间 CRISPR 实验刻画与 T 细胞邻近相关的转录反应。
details.limitations:
预印本；摘要未提供独立留出、计算成本和逐任务效应量，空间关联不等同于扰动因果效应。
简报证据边界：本次补充依据原始摘要；原文未报告的输入输出细节、完整基线、切分和训练设置均未补造。摘要译文采用机器辅助翻译并作术语、数值和身份检查；未逐篇全文精读。原有局限为简报分析，不能一概视为作者自述。
details.abstractOriginal: Abstract    Foundation models offer a promising paradigm for modeling spatial transcriptomics, but capturing tissue context over cellular graphs makes training at scale challenging. We introduce spaGFM, a graph foundation model that serializes cellular neighborhoods through random walks to generate transformer-compatible representations of tissue organization. By replacing classical graph message passing with augmented self-supervised neighborhood reconstruction, spaGFM captures higher-order spatial context while allowing scaling at the atlas level. Pretrained on 43.9 million cells from 132 image-based spatial transcriptomics datasets, spaGFM produces robust representations at both the neighborhood and cell level that transfer across tissues, disease contexts, and spatial technologies. SpaGFM identifies tertiary lymphoid structures across cancer cohorts and spatial platforms, captures cell-level transcriptomic perturbation responses associated with T cell vicinity in spatial CRISPR experiments, and characterizes glomerular organization associated with pathological grade in diabetic kidney disease biopsies. Overall, spaGFM establishes a graph foundation-model framework for learning cellular organization and its functional consequences.

items.title: AI Scientists for Building Virtual-Cell Models
items.summary: 让数据建模、单细胞生物学和深度学习专长智能体经批评讨论形成模型假设，再自动编写训练代码、运行实验；涵盖6个转录组、表观组和蛋白组扰动数据集及配对多组学读出。 作者报告在既定任务中与手工设计的先进方法有竞争力，且盲评者对其研究计划的科学性与创新性评分高于单一 LLM 或深度研究系统。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
摘要：从虚拟实验室到生物数据分析代理和联合科学家，自主代理已经开始将科学目标转化为假设。他们是否可以更进一步，将真实、嘈杂和复杂的生物数据转换为可执行的模型假设和编码可测试假设的架构，目前尚不清楚。预测细胞如何响应遗传和化学扰动（即模拟虚拟细胞）是对这种能力的自然测试：它对于解码疾病机制和治疗发现至关重要，但它需要跨学科的专业知识，而很少集中在单个研究小组中。在这里，我们介绍 CellForge，这是一个有组织的自主代理团队，用于单细胞扰动建模。给定数据集和任务，它会调查文献、解析数据、识别相关基线，并通过专门从事数据建模、单细胞生物学和深度学习的代理之间的评论家介导的讨论来制定模型假设。然后，它编写训练代码，运行实验，并返回经过训练的预测器，包括架构、代码和验证结果。架构本身就是假设：CellForge 端到端地生成它，没有人指定设计、损失或训练协议。在涵盖转录组、表观基因组和蛋白质组背景的六个扰动数据集中，CellForge 生成的模型可与已建立任务上手工制作的最先进结果相媲美，并将相同的工作流程扩展到配对的多组学读数。盲人评估者认为 CellForge 的研究计划比单一法学硕士或深度研究系统的研究计划更科学合理、更具创新性。总之，我们证明自主代理可以完成单细胞生物学中从假设到验证的完整周期，在目前需要人类专家团队的复杂环境中，一个人工智能有效地构建另一个人工智能。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：摘要：从虚拟实验室到生物数据分析代理和联合科学家，自主代理已经开始将科学目标转化为假设。他们是否可以更进一步，将真实、嘈杂和复杂的生物数据转换为可执行的模型假设和编码可测试假设的架构，目前尚不清楚。

方法与数据：让数据建模、单细胞生物学和深度学习专长智能体经批评讨论形成模型假设，再自动编写训练代码、运行实验；涵盖6个转录组、表观组和蛋白组扰动数据集及配对多组学读出。

结果及适用范围：作者报告在既定任务中与手工设计的先进方法有竞争力，且盲评者对其研究计划的科学性与创新性评分高于单一 LLM 或深度研究系统。
details.findings: 结果解读：作者报告在既定任务中与手工设计的先进方法有竞争力，且盲评者对其研究计划的科学性与创新性评分高于单一 LLM 或深度研究系统。

预印本；“有竞争力”未在摘要给出完整基线数值和资源成本，自动生成架构仍需独立复现及防止评测泄漏。
简报证据边界：本次补充依据原始摘要；原文未报告的输入输出细节、完整基线、切分和训练设置均未补造。摘要译文采用机器辅助翻译并作术语、数值和身份检查；未逐篇全文精读。原有局限为简报分析，不能一概视为作者自述。
details.abstractOriginal: Abstract    Autonomous agents, from virtual laboratories to biological data-analysis agents and co-scientists, have begun to turn scientific goals into hypotheses. Whether they can go further and convert real, noisy and complex biological data into executable model hypotheses and architectures that encode testable assumptions remains unclear. Predicting how cells respond to genetic and chemical perturbations (i.e., modeling virtual cells) is a natural test of this ability: it is central to decoding disease mechanisms and therapeutic discovery, yet it demands cross-disciplinary expertise rarely concentrated in a single research group. Here, we introduce CellForge, an organized team of autonomous agents for single-cell perturbation modeling. Given a dataset and a task, it surveys the literature, parses the data, identifies relevant baselines, and formulates a model hypothesis through critic-mediated discussion among agents specialized in data modeling, single-cell biology, and deep learning. It then writes the training code, runs the experiments, and returns a trained predictor including architecture, code, and validation results. The architecture itself is the hypothesis: CellForge produces it end-to-end, with no human specifying the design, loss, or training protocol. Across six perturbation datasets spanning transcriptomic, epigenomic, and proteomic contexts, CellForge yields models that are competitive with hand-crafted state-of-the-art results on established tasks and extends the same workflow to paired multiomic readouts. Blinded human evaluators rate CellForge’s research plans as more scientifically sound and innovative than those from single LLMs or deep-research systems. In summary, we show autonomous agents can complete the full hypothesis-to-validation cycle in single-cell biology, with an AI effectively building another AI, in a complex setting that currently requires a team of human experts.

items.title: Pretrained gene representations transfer mean expression more broadly than spatial patterns in virtual spatial transcriptomics
items.summary: 在四个队列、三个脑区及 HER2 阳性乳腺癌中，对 Decima 或 scGPT 固定基因表征的留出基因、留出个体预测分解均值与空间成分。 作者报告相较随机向量，超过91%的均方误差降幅来自基因均值误差；不使用图像的均值模型仍保留全矩阵相关性增益的90–99%，空间增益较小且依赖队列和训练组织变异。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
虚拟空间转录组学模型将组织图像与预先训练的基因表示相结合，以预测未见的基因的表达，但这些表示的贡献尚不清楚。我们使用跨越三个人类大脑区域和 HER2 阳性乳腺癌的四个队列中的保留基因和个体，将它们的影响分为整体基因均值和空间变异。利用源自调控 DNA 序列的固定表示和在单细胞转录组上预训练的表示，基因平均误差的减少占匹配随机向量总均方误差减少的 91-96%。使用没有图像的基因表示的纯均值模型保留了 82-99% 的相应全矩阵相关增益。空间增益较小，随着训练组织中表达变化的增加而增加，并且随着队列和表征的不同而变化。因此，预训练的基因表示广泛地转移平均表达，但仅选择性地支持空间恢复，这表明仅基因组扩展并不能为新目标建立空间恢复。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：虚拟空间转录组学模型将组织图像与预先训练的基因表示相结合，以预测未见的基因的表达，但这些表示的贡献尚不清楚。我们使用跨越三个人类大脑区域和 HER2 阳性乳腺癌的四个队列中的保留基因和个体，将它们的影响分为整体基因均值和空间变异。

方法与数据：在四个队列、三个脑区及 HER2 阳性乳腺癌中，对 Decima 或 scGPT 固定基因表征的留出基因、留出个体预测分解均值与空间成分。

结果及适用范围：作者报告相较随机向量，超过91%的均方误差降幅来自基因均值误差；不使用图像的均值模型仍保留全矩阵相关性增益的90–99%，空间增益较小且依赖队列和训练组织变异。

details.abstractOriginal: Virtual spatial transcriptomics models combine tissue images with pretrained gene representations to predict expression for unseen genes, but what these representations contribute is unclear. We separated their effects into overall gene-mean and spatial variation using held-out genes and individuals across four cohorts spanning three human brain regions and HER2-positive breast cancer. With fixed representations derived from regulatory DNA sequences and representations pretrained on single-cell transcriptomes, reductions in gene-mean error accounted for 91-96% of the total mean squared error reductions over matched random vectors. Mean-only models using gene representations without images retained 82-99% of the corresponding full-matrix correlation gain. Spatial gains were smaller, increased with expression variation in training tissue, and varied across cohorts and representations. Thus, pretrained gene representations broadly transfer mean expression but only selectively support spatial recovery, showing that gene-panel extension alone does not establish spatial recovery for new targets.

items.title: Regulatory-prior-guided attention preserves biological structure during unpaired single-cell RNA-ATAC integration.
items.summary: RNA 与 ATAC 模态特异编码器结合由调控连接约束的跨模态 Transformer，并使用域对抗目标；在 PBMC3k、小鼠脾脏、CITE-seq/ASAP-seq PBMC 与 PBMC10k 比较。 作者报告改善聚类一致性、标签迁移和结构保持；在部分重叠或条件偏移时保留未匹配状态，并从注意力链接恢复调控关系与转录因子程序。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
动机单细胞 RNA 测序和单细胞 ATAC 测序提供了转录输出和染色质调控潜力的互补视图，但整合未配对的图谱仍然具有挑战性，因为这些模式在特征空间、稀疏性和噪声方面存在差异。现有方法通常将整合构建为分布匹配，这可能会过度对齐生物学上不同的、条件特异性或模态特异性的细胞状态。我们提出了 scHPGT，一种单细胞异质先验引导转化器，用于未配对 RNA 和染色质可及性特征的先验引导整合。 scHPGT 使用特定于模态的编码器来对 RNA 和 ATAC 信号进行建模，使用预先引导的跨模态 Transformer 使用调节链接来限制基因峰值注意力，并使用域对抗目标来减少共享潜在空间中特定于模态的差异。结果 在 PBMC3k、小鼠脾脏、CITE-seq/ASAP-seq PBMC 和 PBMC10k 基准中，scHPGT 改善了聚类一致性、标签转移和生物结构保存，同时保持有效的模态比对。在部分重叠和条件转移设置中，scHPGT 可以对齐共享群体，而不会强制不匹配或特定条件的状态进入不适当的对应关系。注意力衍生的链接恢复调节关系，突出标记基因调节区域，恢复转录因子程序并产生与细胞类型特异性转录程序一致的调节活性谱。可用性和实施​​代码和数据集发布于https://github.com/zlCreator/scHPGT。

研究问题与设计：动机单细胞 RNA 测序和单细胞 ATAC 测序提供了转录输出和染色质调控潜力的互补视图，但整合未配对的图谱仍然具有挑战性，因为这些模式在特征空间、稀疏性和噪声方面存在差异。现有方法通常将整合构建为分布匹配，这可能会过度对齐生物学上不同的、条件特异性或模态特异性的细胞状态。

方法与数据：RNA 与 ATAC 模态特异编码器结合由调控连接约束的跨模态 Transformer，并使用域对抗目标；在 PBMC3k、小鼠脾脏、CITE-seq/ASAP-seq PBMC 与 PBMC10k 比较。

结果及适用范围：作者报告改善聚类一致性、标签迁移和结构保持；在部分重叠或条件偏移时保留未匹配状态，并从注意力链接恢复调控关系与转录因子程序。

details.abstractOriginal: Motivation Single-cell RNA sequencing and single-cell ATAC sequencing provide complementary views of transcriptional output and chromatin regulatory potential, but integrating unpaired profiles remains challenging because the modalities differ in feature space, sparsity and noise. Existing approaches often frame integration as distribution matching, which can over-align biologically distinct, condition-specific or modality-specific cell states. We present scHPGT, a single-cell Heterogeneous Prior-Guided Transformer for regulatory-prior-guided integration of unpaired RNA and chromatin accessibility profiles. scHPGT uses modality-specific encoders to model RNA and ATAC signals, a prior-guided cross-modal Transformer to constrain gene-peak attention using regulatory links, and a domain-adversarial objective to reduce modality-specific discrepancies in a shared latent space. Results Across PBMC3k, mouse spleen, CITE-seq/ASAP-seq PBMC and PBMC10k benchmarks, scHPGT improves clustering agreement, label transfer and biological structure preservation while maintaining effective modality alignment. In partial-overlap and condition-shift settings, scHPGT aligns shared populations without forcing unmatched or condition-specific states into inappropriate correspondence. Attention-derived links recover regulatory relationships, highlight marker-gene regulatory regions, recover transcription factor programs and produce regulatory activity profiles consistent with cell-type-specific transcriptional programs. Availability and implementation Code and datasets are released at https://github.com/zlCreator/scHPGT.

items.title: Single-Cell Study Designs Are Systematically Underpowered for Small-Effect Genes
items.summary: 基于1,494名供者、三类脑细胞中的性别差异表达，比较不同供者数、测序深度与细胞数的实验设置，并拟合经验预测模型。 作者报告即使达到600名供者，小效应差异表达仍缺乏足够检出力；将星形胶质细胞数据降至小胶质细胞较差的测序特征后，完整数据中超过一半的差异表达基因未被检出；显著基因仅前四分位具有可复现性。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
单细胞差异表达分析使生物学家能够得出关于特定细胞类型中哪些基因在两种条件（例如患有或不患有疾病）之间上调或下调的统计结论。然而，由于生物和技术噪音，这些差异很难可靠地检测到。确定实验是否具有足够的功效通常是从模拟或小型试点样本（如果有的话）中得出的。在这里，我们使用 1,494 名捐赠者三种脑细胞类型的性别差异表达，为各种实验设置得出基于经验的功效估计。我们的工作表明，即使在包含 600 名捐赠者的实验中，我们也严重缺乏可靠检测许多研究报告范围内的微小影响的能力。当将星形胶质细胞数据减少到小胶质细胞的较差测序特征时，全套中检测到的差异表达基因（DEG）一半以上丢失，凸显了测序深度和细胞计数不足造成的损害。尽管通过多重测试校正调整 p 值的标准阈值，但只有显着基因的前四分之一是可重复的。此外，从将预测模型拟合到实证结果中，我们发现细胞计数和基因表达水平是功效的重要决定因素。因此，我们提倡未来的研究采用细胞类型富集和更深入的测序，特别是对于像小胶质细胞这样的稀有群体，强调在寻求可靠的发现时支持此类实验的重要性，并为未来的发现提出更严格的显着性阈值。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：单细胞差异表达分析使生物学家能够得出关于特定细胞类型中哪些基因在两种条件（例如患有或不患有疾病）之间上调或下调的统计结论。然而，由于生物和技术噪音，这些差异很难可靠地检测到。

方法与数据：基于1,494名供者、三类脑细胞中的性别差异表达，比较不同供者数、测序深度与细胞数的实验设置，并拟合经验预测模型。

结果及适用范围：作者报告即使达到600名供者，小效应差异表达仍缺乏足够检出力；将星形胶质细胞数据降至小胶质细胞较差的测序特征后，完整数据中超过一半的差异表达基因未被检出；显著基因仅前四分位具有可复现性。

details.abstractOriginal: Single cell differential expression analysis enables biologists to make statistical conclusions about which genes are up or downregulated in a particular cell type, between two conditions, such as those with or without a disease. However, due to biological and technical noise, these differences are hard to detect reliably. Determining if an experiment has sufficient power is often derived from simulations or small pilot samples, if done at all. Here, we use sex-biased differential expression on 1,494 donors in three brain cell types to derive empirically grounded power estimates for a variety of experimental setups. Our work reveals a substantial lack of power for reliably detecting the small effects in the range that many studies report, even in experiments containing 600 donors. When reducing the astrocyte data to the poor sequencing characteristics of microglia, over half the differentially expressed genes (DEGs) detected in the full set were lost, highlighting the damage caused by insufficient sequencing depth and cell counts. Despite standard thresholds of adjusted p-value with multiple testing correction, only the top quartile of significant genes were reproducible. Furthermore, from fitting a predictive model to the empirical outcomes, we find cell count and expression levels of genes to be a strong determinant of power. As such, we advocate for future studies to employ cell type enrichment and deeper sequencing, especially for rarer populations like microglia, emphasise the importance of powering experiments of this type when seeking robust findings, and suggest stricter significance thresholds for future discoveries.

items.title: A single-cell RNA-seq catalog of ground truth gene coregulation
items.summary: 整理启动子报告系统与B细胞轻链互斥数据，分别构成正、负共调控参考，比较七种归一化。 不同归一化对正负共调控表现不同；作者提供Hugging Face数据集。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
单细胞 RNA 测序测量非常适合识别共同调控的基因转录。共调节应该是明显的表达水平的相关性，但在哪个单位量化表达以计算相关性尚不清楚。为了能够评估用于识别共调节的标准化方法，我们整理并预处理了 35 个具有已知调节关系的 scRNA-seq 样本，并将其放入目录中。这些数据集包含代表已知正向共调节的启动子-报告基因数据和 B 细胞，其中 {kappa} 和 {lambda} 轻链的同种型互斥代表已知负向共调节。作为示例，我们使用目录来评估七种标准化方法。不同的归一化方法对于正向或负向核心调节表现更好，结果表明高级归一化方法的实现选择该目录可以作为评估新提出的归一化方法的资源，可在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/valsv/scrna-coregulation-benchmark 获取

details.abstractOriginal: Single-cell RNA-sequencing measurements are uniquely well-poised to identify coregulated gene transcription. Coregulation should be apparent as correlation of expression levels, but at which unit to quantify expression for calculation of correlations is not clear. To enable evaluation of normalization methods for identification of coregulation we have curated and preprocessed 35 scRNA-seq samples with known regulature relationships into a catalog. These datasets contain promoter-reporter data representing known positive coregulation and B cells where isotypic mutual exclusion of {kappa} and {lambda} light chains represent known negative coregulation. As an example, we use the catalog to evaluate seven normalization methods. Different normalization methods perform better for positive or negative coregulation, and results indicate implementation choices for advanced normalization methods The catalog may serve as a resource for evaluating novel proposed normalization methods and is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/valsv/scrna-coregulation-benchmark

items.title: Gravlax: an annotation-independent molecular evidence archive for single-cell RNA-seq
items.summary: 存储分子几何、barcode和UMI关系，推迟依赖注释的决定；测试四个人10x 3端数据集。 作者报告比保留标签的CRAM小9.0–12.7倍，定量重放比匹配线程的STARsolo快34–82倍。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
逐个基因计数矩阵是单细胞 RNA 测序实验的产物，最常被存储、共享和重新分析。它是计算的输出，其输入是测序分子和基因注释，虽然分子永远不会改变，但注释会不断修改。一旦矩阵产生，其背后的证据就不能再被重新解释。恢复证据意味着返回大量的原始读数或比对，这些读数或比对数据量大、处理成本高且经常不可用。我们询问分子本身的简明表示是否可以一次提取并无限期地重复使用，以便在任何未来的注释下进行量化，查询和发现注释尚未描述的特征，以及跨细胞和样本汇集证据。我们最初的观察是，将比对转化为计数、基因分配和 UMI 的程序崩溃了，从未读取比对文件包含的大部分内容。它们消耗分子之间的关系，例如共享基因组几何、共享位置、条形码身份以及 UMI 的相等或接近相等。我们证明这些关系形成了足以满足此类消费者需求的统计数据，并且我们设计了一个紧凑的、可搜索的、经过内容验证的存档来存储它们，同时将每个依赖于注释的决策推迟到分析时间。档案组成内容寻址的集合，将队列查询路由到可以回答它们而无需复制分子的分子。我们在名为 gravlax 的工具中实现了这些想法。在四个人类 10×3' 数据集中，gravlax 档案每次读取需要 11-18 位，并且比保留标签的 CRAM 小 9.0-12.7 倍。 Count matrices replayed from an archive deviate from direct STARsolo quantification by 0.24-0.75% of normalized UMI mass, whereas changing GENCODE v32 to v49 moves 2.12-4.64%, and quantification replay is 34-82× faster than STARsolo at matched thread budgets.超过八个档案的联合索引占据其大小的 2.96%，回答 96 个查询的连接面板比单独档案快 2.59 倍，并在整个基因组范围内筛选队列中未注释的剪接事件，这些事件在短短 9 秒内在供体之间重复出现。由于分子被保留，档案也回答了矩阵丢弃的问题。对四个外周血档案的分析恢复了经过验证的 FYB1 免疫细胞剪接开关，适用于 3' 化学的交叉拟合片段模型揭示了 NTRK2 末端亚型使用从星形胶质细胞和神经干细胞群到成熟神经元的八个供体转变，并且在期望最大化算法的背景下汇集跨细胞的证据恢复了 75-98% 的保留多基因分子标签。 Gravlax 是开源的，用 Rust 实现，根据 BSD 3-clause 许可证获得许可，可在 https://github.com/COMBINE-lab/gravlax 上获取。

方法与数据：存储分子几何、barcode和UMI关系，推迟依赖注释的决定；测试四个人10x 3端数据集。

details.abstractOriginal: A cell-by-gene count matrix is the artifact of a single-cell RNA-seq experiment that is most often stored, shared, and reanalyzed. It is the output of a computation whose inputs are the sequenced molecules and a gene annotation, and while the molecules never change, the annotation is revised continually. Once the matrix has been produced, the evidence behind it can no longer be reinterpreted. Recovering that evidence means returning to raw reads or alignments that are large, costly to process, and frequently unavailable. We ask whether a concise representation of the molecules themselves can be extracted once and reused indefinitely, to quantify under any future annotation, to query and discover features that no annotation yet describes, and to pool evidence across cells and samples. Our starting observation is that the procedures that turn alignments into counts, gene assignment and UMI collapse, never read most of what an alignment file contains. They consume relations among molecules such as shared genomic geometry, shared placements, barcode identity, and the equality or near-equality of UMIs. We show that these relations form a statistic that is sufficient for such consumers, and we design a compact, seekable, content-authenticated archive that stores them while deferring every annotation-dependent decision to analysis time. Archives compose into content-addressed collections that route cohort queries to the molecules that can answer them without copying molecules. We implement these ideas in a tool called gravlax. Across four human 10× 3' datasets, gravlax archives require 11-18 bits per read and are 9.0-12.7× smaller than tag-preserving CRAM. Count matrices replayed from an archive deviate from direct STARsolo quantification by 0.24-0.75% of normalized UMI mass, whereas changing GENCODE v32 to v49 moves 2.12-4.64%, and quantification replay is 34-82× faster than STARsolo at matched thread budgets. A federated index over eight archives occupies 2.96% of their size, answers a 96-query junction panel 2.59× faster than the archives alone, and screens the cohort genome-wide for unannotated splice events that recur across donors in just 9 seconds. Because the molecules are retained, the archives also answer questions the matrix has discarded. An analysis of four peripheral-blood archives recovers a validated FYB1 immune-cell splicing switch, a cross-fitted fragment model appropriate for 3' chemistry reveals an eight-donor shift in NTRK2 terminal-isoform usage from astrocyte and neural-stem-cell populations to mature neurons, and pooling evidence across cells within the context of an expectation-maximization algorithm recovers 75-98% of withheld multi-gene molecule labels. Gravlax is open source, implemented in Rust, licensed under the BSD 3-clause license, and available at https://github.com/COMBINE-lab/gravlax.

items.title: RamanOmics decodes the spatial vibrational–molecular architecture of senescence in aging and repair
items.summary: 在年轻和老年小鼠肺与皮肤中整合拉曼、单核RNA和890基因STARmap，并研究伤口修复。 发现肺与皮肤不同衰老程序及共有脂质相关拉曼信号，构建多模态衰老识别条码。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
衰老和组织修复涉及跨转录、生化和细胞维度的异质重塑，但流行的定义依赖于孤立的分子标记，这些标记模糊了这些状态如何共同进化。在这里，我们提出了 RamanOmics，这是一个多模态框架，将无标记高光谱拉曼成像与单核 RNA 测序和空间转录组学相结合，以单细胞空间分辨率将生化状态与转录程序联系起来。拉曼组学应用于年轻和年老小鼠的肺和皮肤，揭示了组织特异性程序：肺衰老细胞富集用于细胞外基质重塑和转化生长因子-β信号传导，而皮肤衰老则由表皮分化基因（Krt10、Lor和Sbsn）主导。在整个组织中，我们鉴定了标记 p21+ 衰老细胞的保守脂质连接拉曼特征 (1,131-1,135 cm-1)，并开发了一种源自机器学习的多模式条形码，可实现原位无损衰老识别。在小鼠伤口愈合模型中，拉曼组学揭示了衰老细胞中表皮分化基因（Krt10、Lor 和 Sbsn）的重新激活，以及脂质相关拉曼特征的增加。拉曼组学共同为细胞状态的可扩展、多模式分析提供了一个与组织无关的框架。

方法与数据：在年轻和老年小鼠肺与皮肤中整合拉曼、单核RNA和890基因STARmap，并研究伤口修复。

结果及适用范围：发现肺与皮肤不同衰老程序及共有脂质相关拉曼信号，构建多模态衰老识别条码。

局限于所测小鼠组织；全转录组空间表达含插补值，不等于直接全基因测量。

details.abstractOriginal: Aging and tissue repair involve heterogeneous remodeling across transcriptional, biochemical and cellular dimensions, yet prevailing definitions rely on isolated molecular markers that obscure how these states co-evolve. Here we present RamanOmics, a multimodal framework integrating label-free hyperspectral Raman imaging with single-nucleus RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomics to link biochemical states with transcriptional programs at single-cell spatial resolution. Applied to young and old mouse lung and skin, RamanOmics reveals tissue-specific programs: lung senescent cells are enriched for extracellular matrix remodeling and transforming growth factor-β signaling, whereas skin senescence is dominated by epidermal differentiation genes (Krt10, Lor and Sbsn). Across tissues, we identified a conserved lipid-linked Raman signature (1,131-1,135 cm-1) marking p21+ senescent cells and developed a machine learning-derived, multimodal barcode enabling nondestructive senescence identification in situ. In a mouse wound-healing model, RamanOmics reveals reactivation of epidermal differentiation genes (Krt10, Lor and Sbsn) in senescent cells, alongside increased lipid-associated Raman signatures. Together, RamanOmics provides a tissue-agnostic framework for scalable, multimodal profiling of cellular states.

items.title: Rethinking Class Imbalance for Single-Cell Foundation Models: A Systematic Benchmark Across Architectures and Long-Tail Loss Functions
items.summary: scGPT、scBERT、Geneformer，三个数据集、六类损失及三个种子，共162次训练。 作者发现重加权收益与类别绝对训练量相关，class-balanced loss和LDAM较稳定。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
在我们的实验中，单细胞基础模型（scGPT、scBERT、Geneformer）实现了高达 97.5% 的细胞类型分类准确度，但这种总体准确度可能掩盖了罕见的、通常与疾病相关的细胞群的系统故障，而长尾损失函数被广泛认为可以解决这些问题。我们提出了跨三种架构和三个数据集（多发性硬化症、Zheng68K、人类胰腺）的六个长尾损失函数（交叉熵、加权CE、类平衡损失、焦点损失、LDAM、logit-调整的softmax）的系统基准，总共162次受控训练运行（3个主干x 3个数据集x 6个损失x 3个种子）。普通交叉熵下的整体准确度、Macro-F1 和稀有类召回之间的差距在所有九个（架构、数据集）设置中是一致的，由数据集结构而不是预训练驱动。稀有类故障本身分为两种具有不同嵌入几何特征的状态，在选择任何损失之前就可见：一些类可以通过正确的损失来恢复，而其他类则保留线性可分离性，但在每个评估的损失和架构下被吸收到不相关类的邻域中。在可恢复的类别中，重新加权的效果是通过类别的绝对训练集大小来预测的，而不是通过其在数据集中的份额或数据集的整体不平衡率来预测。类平衡损失和 LDAM 是所有九种设置中最一致的选择，而 logit 调整则用稀有类精度来换取召回率，而不是同时提高两者。我们的结果提供了可重复使用的基准和基于机制的实用指南，用于将基础模型与不平衡的生物数据相结合。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：在我们的实验中，单细胞基础模型（scGPT、scBERT、Geneformer）实现了高达 97.5% 的细胞类型分类准确度，但这种总体准确度可能掩盖了罕见的、通常与疾病相关的细胞群的系统故障，而长尾损失函数被广泛认为可以解决这些问题。我们提出了跨三种架构和三个数据集（多发性硬化症、Zheng68K、人类胰腺）的六个长尾损失函数（交叉熵、加权CE、类平衡损失、焦点损失、LDAM、logit-调整的softmax）的系统基准，总共162次受控训练运行（3个主干x 3个数据集x 6个损失x 3个种子）。

方法与数据：scGPT、scBERT、Geneformer，三个数据集、六类损失及三个种子，共162次训练。

结果及适用范围：作者发现重加权收益与类别绝对训练量相关，class-balanced loss和LDAM较稳定。
details.findings: 结果解读：作者发现重加权收益与类别绝对训练量相关，class-balanced loss和LDAM较稳定。
details.limitations:
预印本；结论限于三种架构及数据，部分稀有类在全部所测损失下仍难恢复。
简报证据边界：本次补充依据原始摘要；原文未报告的输入输出细节、完整基线、切分和训练设置均未补造。摘要译文采用机器辅助翻译并作术语、数值和身份检查；未逐篇全文精读。原有局限为简报分析，不能一概视为作者自述。
details.abstractOriginal: Single-cell foundation models (scGPT, scBERT, Geneformer) achieve cell-type classification accuracy up to 97.5% in our experiments, yet this aggregate accuracy can mask systematic failure on rare, often disease-relevant cell populations that long-tail loss functions are widely assumed to address. We present a systematic benchmark of six long-tail loss functions (cross-entropy, weighted CE, class-balanced loss, focal loss, LDAM, logit-adjusted softmax) across three architectures and three datasets (Multiple Sclerosis, Zheng68K, human Pancreas), totaling 162 controlled training runs (3 backbones x 3 datasets x 6 losses x 3 seeds). The gap between overall accuracy, Macro-F1, and rare-class recall under plain cross-entropy is consistent across all nine (architecture, dataset) settings, driven by dataset structure rather than pretraining. Rare-class failure itself splits into two regimes with distinct embedding-geometry signatures, visible before any loss is chosen: some classes are recoverable by the right loss, while others retain linear separability yet are absorbed into unrelated classes' neighborhoods under every evaluated loss and architecture. Among the recoverable classes, the efficacy of reweighting is predicted by a class's absolute training-set size, rather than its share of the dataset or the dataset's overall imbalance ratio. Class-balanced loss and LDAM are the most consistent choices across all nine settings, while logit adjustment trades rare-class precision for recall rather than improving both. Our results give both a reusable benchmark and mechanism-grounded practical guidelines for combining foundation models with imbalanced biological data.

items.title: Stochastic Flow Map for Count Data
items.summary: 使用Poisson出生和Binomial死亡学习有限时间随机转移，保持非负整数；应用于药物扰动与神经群体预测。 作者报告单个模型在不同推理预算下捕获扰动响应并预测高活动事件。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
高维计数数据在科学应用中很常见，但大多数扩散和流动模型都是针对连续或分类数据而设计的，并且生成通常需要许多顺序模型评估。我们提出了计数流图，这是一种生成模型，可以直接在计数空间中学习有限时间转换，以进行一步或几步生成。我们的模型直接学习有限时间间隔内的随机转换，使用泊松出生和二项式死亡来保留非负整数计数，而无需预定义最大值。这些转换模型经过训练，可以匹配潜在的局部出生-死亡动态，并保持步长之间的一致性。我们描述了局部动力学和有限时间转换一致性之间的联系，并得出了生成误差的界限。在多次模拟（包括高维、高计数设置）中验证计数流图后，我们将其应用于单细胞药物扰动预测和神经群体预测，其中它捕获扰动响应并支持仅通过一个或几个模型评估即可预测高活动事件。这些实验共同证明，计数流图可以使用单个经过训练的模型，在跨推理预算的计数空间中直接进行高质量生成，从一步生成到几步生成。

details.abstractOriginal: High-dimensional count data are common in scientific applications, but most diffusion and flow models are designed for continuous or categorical data, and generation often requires many sequential model evaluations. We propose Count Flow Map, a generative model that learns finite-time transitions directly in count space for one- or few-step generation. Our model directly learns stochastic transitions over finite time intervals, using Poisson births and Binomial deaths to preserve nonnegative integer counts without a predefined maximum. These transition models are trained to match the underlying local birth--death dynamics and to maintain consistency across step sizes. We characterize the connection between local dynamics and finite-time transition consistency and derive a bound on the generation error. After validating Count Flow Map in several simulations, including a high-dimensional, high-count setting, we apply it to single-cell drug perturbation prediction and neural population forecasting, where it captures perturbation responses and supports forecasts of high-activity events with only one or a few model evaluations. Together, these experiments demonstrate that Count Flow Map enables high-quality generation directly in count space across inference budgets, from one-step to few-step generation, using a single trained model.

items.title: DeepSpaceDB 2.0: an interactive spatial transcriptomics database for large-scale Xenium data exploration
items.updateType: 预印本修订 v2（首次收录）
items.summary: 收集1539个公开Xenium数据集，校验修复并统一格式，采用Zarr存储与新网页界面。 作者报告常见交互操作亚秒响应，支持浏览器中区域分析与基因中心查询。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
10x Genomics Xenium 平台可实现单细胞和亚细胞尺度的高分辨率空间转录组学，但公共 Xenium 数据集的有效重用受到大数据量和异构文件格式的阻碍。我们之前开发了 DeepSpaceDB，这是一个空间转录组数据库，旨在对组织和组织微环境进行交互式深入分析。在这里，我们提出了 DeepSpaceDB 的重大扩展，它集成了 Xenium 平台生成的大规模单细胞空间转录组数据。在此更新中，我们系统地从多个存储库收集了 1,539 个公共 Xenium 数据集，并通过强大的标准化分析流程对它们进行处理，该分析流程验证、修复异构输入并将其协调为统一的表示形式。为了支持对这些数据的高效探索，我们引入了重新设计的 DeepSpaceDB 界面和基于 Zarr 的补充存储格式，针对以基因为中心的可视化和空间本地化查询进行了优化，为常见的交互式操作提供了亚秒级响应时间。更新后的平台支持直接在网络浏览器中实时可视化空间数据和分析感兴趣的区域。总之，这一扩展将 DeepSpaceDB 确立为单细胞空间转录组学的统一资源，大大降低了访问、探索和重用大规模公共 Xenium 数据集的障碍。

研究问题与设计：10x Genomics Xenium 平台可实现单细胞和亚细胞尺度的高分辨率空间转录组学，但公共 Xenium 数据集的有效重用受到大数据量和异构文件格式的阻碍。我们之前开发了 DeepSpaceDB，这是一个空间转录组数据库，旨在对组织和组织微环境进行交互式深入分析。

方法与数据：收集1539个公开Xenium数据集，校验修复并统一格式，采用Zarr存储与新网页界面。

details.abstractOriginal: The 10x Genomics Xenium platform enables high-resolution spatial transcriptomics at single-cell and subcellular scales, but effective reuse of public Xenium datasets is hindered by large data sizes and heterogeneous file formats. We previously developed DeepSpaceDB, a spatial transcriptomics database designed for interactive, in-depth analysis of tissues and tissue microenvironments. Here, we present a major expansion of DeepSpaceDB that integrates large-scale single-cell spatial transcriptomics data generated by the Xenium platform. In this update, we systematically collected 1,539 public Xenium datasets from multiple repositories and processed them through a robust, standardized pipeline that validates, repairs, and harmonizes heterogeneous inputs into a unified representation. To support efficient exploration of these data, we introduced a redesigned DeepSpaceDB interface and complementary Zarr-based storage formats optimized for gene-centric visualization and spatially localized queries, enabling sub-second response times for common interactive operations. The updated platform supports real-time visualization of spatial data and analysis of regions of interest directly in the web browser. Together, this expansion establishes DeepSpaceDB as a unified resource for single-cell spatial transcriptomics, substantially lowering the barrier to accessing, exploring, and reusing large-scale public Xenium datasets.

items.title: DELPHAI predicts heterogeneous perturbation responses with learned single-cell fitness
items.updateType: 预印本修订 v2（首次收录）
items.summary: 同时训练适应度网络和最优传输网络，推理采用适应度门控及直接基因空间检索。 作者在两个基准框架中报告差异表达预测排名第一，并识别被扰动消耗的细胞谱系。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：

details.abstractOriginal: Current perturbation response modelling in single-cell transcriptomics assumes conserved cell mass and loses gene expression information to latent-space decoding. We propose DELPHAI, training a fitness network and an optimal transport network jointly without biological priors, and during inference applying a fitness-gated transport with a direct gene-space retrieval. Demonstrated across two benchmark frameworks, DELPHAI ranks first in predicting differentially expressed genes, while revealing which cell lineages a perturbation depletes.

items.title: Building dynamical models of multi-step state transitions from single cell gene expression trajectories
items.updateType: 预印本修订 v2（首次收录）
items.summary: 推断核心TF网络并构建ODE模型，在合成轨迹、BEELINE和多种分化轨迹评测。 模型再现顺序状态转换，并预测驱动转换的TF及组合、恢复部分已知调控因子。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
多步细胞状态转变发生在生物过程中，例如发育和疾病进展，但潜在的基因调控仍不清楚。我们介绍了 NetDes，这是一种计算系统生物学方法，可推断核心转录因子 (TF) 调控网络并根据单细胞基因表达轨迹构建基于 ODE 的动态模型。在使用诱饵和 BEELINE scRNA-seq 数据集的合成轨迹基准中，NetDes 与现有方法竞争性地识别了调控相互作用，并重建了模拟的细胞命运回路。我们将其应用于 iPSC 至定形内胚层分化、上皮间质转化、红细胞生成和树突细胞分化的时间序列 scRNA-seq 数据。 NetDes 在使用单个模型重建最小网络方面比现有方法具有优势，该模型可以重现观察到的表达动态并捕获顺序状态转换。网络模拟预测 TF 及其组合驱动每次转换，恢复已知的主调节器，而网络粗粒度揭示了 iPSC 到 DE 差异的电路逻辑。 NetDes 为复杂细胞状态转换的机械建模提供了通用框架。

方法与数据：推断核心TF网络并构建ODE模型，在合成轨迹、BEELINE和多种分化轨迹评测。

details.abstractOriginal: Multi-step cell state transitions occur across biological processes, such as development and disease progression, yet the underlying gene regulation remains unclear. We introduce NetDes, a computational systems-biology method that infers core transcription factor (TF) regulatory networks and builds ODE-based dynamical models from single-cell gene expression trajectories. In benchmarks on synthetic trajectories with decoys and BEELINE scRNA-seq datasets, NetDes identifies regulatory interactions competitively with existing methods, and reconstructs a simulated cell-fate circuit. We applied it to time-series scRNA-seq data of iPSC-to-definitive-endoderm differentiation, epithelial-mesenchymal transition, erythropoiesis, and dendritic cell differentiation. NetDes has advantages over existing approaches in reconstructing a minimal network with a single model that reproduces observed expression dynamics and captures sequential state transitions. Network simulations predict TFs and their combinations driving each transition, recovering known master regulators, while network coarse-graining reveals the circuit logic of iPSC-to-DE differentiation. NetDes provides a general framework for mechanistic modeling of complex cell state transitions.

items.title: Domain Elastic Transform: Bayesian Function Registration for High-Dimensional Scientific Data
items.updateType: 预印本修订 v3（首次收录）
items.summary: 广义贝叶斯弹性变形，在MERFISH脑切片90例基准及Stereo-seq胚胎图谱评测。 DET在所测管线中空间重合与拓扑最强，PASTE2变体的标签转移ARI更高。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
非刚性配准通常分为点集配准（对齐稀疏几何形状）和图像配准（对齐规则网格上的连续强度场）。这种二分法限制了空间转录组学等新兴科学数据，其中高维向量值函数（例如基因表达）是在不规则稀疏流形上定义的。因此，研究人员必须要么通过体素化牺牲单细胞分辨率，要么忽略功能信号以支持几何对齐。我们提出了域弹性变换（DET），这是一种联合对齐几何和函数的无网格概率框架。通过将数据视为不规则域上的函数，DET 直接记录高维信号而无需合并。在广义贝叶斯公式中，域变形被建模为由联合空间函数似然引导的弹性运动。 DET 是完全无监督的，并且通过在采样点上进行配准然后进行位移插值来进行扩展。我们在 MERFISH 小鼠大脑切片和 Stereo-seq 小鼠胚胎图谱上评估 DET。在具有严重扰动且没有事先初始化的 90 例 MERFISH 基准上，DET 在评估的分析流程中实现了最强的空间重叠和拓扑，而加速的 PASTE2 变体实现了最高的标签传输 ARI。在没有跨阶段真实情况的图谱规模 MOSTA 可行性研究中，非刚性细化改进了分析流程内的几个解剖域和边界一致性措施。这些结果表明，无网格函数配准补充了高维科学数据的点集、基于图像和最优传输方法。 DET 实现可从此 https URL 获取（自 2025 年 3 月起）。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：非刚性配准通常分为点集配准（对齐稀疏几何形状）和图像配准（对齐规则网格上的连续强度场）。这种二分法限制了空间转录组学等新兴科学数据，其中高维向量值函数（例如基因表达）是在不规则稀疏流形上定义的。

方法与数据：广义贝叶斯弹性变形，在MERFISH脑切片90例基准及Stereo-seq胚胎图谱评测。

结果及适用范围：DET在所测管线中空间重合与拓扑最强，PASTE2变体的标签转移ARI更高。

details.abstractOriginal:
Nonrigid registration is conventionally divided into point set registration, which aligns sparse geometries, and image registration, which aligns continuous intensity fields on regular grids. This dichotomy is limiting for emerging scientific data such as spatial transcriptomics, where high-dimensional vector-valued functions, e.g., gene expression, are defined on irregular sparse manifolds. Researchers must therefore either sacrifice single-cell resolution through voxelization or ignore functional signals in favor of geometric alignment.
 We propose Domain Elastic Transform (DET), a grid-free probabilistic framework that jointly aligns geometry and function. By treating data as functions on irregular domains, DET registers high-dimensional signals directly without binning. Within a generalized Bayesian formulation, domain deformation is modeled as elastic motion guided by a joint spatial-functional likelihood. DET is fully unsupervised and scalable through registration on sampled points followed by displacement interpolation.
 We evaluate DET on MERFISH mouse-brain slices and Stereo-seq mouse-embryo atlases. On a 90-case MERFISH benchmark with severe perturbations and no prior initialization, DET achieved the strongest spatial overlap and topology among the evaluated pipelines, while an accelerated PASTE2 variant achieved the highest label-transfer ARI. In an atlas-scale MOSTA feasibility study without cross-stage ground truth, nonrigid refinement improved several within-pipeline anatomical-domain and boundary-consistency measures.
 These results suggest that grid-free function registration complements point-set, image-based, and optimal-transport approaches for high-dimensional scientific data. The DET implementation is available at  this https URL  (since Mar, 2025).

items.title: A lifespan single-cell atlas of the human developing hippocampus benchmarks familial Alzheimer's disease brain organoids.
items.summary: 整合658059个细胞，覆盖受孕后3周至15.3岁，并映射PSEN1 E280A类器官。 作者观察到放射状胶质减少、神经嵴来源神经元增加和成熟状态偏移。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
家族性阿尔茨海默病 (fAD) 是一种早发性 AD，由 APP、PSEN1 或 PSEN2 的常染色体显性变异引起，其中 PSEN1 占大多数遗传定义的病例 [1]。海马体是 AD 中最早、受影响最严重的大脑区域之一 [2,3]。人类诱导多能干细胞 (iPSC) 衍生的大脑类器官概括了早期人类大脑发育的关键特征，并为研究 fAD 突变如何扰动神经发育过程提供了一个易于处理的模型 [4]。然而，由于异质的区域特性、不同的成熟状态和跨方案的细胞类型组成，它们的解释变得复杂[5,6]。现有的人类海马单细胞研究涵盖产前[7]和产后[8-10]阶段，但没有提供持续的发育参考。通过提升利用单细胞 RNA 测序数据的图谱方法，我们获得了有关类器官细胞类别和类型组成以及成熟状态的标准化信息。在这里，我们构建了人类发育海马图谱 (HuDeHA)，这是一个集成的单细胞参考，包含涵盖受孕后第 3 周至 15.3 年的 658,059 个细胞，并用它来对携带 PSEN1 E280A 的 iPSC 衍生的大脑类器官进行基准测试，PSEN1 E280A 与大量哥伦比亚人群中的 fAD 相关。基于参考的绘图揭示了 PSEN1 E280A 类器官中细胞组成的改变，包括放射状胶质细胞的减少和神经嵴衍生神经元的增加。这些变化伴随着跨谱系转录改变，包括脉络丛和室管膜相关群体中腹侧模式因子 MEIS2 的广泛上调和 {β} 结合蛋白转甲状腺素蛋白 (TTR) 表达的减少。重建的神经元谱系轨迹显示 PSEN1 E280A 类器官向成熟状态转变。总之，这些发现将 HuDeHA 确立为海马相关类器官系统发育基准的资源，并描述了 PSEN1 E280A 类器官中细胞谱系特异性的发育变化，这可能有助于解释 fAD 的早期细胞改变。

方法与数据：整合658059个细胞，覆盖受孕后3周至15.3岁，并映射PSEN1 E280A类器官。

结果及适用范围：作者观察到放射状胶质减少、神经嵴来源神经元增加和成熟状态偏移。
