details.abstractOriginal: Familial Alzheimer's disease (fAD) is an early-onset form of AD caused by autosomal-dominant variants in APP, PSEN1, or PSEN2, with PSEN1 accounting for most genetically defined cases [1]. The hippocampus is among the earliest and most severely affected brain regions in AD [2,3]. Human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived brain organoids recapitulate key features of early human brain development and provide a tractable model for studying how fAD mutations perturb neurodevelopmental processes [4]. However, their interpretation is complicated by heterogeneous regional identity, variable maturation state, and cell-type composition across protocols [5,6]. Existing single-cell studies of human hippocampus cover prenatal [7] and postnatal [8-10] stages but do not provide a continuous developmental reference. By elevating the atlas approach in utilizing single-cell RNA-sequencing data, we obtain standardized information on the organoid cell class and type composition and maturation states. Here, we constructed the Human Developing Hippocampus Atlas (HuDeHA), an integrated single-cell reference comprising 658,059 cells spanning post-conceptional week 3 to 15.3 years, and used it to benchmark iPSC-derived brain organoids carrying PSEN1 E280A which is associated with fAD in a large Colombian population. Reference-based mapping revealed altered cellular composition in PSEN1 E280A organoids, including reduced radial glia and increased neural crest-derived neurons. These changes were accompanied by cross-lineage transcriptional alterations, including broad upregulation of the ventral patterning factor MEIS2 and reduced expression of the {beta}-binding protein transthyretin (TTR) in choroid-plexus and ependymal-associated populations. Reconstructed neuronal-lineage trajectories showed a shift toward mature states in PSEN1 E280A organoids. Together, these findings establish HuDeHA as a resource for developmental benchmarking of hippocampus-relevant organoid systems and describe cell-lineage-specific developmental changes in PSEN1 E280A organoids that may inform interpretation of early cellular alterations in fAD.

items.title: Paired-surface spatial mechanomics links tissue stiffness maps to spatial transcriptomics
items.updateType: 预印本修订 v2（首次收录）
items.summary: 小鼠卵巢新鲜表面纳米压痕与紧邻平行表面的Visium HD配准，21个区域2771对测量。 作者发现刚度与基质、细胞周期程序及年龄相关炎症和代谢信号关联。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
组织力学影响多种生物过程，但将刚度测量与完整组织中的空间分辨分子状态直接联系起来仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们开发了一种配对表面空间力学方法，通过纳米压痕在新鲜组织表面上绘制杨氏模量，并将刚度网格与来自紧邻平行表面的 Visium HD 空间转录组数据共同配准。将其应用于小鼠卵巢，该卵巢具有空间上不同的区室，并随着年龄的增长而经历细胞外基质重塑。 50 m 网格间距的纳米压痕可实现毫米级刚度图，同时平衡新鲜组织中的采集时间，在 21 个感兴趣区域生成 2,771 个匹配测量结果。整体和隔室特异性分析将较僵硬的区域与较低的基质相关程序和较高的细胞周期程序以及年龄依赖性炎症和代谢关联相关联。这种相关策略将实验测量的力学与新鲜组织中的空间组学相结合。

方法与数据：小鼠卵巢新鲜表面纳米压痕与紧邻平行表面的Visium HD配准，21个区域2771对测量。

结果及适用范围：作者发现刚度与基质、细胞周期程序及年龄相关炎症和代谢信号关联。

details.abstractOriginal: Tissue mechanics influence diverse biological processes, yet directly linking stiffness measurements to spatially resolved molecular states in intact tissues remains challenging. Here we developed a paired-surface spatial mechanomics approach to map Young's modulus by nanoindentation on a fresh tissue surface and co-register the stiffness grid with Visium HD spatial transcriptome data from the immediately adjacent, parallel surface. This was applied to the mouse ovary, which has spatially distinct compartments and undergoes extracellular matrix remodeling with age. Nanoindentation at 50 m grid spacing enabled millimeter-scale stiffness maps while balancing acquisition time in fresh tissues, generating 2,771 matched measurements across 21 regions of interest. Global and compartment-specific analyses associated stiffer regions with lower matrix-related programs and higher cell-cycle programs, alongside age-dependent inflammatory and metabolic associations. This correlative strategy integrates experimentally measured mechanics with spatial omics in fresh tissues.

items.title: SMORE: joint dimension reduction and cell population discovery on single-cell methylome data
items.summary: 贝叶斯模型将甲基化比例转为有序状态，以低秩高斯分解和有限混合先验推断群数。 模拟及人肺、血液和运动皮层数据中恢复有生物支持的群体结构。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
单细胞 DNA 甲基化分析技术捕获了新颖的表观遗传数据模式，但由于其异质性、高维性和超稀疏性而难以分析。在这里，我们提出 SMORE（单细胞甲基化还原和嵌入），这是一种专门用于单细胞 DNA 甲基化数据的联合降维和细胞群发现的计算方法。 SMORE 在贝叶斯框架上运行，将甲基化比例转换为有序甲基化状态，并联合推断低维表示、细胞群及其数量。通过使用低秩潜在高斯分解并在潜在细胞评分之前采用有限混合物的混合物，SMORE 无需预先指定的簇数即可推断细胞分配，并将甲基化测量的不确定性传播到细胞分配。在涵盖不同样本量、群体不平衡、信号强度和模型错误指定的模拟中，SMORE 准确地恢复了潜在群体结构，并且优于现有方法。 SMORE 应用于来自肺、外周血和初级运动皮层的人类单细胞甲基化数据集，恢复了生物支持的细胞群结构。 SMORE 为单细胞甲基化组的降维和群体发现提供了一个不确定性感知框架。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：单细胞 DNA 甲基化分析技术捕获了新颖的表观遗传数据模式，但由于其异质性、高维性和超稀疏性而难以分析。在这里，我们提出 SMORE（单细胞甲基化还原和嵌入），这是一种专门用于单细胞 DNA 甲基化数据的联合降维和细胞群发现的计算方法。

details.abstractOriginal: Single-cell DNA methylation profiling technology captures novel epigenetic data modality but are challenging to analyze because of their heterogeneity, high dimensionality, and ultra-sparsity. items.title: Multi-model biological and sequence information fusion for gene regulatory network inference from single-cell transcriptomics
items.summary: 去噪自编码器、图注意力、预训练DNA语言模型及门控多头注意力整合多源信息。 在人鼠七个数据集上作者报告优于比较方法并识别候选TF–基因关系。

摘要中文翻译：
转录因子靶基因相互作用的鉴定和基因调控网络（GRN）的构建对于理解转录基因调控的分子机制至关重要。跨不同组织的大规模单细胞转录组学通过捕获基因表达异质性提供了细胞多样性和调控动态的前所未有的分辨率。然而，现有方法往往缺乏有效的多模态集成，并且无法充分利用基因本体（GO）和基因序列水平表示的层次结构，这限制了它们的预测性能和生物学可解释性的能力。我们提出了 scMGFGRN，一个多模型深度学习框架，它通过利用去噪自动编码器将单细胞转录组图谱与 GO 层次关系、基因序列、图注意力特征提取和相关 DNA 语言模型集成在一起，以捕获多模型生物知识中的多源依赖性，而其门控多头注意力模块有效地识别信息性监管签名并集成来自不同来源的互补特征以预测准确的基因调控网络。对人类和小鼠的七个数据集进行的基准测试表明，scMGFGRN 在识别 GRN 方面优于最先进的方法。进一步的分析表明，scMGFGRN 可以有效识别新的 TF 基因相互作用 (TGI) 并重建细胞类型特异性的 GRN。可解释性分析揭示了异质生物来源的贡献模式，证明了 scMGFGRN 将转录组谱与多模型结构信息整合的能力。

details.abstractOriginal: Identification of transcription factor target gene interactions and construction of the gene regulatory networks (GRNs) are essential for understanding the molecular mechanisms underlying transcriptional gene regulation. Large scale single cell transcriptomics across different tissues offers unprecedented resolution of cellular diversity and regulatory dynamics by capturing gene expression heterogeneity. However, existing methods often lack effective multimodal integration and fail to fully exploit the hierarchical structure in Gene Ontology (GO) and gene sequence level representations, which limits their ability for predictive performance and biological interpretability. We present scMGFGRN, a multi-model deep learning framework that integrates single-cell transcriptomic profiles with GO hierarchical relationships, gene sequences by leveraging denoising auto encoders, graph attention feature extraction and pertained DNA language model to capture multi-source dependencies within multi-model biological knowledge, while its gated multi head attention module effectively identifies informative regulatory signatures and integrate complementary features from different sources to predict accurate gene regulatory networks. Benchmarking on the seven datasets of human and mouse demonstrates that scMGFGRN outperforms state of the art methods in identifying GRNs. Further analyses reveal that scMGFGRN effectively identifies novel TF gene interactions (TGIs) and reconstructs cell type specific GRNs. Interpretability analysis reveals the contribution patterns of heterogeneous biological sources, demonstrating the ability of scMGFGRN to integrate transcriptomic profiles with multi model structure information.

items.title: Setting the SCENE for Interpretable Cell-Gene Embeddings in Single-Cell RNA-seq
items.summary: 把UMI计数视作加权二部图，使用潜在欧氏距离及零膨胀计数似然，区分检出与表达量。 真实及模拟数据上保留生物结构，在二维和三维潜空间展现细胞及基因程序。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
单细胞 RNA 测序以高分辨率测量细胞状态，但稀疏的高维计数数据仍然难以进行可解释的建模。我们引入了单细胞欧几里德网络嵌入（SCENE），这是一种概率潜在距离模型，可联合嵌入来自唯一分子标识符（UMI）计数的细胞和基因。 SCENE 将计数矩阵视为加权二分细胞基因图，其中欧几里得距离代表转录亲和力，并将这种几何形状与零膨胀计数可能性相结合，将基因检测与表达量分开。在真实和模拟的 scRNA-seq 数据集中，SCENE 以最先进的性能恢复生物结构的细胞和基因嵌入。令人惊讶的是，主要的生物结构被保存在原生的二维和三维潜在空间中，从而实现了直接可解释的可视化。扰动分析表明，SCENE 在基因空间中连贯地组织糖皮质激素反应基因和 T 细胞受体调节程序，捕获细胞类型分离之外的生物学。 SCENE 提供了一个透明的表示学习框架，其中低维欧几里得几何支持准确的建模和生物解释。

details.abstractOriginal: Single-cell RNA sequencing measures cellular states at high resolution, but sparse high-dimensional count data remain difficult to model interpretably. We introduce the Single-Cell Euclidean Network Embedding (SCENE), a probabilistic latent-distance model that jointly embeds cells and genes from Unique Molecular Identifier (UMI) counts. SCENE treats the count matrix as a weighted bipartite cell-gene graph, where Euclidean distances represent transcriptional affinity, and combines this geometry with a zero-inflated count likelihood that separates gene detection from expression magnitude. Across real and simulated scRNA-seq datasets, SCENE recovers biologically structured cell and gene embeddings with state-of-the-art performance. Surprisingly, major biological structure is preserved in native two- and three-dimensional latent spaces, enabling directly interpretable visualization. Perturbation analyses show that SCENE organizes glucocorticoid-response genes and T-cell receptor regulatory programs coherently in gene space, capturing biology beyond cell-type separation. SCENE provides a transparent representation learning framework in which low-dimensional Euclidean geometry supports accurate modeling and biological interpretation.

items.title: ssJSD: A fusion of sparsity and spatial information for HiC single-cell clustering
items.summary: ssJSD结合scHiC带状接触频率及结构零稀疏矩阵，早期/晚期融合；模拟、人细胞系及前额叶数据。 作者报告聚类改善并更好区分细胞类型。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
单细胞高通量染色质构象捕获 (scHiC) 能够以细胞分辨率分析三维基因组结构，从而深入了解细胞间的变异性和细胞功能。最近的框架利用空间交互模式来导出下游任务（例如细胞聚类）的相异性度量。然而，scHiC 接触矩阵固有的稀疏性和超高维性带来了重大挑战。一个主要障碍是现有措施通常不加区别地对待所有零，无法区分具有生物学意义的结构零（SZ）和技术辍学。在这里，我们介绍 ssJSD（空间和稀疏性詹森-香农散度），这是一种计算框架，旨在明确解释 scHiC 特定的稀疏模式。通过将带状接触频率分布与 SZ 诱导的稀疏矩阵相结合，ssJSD 利用了空间相互作用模式和生物学上的接触缺失。我们采用了两种互补的集成策略：早期融合方法将信息连接成单个表示，以及后期融合方法通过不同的平均方法集成基于 JSD 的差异。通过对人类细胞系和前额皮质数据的模拟和应用，我们证明了 ssJSD 提高了聚类精度并有效区分细胞类型。我们的研究表明，整合 SZ 模式对于准确量化 3D 基因组学中细胞间的变异性非常重要。

方法与数据：ssJSD结合scHiC带状接触频率及结构零稀疏矩阵，早期/晚期融合；模拟、人细胞系及前额叶数据。

结果及适用范围：作者报告聚类改善并更好区分细胞类型。

details.abstractOriginal: Single-cell high-throughput chromatin conformation capture (scHiC) enables profiling three dimensional genome architecture at cellular resolution, providing insights into cell-to-cell variability and cellular functions. Recent frameworks utilize spatial interaction patterns to derive dissimilarity measures for downstream tasks such as cell clustering. However, the inherent sparsity and ultra-high dimensionality of scHiC contact matrices pose significant challenges. A central hurdle is that existing measures typically treat all zeros without distinction, failing to differentiate biologically meaningful structural zeros (SZs) from technical dropouts. Here, we introduce ssJSD (spatial and sparsity informed Jensen-Shannon Divergence), a computational framework designed to explicitly account for scHiC-specific sparsity patterns. By integrating band-wise contact frequency profiles with SZ-induced sparsity matrices, ssJSD leverages both spatial interaction patterns and biological absence of contacts. We adopted two complementary integration strategies: an early fusion approach that concatenates information into a single representation, and a late fusion approach that integrates JSD-based dissimilarities through diverse averaging methods. Through simulations and applications to human cell lines and prefrontal cortex data, we demonstrate that ssJSD improves clustering accuracy and effectively distinguishes cell types. Our study indicates that integrating SZ patterns is important for accurately quantifying cell-to-cell variability in 3D genomics.

items.title: Revealing therapeutic single-cell transcriptomic signatures using a simple classifier
items.summary: 按处理与暴露时间分类单细胞，并对照Perturb-seq与LINCS药物签名。 作者报告可辨认常规降维中隐藏的细胞并辅助推断药物靶点。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 已成为表征异质群体的常规工具。在这里，我们提出了 Cell-Sign，一种检测算法，可以根据单细胞水平的药物治疗对细胞进行分类。该方法可以识别传统降维方法中隐藏的单个细胞，并揭示细胞接触的药物和接触的持续时间。我们展示了如何通过将单细胞 Perturb-seq 数据与来自基于集成网络的细胞特征库 (LINCS) 的药物特征进行比较来使用我们的方法来识别药物靶点。 Cell-Sign 有助于高度多元化的单细胞药物发现和新药物靶点的识别。

details.abstractOriginal: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) has become a routine tool for characterizing heterogeneous populations. Here, we present Cell-Sign, a detection algorithm that can classify cells according to drug treatments at the single-cell level. The method allows the identification of individual cells that remain hidden in conventional dimensionality reduction approaches and reveals both the drug a cell was exposed to and the duration of exposure. We show how our approach can be used to identify drug targets by comparing single-cell Perturb-seq data with drug signatures from the Library of Integrated Network-based Cellular Signatures (LINCS). Cell-Sign can contribute to highly multiplexed single-cell drug discovery and the identification of novel drug targets.

items.title: Interpretable spherical geometry of single-cell state transitions from dominant principal components
items.updateType: 新预印本（解除历史待核验）
items.summary: 对前三个主成分L2归一化，并以生物学根状态对齐北极，保留角度与投影前径向幅度。 作者报告发育距离与CytoTRACE干性相关，固定载荷扰动可分解位置和径向贡献。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
单细胞 RNA-seq 图谱通常使用非线性嵌入进行探索，这种嵌入保留邻域，但提供有限的坐标级别解释。我们询问将单细胞基因表达的主要成分（PC）投影到单位球体上是否会产生可解释的坐标系。 SPHERE-PCA L2 对前三个 PC 坐标进行归一化，将生物学定义的根与北极对齐，并通过三个坐标表示每个细胞：根对齐的测地距离 ({theta})、角度位置 ({phi}) 和预投影径向幅度 (r)。在发育和疾病相关的数据集中，这种表示揭示了结构化的球面几何形状，范围从近大圆轨迹到多弧流形。在发育图谱中，随着 CytoTRACE 推断的干性降低，根对齐测地距离增加，而基因坐标分析将与角位置相关的程序与与径向大小相关的程序分开。固定负载扰动将每个基因对细胞位置的影响分解为进展、分支或状态位置以及径向活性成分。因此，SPHERE-PCA 提供了一个确定性的、负载保持的坐标框架，用于解释主要转录组方差，并为扰动分析和虚拟细胞模型建立透明的几何坐标框架。

方法与数据：对前三个主成分L2归一化，并以生物学根状态对齐北极，保留角度与投影前径向幅度。

details.abstractOriginal: Single-cell RNA-seq atlases are commonly explored with nonlinear embeddings that preserve neighborhoods but provide limited coordinate-level interpretation. We asked whether projecting the dominant principal components (PCs) of single-cell gene expression onto a unit sphere would yield an interpretable coordinate system. SPHERE-PCA L2-normalizes the first three PC coordinates, aligns a biologically defined root to the north pole, and represents each cell by three coordinates: root-aligned geodesic distance ({theta}), angular position ({phi}), and pre-projection radial magnitude (r). Across developmental and disease-associated datasets, this representation reveals structured spherical geometry, ranging from near-great-circle trajectories to multi-arc manifolds. In developmental atlases, root-aligned geodesic distance increases as CytoTRACE-inferred stemness decreases, while gene-coordinate analyses separate programs associated with angular position from those associated with radial magnitude. Fixed-loading perturbations decompose each gene's effect on cell position into progression, branch- or state-position, and radial activity components. SPHERE-PCA therefore provides a deterministic, loading-preserving coordinate framework for interpreting dominant transcriptomic variance and establishing a transparent geometric coordinate framework for perturbation analysis and virtual-cell models.

items.title: DiffDomain-Spectrum identifies structurally reorganized TADs from sparse aggregated single-cell Hi-C contact maps
items.summary: 在25 kb尺度对TAD差异矩阵实施谱统计，以半圆律零分布整合全特征值证据。 作者报告兼顾假阳性与灵敏度；检出区域伴随CTCF与差异表达富集。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
结构重组的拓扑关联域（TAD）捕获条件或细胞类型特异性的染色质接触重塑，对于理解健康和疾病中的基因组组织非常重要。新兴的单细胞 Hi-C (scHi-C) 技术能够在异质细胞群之间进行此类比较，但聚合的 scHi-C 接触图在具有生物学意义的 25 kb 分辨率下仍然稀疏，限制了可靠的 TAD 重组检测。在这里，我们提出了 DiffDomain-Spectrum，这是一个光谱统计框架，用于从聚合的原始 scHi-C 接触图中识别条件或细胞类型之间重组的 TAD。它测试归一化的 TAD 级差异矩阵，无需单独归一化稀疏图或增强各个 scHi-C 接触图。与半圆律零值的比较整合了整个特征值谱的证据。在多个 scHi-C 平台上，DiffDomain-Spectrum 平衡了相对于替代批量调用者的误报控制和检测灵敏度，并检测到比注重边界的单细胞方法 scHiCluster 更高比例的重组参考 TAD。检测到的 TAD 显示一致的聚集接触模式和 CTCF 结合变化，并且富集差异表达基因，支持生物学相关性。总之，这些结果将 DiffDomain-Spectrum 确立为统计原理框架，用于对稀疏聚合 scHi-C 接触图进行比较域级分析，无需单细胞图增强。

details.abstractOriginal: Structurally reorganized topologically associating domains (TADs) capture condition- or cell-type-specific remodeling of chromatin contacts and are important for understanding genome organization in health and disease. Emerging single-cell Hi-C (scHi-C) technologies enable such comparisons across heterogeneous cell populations, but aggregated scHi-C contact maps remain sparse at biologically meaningful 25 kb resolution, limiting reliable TAD reorganization detection. Here we present DiffDomain-Spectrum, a spectral statistical framework for identifying reorganized TADs between conditions or cell types from aggregated raw scHi-C contact maps. It tests normalized TAD-level difference matrices without separately normalizing sparse maps or enhancing individual scHi-C contact maps. Comparison with a semicircle-law null integrates evidence across the full eigenvalue spectrum. Across multiple scHi-C platforms, DiffDomain-Spectrum balances false positive control and detection sensitivity relative to alternative bulk callers, and detects a substantially higher proportion of reference TADs as reorganized than the boundary-focused single-cell method scHiCluster. Detected TADs show coherent aggregate contact patterns and CTCF binding changes and are enriched for differentially expressed genes, supporting biological relevance. Together, these results establish DiffDomain-Spectrum as a statistically principled framework for comparative domain-level analysis of sparse aggregated scHi-C contact maps without single-cell map enhancement.

items.title: Locat: Joint enrichment and depletion testing identifies localized marker genes in single-cell transcriptomics
items.updateType: 预印本修订 v3（首次收录）
items.summary: 在细胞嵌入中拟合基因与背景加权高斯混合密度，联合浓集及耗减评分。 模拟、发育、扰动和分化数据中获得紧凑标记集合并保留主要生物结构。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
有几种方法可以识别在单细胞转录组数据中描绘细胞群的标记基因，但大多数方法都强调候选群体内的富集，而不测试其他地方的表达是否显着降低。我们提出了 Locat，这是一个框架，用于通过测试表达是否集中在细胞嵌入的紧凑区域内并在其外部耗尽来识别高度特异性的局部基因。对于每个基因，Locat 将加权高斯混合模型拟合到特定基因和背景密度，计算浓度和消耗统计数据，并将它们集成到统一的定位分数中。在具有受控参考真值的综合基准中，Locat 可以检测单模态、多模态和稀疏局部模式，并且当表达与背景结构无法区分时就失去重要性。在发育、扰动和分化数据集中，Locat 识别紧凑的标记集，捕获谱系组织、特定条件程序和时间动态。这些集合通常小于高度可变的基因选择，而从它们构建的嵌入在某些情况下保留了主要细胞群和发育程序。在小鼠真皮、干扰素处理的 PBMC 和视黄酸诱导的胚胎干细胞分化中，局部基因恢复分化轨迹、刺激响应程序和可重复的阶段特异性模式。总之，这些结果表明，联合评估浓度和消耗会产生特定的、可解释的标记基因。

方法与数据：在细胞嵌入中拟合基因与背景加权高斯混合密度，联合浓集及耗减评分。

结果及适用范围：模拟、发育、扰动和分化数据中获得紧凑标记集合并保留主要生物结构。

details.abstractOriginal: Several methods identify marker genes that delineate cell populations in single-cell transcriptomic data, yet most emphasize enrichment within candidate populations without testing whether expression is significantly reduced elsewhere. We present Locat, a framework for identifying highly specific localized genes by testing whether expression is concentrated within compact regions of a cellular embedding and depleted outside them. For each gene, Locat fits weighted Gaussian mixture models to gene-specific and background densities, computes concentration and depletion statistics, and integrates them into a unified localization score. Across synthetic benchmarks with controlled ground truth, Locat detects uni-modal, multi-modal, and sparse localized patterns and loses significance when expression becomes indistinguishable from background structure. In developmental, perturbation, and differentiation datasets, Locat identifies compact marker sets that capture lineage organization, condition-specific programs, and temporal dynamics. These sets are often smaller than highly variable gene selections, while embeddings built from them preserve major cell populations and developmental programs in several cases. In murine dermis, interferon-treated PBMCs, and retinoic acid-induced embryonic stem cell differentiation, localized genes recover differentiation trajectories, stimulus-responsive programs, and reproducible stage-specific patterns. Together, these results show that jointly assessing concentration and depletion yields specific, interpretable marker genes.

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
差异转录本使用 (DTU) 分析揭示了选择性剪接中的转录本水平调控。随着长读长测序在批量、单细胞和空间转录组学中的快速采用，在真实生物条件下对 DTU 方法进行可靠评估变得至关重要。目前的评估框架主要依赖于模拟数据，这可能会引入偏差，并且可能无法反映真实的监管机制。构建了一个真实数据驱动的框架来评估长读长、单细胞和空间转录组学的 DTU 方法。该框架包括两个关键组件。首先，使用 RNA 结合蛋白 (RBP) 敲除或敲低 RNA-seq 数据以及经过实验验证的 RBP-转录本相互作用来定义生物学基础的参考转录本集。其次，引入了 DTU 特定的评估指标（转录本集富集分数），以量化方法在排名结果中优先考虑参考转录本的有效性。使用多个真实的 RNA-seq 数据集系统地验证了该框架的可靠性、公正性、稳定性、有效性和鲁棒性。在该验证的支持下，十种代表性的 DTU 方法在长读和短读数据上进行了评估，揭示了不同数据类型的性能差异。除了评估 DTU 方法之外，该框架还进一步扩展到预测转录本水平的 RBP 活性，比基因水平差异表达策略更一致地恢复受干扰的 RBP。总之，这项研究为 DTU 方法评估建立了生物学可解释和数据驱动的标准。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：差异转录本使用 (DTU) 分析揭示了选择性剪接中的转录本水平调控。随着长读长测序在批量、单细胞和空间转录组学中的快速采用，在真实生物条件下对 DTU 方法进行可靠评估变得至关重要。

方法与数据：结合RBP敲除/敲低RNA-seq与实验验证结合关系，提出转录本集合富集分数，比较十种DTU方法。

结果及适用范围：作者发现长短读长及不同组学场景存在方法差异，并更一致地恢复扰动RBP活性。

details.abstractOriginal: Differential transcript usage (DTU) analysis reveals transcript-level regulation in alternative splicing. With the rapid adoption of long-read sequencing in bulk, single-cell, and spatial transcriptomics, reliable evaluation of DTU methods under real biological conditions becomes essential. Current evaluation frameworks mainly rely on simulated data, which can introduce bias and may not reflect true regulatory mechanisms. A real-data-driven framework is constructed to evaluate DTU methods across long-read bulk, single-cell, and spatial transcriptomics. The framework includes two key components. First, a biologically grounded reference transcript set is defined using RNA-binding protein (RBP) knockout or knockdown RNA-seq data together with experimentally validated RBP-transcript interactions. Second, a DTU-specific evaluation metric, the transcript set enrichment score, is introduced to quantify how effectively a method prioritizes reference transcripts in ranked results. The framework is systematically validated for reliability, unbiasedness, stability, effectiveness, and robustness using multiple real RNA-seq datasets. Supported by this validation, ten representative DTU methods are evaluated across long-read and short-read data, revealing performance differences across data types. Beyond evaluating DTU methods, the framework is further extended to predict transcript-level RBP activity, recovering perturbed RBPs more consistently than gene-level differential expression strategies. Together, this study establishes a biologically interpretable and data-driven standard for DTU method evaluation.

items.title: STCGCar: Graph Contrastive Learning with Reliable Augmentation for Spatial Transcriptomics Clustering
items.summary: 可逆网络生成增强视图，多头注意力学习低维表示；在五个Visium、一个STARmap及两个Stereo-seq数据集比较六种方法。 作者报告聚类表现改善，可恢复脑分层并发现乳腺癌候选差异基因。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
基于空间转录组学（ST）数据准确识别空间域可以极大地促进我们对细胞组成和组织组织的理解。虽然图神经网络 (GNN) 在空间聚类方面取得了显着进步，但它们往往对噪声边不敏感，导致已识别的空间域之间出现交叉。在这里，我们介绍一种基于 GNN 的 ST 聚类框架，称为 STCGCar，利用具有可靠增强和冗余减少策略的图对比学习模型。该框架首先在数据预处理后通过可逆网络创建增强视图。随后，使用多头注意力机制学习点的低维嵌入。此外，采用冗余减少策略来减少潜在特征空间中的信息冗余。最后，通过 K 均值聚类描绘空间域，然后进行下游分析。 STCGCar 使用五个 10x Visium 数据集、一个 STARmap 数据集和两个 Stereo-seq 小鼠胚胎数据集，针对六种最先进的聚类方法（即 Seurat、conST、CCST、STAGATE、DeepST 和 GraphST）进行了基准测试。通过使用调整兰德指数（ARI）、归一化互信息（NMI）和四个内部指标进行评估，与其他方法相比，它在四个标记数据集和四个未标记数据集上表现出了出色的聚类性能。此外，STCGCar 准确识别了空间域，并在人类乳腺癌组织中发现了三个潜在的差异表达基因（AZGP1、CD24 和 CCND1）。此外，它还有效地描绘了人类 DLPFC 和成年小鼠脑组织的层结构。 STCGCar 是一个强大的空间域识别工具，展示了其在不同数据集上的有效性和可扩展性。它可以在 https://github.com/plhhnu/STCGCar 上免费获得。

研究问题与设计：基于空间转录组学（ST）数据准确识别空间域可以极大地促进我们对细胞组成和组织组织的理解。虽然图神经网络 (GNN) 在空间聚类方面取得了显着进步，但它们往往对噪声边不敏感，导致已识别的空间域之间出现交叉。

方法与数据：可逆网络生成增强视图，多头注意力学习低维表示；在五个Visium、一个STARmap及两个Stereo-seq数据集比较六种方法。

结果及适用范围：作者报告聚类表现改善，可恢复脑分层并发现乳腺癌候选差异基因。

details.abstractOriginal: Accurately identifying spatial domains based on spatial transcriptomics (ST) data can greatly promote our understanding of cellular composition and tissue organization. While graph neural networks (GNNs) have shown significant advancements in spatial clustering, they tend to be insensitive to noisy edges, leading to intersections among identified spatial domains. Here, we introduce a GNN-based ST Clustering framework, called STCGCar, utilizing a Graph Contrastive learning model with reliable augmentation and redundancy reduction strategies. The framework begins by creating an enhanced view through a reversible network after data preprocessing. Subsequently, low-dimensional embeddings of spots are learned using a multi-head attention mechanism. Moreover, a redundancy reduction strategy is employed to reduce information redundancy in potential feature space. Finally, spatial domains are delineated through K-means clustering, followed by downstream analysis. STCGCar was benchmarked against six state-of-the-art clustering methods (i.e., Seurat, conST, CCST, STAGATE, DeepST, and GraphST) using five 10x Visium datasets, a STARmap dataset, and two Stereo-seq mouse embryo datasets. Through evaluation with adjusted rand index (ARI), normalized mutual information (NMI), and four internal indicators, it demonstrated outstanding clustering performance compared to other methods on four labeled and four unlabeled datasets. Additionally, STCGCar accurately identified spatial domains and discovered three potential differentially expressed genes (AZGP1, CD24, and CCND1) in human breast cancer tissues. Furthermore, it effectively delineated layer structures in human DLPFC and adult mouse brain tissues. STCGCar is a powerful tool for spatial domain identification, showcasing its effectiveness and scalability on diverse datasets. It is freely available at https://github.com/plhhnu/STCGCar.

items.title: Beyond the drug-centric view: Advancing AI virtual cell platforms for environmental perturbation modelling
items.summary: 回顾从数学模型至基础模型及多种组学模态，讨论剂量、时序和混合暴露的数据缺口。 提出标准化环境扰动数据、不确定性评测和监管对齐基准的建议。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
环境暴露对全球发病率和死亡率有重大影响，其生物效应由剂量、暴露持续时间、生命阶段时间以及累积或连续暴露模式等因素决定。随着基于人工智能的虚拟细胞技术的快速发展，当前的框架强调遗传和药理学扰动，而对环境扰动的建模不足。这种不平衡是由于数据可用性、化学空间覆盖和代表性设计方面的基本结构限制，以及缺乏剂量、时间和混合物的标准化注释，而这些是环境扰动的核心决定因素。本综述认为，将环境扰动作为虚拟细胞开发的基本组成部分对于将这些模型扩展到环境和公共卫生应用是必要的。我们回顾了这些扰动预测模型从数学模型到深度学习和基础模型架构的演变，评估了虚拟细胞在基因组、转录组、蛋白质组、代谢组和表组学模式中的工作状态，并展示了目前限制其对环境健康的适用性的系统性差距。我们概述了主要挑战，包括数据稀缺和偏见、环境扰动的代表性不足、多模式整合有限以及基准测试实践薄弱。为了解决这些问题，我们建议开发标准化的环境扰动数据集、集成和独立的多模式架构、不确定性感知评估指标以及符合监管的基准测试框架，这些都旨在推进计算机扰动和非动物测试，促进 3R 范式。

研究问题与设计：环境暴露对全球发病率和死亡率有重大影响，其生物效应由剂量、暴露持续时间、生命阶段时间以及累积或连续暴露模式等因素决定。随着基于人工智能的虚拟细胞技术的快速发展，当前的框架强调遗传和药理学扰动，而对环境扰动的建模不足。

方法与数据：回顾从数学模型至基础模型及多种组学模态，讨论剂量、时序和混合暴露的数据缺口。

结果及适用范围：提出标准化环境扰动数据、不确定性评测和监管对齐基准的建议。

details.abstractOriginal: Environmental exposures contribute substantially to global morbidity and mortality, with their bio¬logical effects shaped by factors such as dose, exposure duration, life-stage timing, and cumulative or sequential exposure patterns. With rapid advances in AI-based virtual cell technologies, current frameworks emphasize genetic and pharmacological perturbations, leaving environmental pertur¬bations insufficiently modelled. This imbalance is due to fundamental structural limitations in data availability, chemical space coverage, and representational design, as well as lacking stand¬ardized annotation of dose, timing, and mixtures, which are core determinants of environmental perturbations. This review argues that incorporating environmental perturbations as a foundational component of virtual cell development is necessary to extend these models toward environmental and public health applications. We review the evolution of these perturbation predictive models from mathematical models to deep learning and foundation model architectures, evaluate the status of virtual cell efforts across genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, metabolomic and phenomic modal-ities, and show the systematic gaps that currently limit their applicability to environmental health. We outline key challenges, including data scarcity and bias, inadequate representation of environ¬mental perturbations, limited multimodal integration, and weak benchmarking practices. To address these issues, we propose the development of standardized environmental perturbation datasets, integrated and standalone multimodal architectures, uncertainty-aware evaluation metrics, and regulatory-aligned benchmarking frameworks, which are all geared toward advancing in silico perturbation and non-animal testing, promoting the 3Rs paradigm.

items.title: CoSAG-nf: A Scalable Nextflow Pipeline for Co-assembly, Optimization, and Interactive Visualization of High-Throughput Single-Cell Genomes
items.summary: Nextflow管线结合sourmash MinHash分组、四核苷酸异常筛除及CheckM2质量选择，支持容器化。 提供高通量共组装、完整度和污染率评估及HTML报告，原文列出MIT代码与Zenodo快照。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
动机单细胞扩增基因组（SAG）对于解决种群内微生物异质性和准确了解微生物暗物质种群的代谢潜力至关重要。然而，通过对单拷贝染色体的单细胞基因组DNA进行多重置换扩增（MDA）产生的SAG高度碎片化且容易受到污染，严重阻碍了高质量的基因组重建和功能分析，极大地限制了其科学应用。相关 SAG 的共同组装可以显着提高基因组质量，但据我们所知，不存在用于高通量处理的自动化分析流程，迫使手动实施复杂的工作流程，而这些工作流程很难扩展到现代数据集大小。结果我们提出了 CoSAG-nf，这是一种针对 SAG 的自动化高通量联合组装和优化分析流程，按照 nf-core 框架标准实施。该分析流程使用 sourmash MinHash 签名执行免对齐聚类，然后采用迭代四核苷酸频率分析来识别并排除共组装组中的异常 SAG。 CheckM2 质量评估指导动态选择最佳 SAG 组合，以优化基因组完整性并最大限度地减少污染。 CoSAG-nf 完全容器化，确保跨不同计算环境（包括 HPC 和云平台）大规模 SAG 数据集的高吞吐量处理的再现性和可扩展性。该分析流程生成包含质量指标和分类注释的全面 HTML 报告，为自动化高通量单细胞基因组重建提供端到端解决方案。可用性 CoSAG-nf 可根据 MIT 许可证免费获得：https://github.com/linfengxu/CoSAG-nf。存档代码存储库快照通过 doi 在 zenodo 上发布：https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21525244。

研究问题与设计：动机单细胞扩增基因组（SAG）对于解决种群内微生物异质性和准确了解微生物暗物质种群的代谢潜力至关重要。然而，通过对单拷贝染色体的单细胞基因组DNA进行多重置换扩增（MDA）产生的SAG高度碎片化且容易受到污染，严重阻碍了高质量的基因组重建和功能分析，极大地限制了其科学应用。

方法与数据：Nextflow管线结合sourmash MinHash分组、四核苷酸异常筛除及CheckM2质量选择，支持容器化。

结果及适用范围：提供高通量共组装、完整度和污染率评估及HTML报告，原文列出MIT代码与Zenodo快照。
details.findings: 结果解读：提供高通量共组装、完整度和污染率评估及HTML报告，原文列出MIT代码与Zenodo快照。
details.limitations:
共组装基于相关SAG组合，不能将组装结果视作每个单细胞的完整独立基因组。

details.abstractOriginal: Motivation Single-cell amplified genomes (SAGs) are crucial for resolving intra-population microbial heterogeneity and accurately understanding the metabolic potential of microbial dark matter populations. However, SAGs generated through multiple displacement amplification (MDA) of genomic DNA from single cells with single-copy chromosomes are highly fragmented and prone to contamination, severely hindering high-quality genome reconstruction and functional analysis, which greatly limits their scientific utility. Co-assembly of related SAGs can substantially improve genome quality, but to our knowledge no automated pipeline exists for high-throughput processing, forcing manual implementation of complex workflows that scale poorly to modern dataset sizes. Results We present CoSAG-nf, an automated high-throughput co-assembly and optimization pipeline for SAGs, implemented following the nf-core framework standards. The pipeline performs alignment-free clustering using sourmash MinHash signatures, then employs iterative tetranucleotide frequency profiling to identify and exclude outlier SAGs from co-assembly groups. CheckM2 quality assessment guides dynamic selection of optimal SAG combinations to optimize genome completeness and minimize contamination. Fully containerized, CoSAG-nf ensures reproducibility and scalability for the high-throughput processing of large-scale SAG datasets across diverse computing environments, including HPC and cloud platforms. The pipeline generates comprehensive HTML reports with quality metrics and taxonomic annotations, providing an end-to-end solution for automated high-throughput single-cell genome reconstruction. Availability CoSAG-nf is freely available under the MIT License at: https://github.com/linfengxu/CoSAG-nf. Archival code repository snapshots are published at zenodo with doi: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21525244.

items.title: When Riemann flows with Wasserstein: Generative Modeling of Probability Distributions on Manifolds
items.summary: 以黎曼最优传输速度训练向量场，结合McCann位移插值和GPU友好的黎曼熵映射。 作者展示超球面潜空间中的单细胞样本生成，以及环面蛋白构象和三角网格分布生成。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
许多科学数据集，例如分子构象集合或单细胞组织测量，自然地被建模为元分布：非欧几里得域上概率测量的分布。现有的生成方法主要假设欧几里得几何，但无法捕捉这种结构。我们介绍黎曼 Wasserstein 熵流匹配（RWEFM），这是黎曼流形 $(\mathcal{M},g)$ 的 Wasserstein 空间 $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathcal{M})$ 上的生成框架。 RWEFM 通过使用 McCann 位移插值作为条件路径，将神经向量场回归到黎曼最优传输速度来进行训练。我们从理论上证实，这种构造可以在 $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathcal{M})$ 上产生有效的流匹配方法，并引入黎曼熵图，这是流形上最佳传输图的 GPU 高效近似。我们的实验表明，通过尊重数据的内在几何形状，RWEFM 可以在超球形潜在空间和环面上的蛋白质构象系综中生成整个单细胞样本。由于 RWEFM 仅需要测地距离和投影算子，因此它不限于具有封闭几何形状的流形，我们通过在一般三角网格上生成分布来演示这一点。

details.abstractOriginal: Many scientific datasets, such as molecular conformational ensembles or single-cell tissue measurements, are naturally modeled as meta-distributions: distributions over probability measures on non-Euclidean domains. Existing generative methods largely assume Euclidean geometry and fail to capture this structure. We introduce Riemannian Wasserstein Entropic Flow Matching (RWEFM), a generative framework on the Wasserstein space $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathcal{M})$ of a Riemannian manifold $(\mathcal{M},g)$. RWEFM is trained by regressing a neural vector field onto Riemannian optimal transport velocities, using McCann displacement interpolations as conditional paths. We confirm theoretically that this construction leads to a valid flow matching approach on $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathcal{M})$ and introduce the Riemannian Entropic Map, a GPU-efficient approximation of the optimal transport map on manifolds. Our experiments show that by respecting the intrinsic geometry of the data, RWEFM can generate whole single-cell samples in hyperspherical latent spaces and protein conformational ensembles on the torus. As RWEFM requires only a geodesic distance and a projection operator, it is not restricted to manifolds with closed-form geometry, which we demonstrate by generating distributions on a general triangulated mesh.

items.updateType: 预印本修订 v2（首次收录）
items.summary: 共享上下文编码结合多个预测分支，使用正交、因子活性及在线方差正则；包含单细胞转录组实验。 作者在视觉、单细胞、健康记录、控制与分子动力学中评估表示及预测能力。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
世界模型构建支持对底层系统进行预测、规划和推理的潜在状态。联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）提供了一种通过预测表示空间中的目标而不是重建观察的每个细节来学习此类状态的直接方法。然而，标准 JEPA 通过一种目标嵌入和一种预测路径来组织所有可预测的内容。在复杂系统中，这种整体状态可以将冗余容量分配给主导信号，同时为不太主导的预测结构提供弱或冲突的梯度。我们引入 \method，一种基于正交预测分解的潜在世界建模框架。学习的基础矩阵将每个目标状态分析为多个组件，并且专用预测分支根据共享上下文表示估计每个组件。预测回归保留状态合成所需的因子大小，正交目标阻止重复方向，因子活动正则化保持预测目标的变化，在线方差正则化阻止坐标编码器崩溃。预测的组件被合成为完整的潜在状态，可供读出器、解码器、规划器或自回归推出使用。当目标在时间上是未来的、在空间上是隐藏的或同一系统的另一个部分观察时，同样的预测状态机制适用。受控视觉、单细胞转录组学、纵向健康记录、连续控制和分子动力学实验评估表征质量、预测、规划和长期稳定性。

details.abstractOriginal: World models construct latent states that support prediction, planning, and reasoning about an underlying system. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) offer a direct way to learn such states by predicting targets in representation space instead of reconstructing every detail of the observation. Standard JEPAs, however, organize all predictable content through one target embedding and one prediction pathway. In complex systems, this monolithic state can allocate redundant capacity to dominant signals while providing weak or conflicting gradients to less dominant predictive structure. We introduce \method, a latent world-modeling framework based on orthogonal predictive factorization. Learned basis matrices analyze each target state into multiple components, and a dedicated prediction branch estimates each component from a shared context representation. Predictive regression preserves the factor magnitudes required for state synthesis, an orthogonality objective discourages repeated directions, factor-activity regularization maintains variation in projected targets, and online variance regularization discourages coordinate-wise encoder collapse. Predicted components are synthesized into a complete latent state that can be used by a readout, decoder, planner, or autoregressive rollout. The same predictive-state mechanism applies when the target is temporally future, spatially hidden, or another partial observation of the same system. Experiments on controlled vision, single-cell transcriptomics, longitudinal health records, continuous control, and molecular dynamics evaluate representation quality, forecasting, planning, and long-horizon stability.

items.title: Saddlepoint approximations for plug-in resampling
items.updateType: 预印本修订 v6（首次收录）
items.summary: 针对条件独立项之和建立Lugannani–Rice相对误差界，并用模拟和单细胞CRISPR数据评估spaCRT。 作者报告接近dCRT的p值与统计表现，特定实验计算最高加速250倍。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
基于重采样的过程可以改进稀疏、大规模测试问题中的正态近似，但其计算成本可能令人望而却步。我们认识到，几个现有程序属于更快的插件重采样子类，在重采样期间修复拟合的干扰参数。当重采样统计量是条件独立项的总和时，重采样 $p$ 值的鞍点近似 (SPA) 提供进一步的加速，用分析尾部近似代替重采样。然而，基于标准埃奇沃斯的近似误差界限强加了难以验证插件重采样定律的规律性条件。我们使用另一种方法在更容易处理的条件下为 Lugannani-Rice 近似建立有限样本相对误差界，并将其应用于两种情况。在统计遗传学中，我们将响应重采样程序确定为现有 SPA 的目标，并在代表性环境中建立保证。在条件独立性测试中，我们引入了spaCRT，这是一种用于蒸馏条件随机化测试（dCRT）的SPA，已在生物学中成功应用。我们的速率量化了稀疏性和信号强度的影响，并在特殊情况下匹配下限。我们还在日益稀疏的情况下建立了相应插件重采样过程的渐近 I 类误差控制。在模拟和单细胞 CRISPR 数据分析中，spaCRT 非常接近 dCRT $p$ 值，并保留其统计性能，同时将计算速度提高高达 250 倍。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：基于重采样的过程可以改进稀疏、大规模测试问题中的正态近似，但其计算成本可能令人望而却步。我们认识到，几个现有程序属于更快的插件重采样子类，在重采样期间修复拟合的干扰参数。

方法与数据：针对条件独立项之和建立Lugannani–Rice相对误差界，并用模拟和单细胞CRISPR数据评估spaCRT。

结果及适用范围：作者报告接近dCRT的p值与统计表现，特定实验计算最高加速250倍。

details.abstractOriginal: Resampling-based procedures can improve on normal approximations in sparse, large-scale testing problems, but their computational cost can be prohibitive. We recognize that several existing procedures belong to a faster plug-in resampling subclass, fixing fitted nuisance parameters during resampling. When the resampled statistic is a sum of conditionally independent terms, the saddlepoint approximation (SPA) for the resampling $p$-value offers further acceleration, replacing resampling with an analytical tail approximation. However, standard Edgeworth-based approximation-error bounds impose regularity conditions that are hard to verify for plug-in resampling laws. We use an alternative approach to establish a finite-sample relative-error bound for the Lugannani-Rice approximation under more tractable conditions, which we apply in two contexts. In statistical genetics, we identify response resampling procedures as the targets of existing SPAs and establish guarantees in a representative setting. In conditional independence testing, we introduce spaCRT, an SPA for the distilled conditional randomization test (dCRT), which has been applied successfully in biology. Our rates quantify the effects of sparsity and signal strength, with matching lower bounds in special cases. We additionally establish asymptotic Type-I error control of the corresponding plug-in resampling procedures under growing sparsity. In simulations and single-cell CRISPR data analysis, spaCRT closely approximates dCRT $p$-values and preserves its statistical performance while accelerating computation by up to 250-fold.

items.title: Proxy-Adjusted Causal Discovery from Targeted Interventions
items.summary: 使用目标干预识别祖先，在匹配条件下比较条件分布增益；含模拟、K562校准计数模拟及Perturb-seq应用。 在假设成立时给出图识别与错误控制条件；真实K562数据展示描述性候选网络。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
随机扰动可以揭示下游响应，而无需确定哪些因果关系是直接的。即使来源是随机的，对中间反应的调节也可能通过不可测量的常见原因引起关联。我们引入代理调整平衡掩码（PABM），这是一种非参数框架，用于从有针对性的干预、响应数据和记录的代理中恢复有向无环图。 PABM 使用有效的特定目标干预措施来识别候选祖先。然后，它比较有和没有候选响应的条件目标分布，并且在设计支持时，其干预变量，调整其他祖先和代理。每次比较都使用匹配的观察结果、调整变量和拟合程序。识别要求每个包含的非亲本比较具有零条件增益，并且每个亲本在至少一个比较中具有正增益。我们建立了总体识别、有限样本恢复条件，以适应不完全调整和估计误差，以及有效保留 p 值下的家庭误差控制。连续响应模拟显示相对于指定比较器分析流程的良好图形恢复； K562 校准计数模拟揭示了选择与排名之间的权衡。代理消融评估对记录信息的敏感性。对 K562 Perturb-seq 数据的分析说明了描述性候选网络构建；未测量的生物变异的代理充分性仍未得到解决。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：随机扰动可以揭示下游响应，而无需确定哪些因果关系是直接的。即使来源是随机的，对中间反应的调节也可能通过不可测量的常见原因引起关联。

方法与数据：使用目标干预识别祖先，在匹配条件下比较条件分布增益；含模拟、K562校准计数模拟及Perturb-seq应用。

结果及适用范围：在假设成立时给出图识别与错误控制条件；真实K562数据展示描述性候选网络。

details.abstractOriginal: Randomized perturbations can reveal downstream responses without identifying which causal relationships are direct. Conditioning on intermediate responses may induce associations through unmeasured common causes, even when the source is randomized. We introduce Proxy-Adjusted Balanced Masking (PABM), a nonparametric framework for recovering directed acyclic graphs from targeted interventions, response data, and recorded proxies. PABM uses valid target-specific interventions to identify candidate ancestors. It then compares conditional target distributions with and without a candidate response and, when supported by the design, its intervention variable, adjusting for other ancestors and proxies. Each comparison uses matched observations, adjustment variables, and fitting procedures. Identification requires every included nonparent comparison to have zero conditional gain and each parent to have positive gain in at least one comparison. We establish population identification, finite-sample recovery conditions that accommodate incomplete adjustment and estimation error, and familywise error control under valid held-out p-values. Continuous-response simulations show favorable graph recovery relative to specified comparator pipelines; K562-calibrated count simulations reveal a selection--ranking tradeoff. Proxy ablations assess sensitivity to recorded information. An analysis of K562 Perturb-seq data illustrates descriptive candidate-network construction; proxy adequacy for unmeasured biological variation remains unresolved.

items.title: Finite Topological Space Filtrations: A Topological Framework for Data Analysis
items.updateType: 预印本修订 v3（首次收录）
items.summary: 从距离矩阵构建逐步变粗的有限拓扑，保留邻域与分量信息；评估合成数据、Paul15单细胞数据和COIL20。 展示细胞细状态及其组成较大群体的过程，以及连接点移除的影响。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
我们引入了基于有限拓扑空间过滤的数据分析框架。从有限度量数据集开始，我们在同一组点上构造一系列粗化拓扑。这些拓扑以通常的方式提供持久性模块和条形码，但它们也保留了当过滤减少到同源时丢失的信息。例如，在每个级别，人们可以检查哪些点在拓扑上无法区分，它们的最小邻域如何重叠，连接的组件如何合并，以及这些特征如何从一个级别变化到下一个级别。我们发展了这些过滤的基本理论，在适当的假设下建立稳定性结果，并直接从距离矩阵开始给出实际的构造。然后我们研究可以从所得的有限拓扑中学到什么。在具有不同形状、大小和密度的已知​​簇的合成数据上，我们研究这些区域如何出现在有限拓扑结构中以及它们如何随着拓扑粗化而合并。我们还研究了当在构建早期发现的点被删除并重复分析时会发生什么。对于一维同调，我们使用有限拓扑结构中的路径来定位循环并检查它们的外观与数据的几何形状之间的关系。我们最终将这些想法应用于两个结构完全不同的真实数据集。在 Paul15 单细胞数据上，我们使用不断演化的有限拓扑来检查精细细胞状态、它们的重叠和关系、它们组装成更大的组，以及删除连接这些结构的点的效果。在 COIL20 上，通过完整旋转对对象的图像进行采样，我们研究图像的循环组织如何反映在有限拓扑演化和相关的一维同源性中。

结果及适用范围：展示细胞细状态及其组成较大群体的过程，以及连接点移除的影响。

details.abstractOriginal:
We introduce a data-analysis framework based on filtrations of finite topological spaces. Starting from a finite metric data set, we construct a sequence of coarsening topologies on the same set of points. These topologies give persistence modules and barcodes in the usual way, but they also retain information that is lost when the filtration is reduced to homology. At each level one can examine, for example, which points are topologically indistinguishable, how their minimal neighbourhoods overlap, how connected components merge, and how these features change from one level to the next.
 We develop the basic theory of these filtrations, establish stability results under suitable hypotheses, and give practical constructions starting directly from a distance matrix. We then study what can be learned from the resulting finite topologies. On synthetic data with known clusters of different shapes, sizes, and densities, we examine how these regions appear among the finite-topological structures and how they merge as the topology coarsens. We also study what happens when points that become uncovered early in the construction are removed and the analysis is repeated. For one-dimensional homology, we use paths in the finite-topological structure to locate cycles and to examine how their appearance is related to the geometry of the data.
 We finally apply these ideas to two real data sets with quite different structures. On the Paul15 single-cell data, we use the evolving finite topology to examine fine cellular states, their overlaps and relations, their assembly into larger groups, and the effect of removing points that connect these structures. On COIL20, where images of an object are sampled through a full rotation, we study how the cyclic organization of the images is reflected in the finite-topological evolution and in the associated one-dimensional homology.

items.title: When models choose metrics: Hidden geometry in computational biology
items.summary: Perspective讨论Fisher信息局部度量及RNA-seq方差稳定化与模型隐含距离的联系。 主张显式说明噪声、依赖和潜在干扰假设，并在失配时开展经验或敏感性比较。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
计算生物学通常将生物测量结果转化为拟合模型、嵌入或摘要，然后将它们与主要按惯例选择的距离进行比较。这种选择可以影响所回答的科学问题，因为不同的距离强调关于噪声、变异和生物相似性的不同假设。本视角描述了当概率模型被足够仔细地指定以支持局部度量结构时可能出现的隐藏几何结构。对于常规参数模型，Fisher 信息定义了一个自然的局部度量，使距离选择成为模型规范的一部分，而不是单独的绘图或聚类首选项。信息几何不是取代熟悉的启发式方法，而是有助于解释常见变换（例如 RNA-seq 的方差稳定性）何时近似模型隐含的距离；当依赖性或潜在的滋扰结构限制该近似时；当错误指定使得经验比较、非参数比较或基于敏感性的比较更合适时。目标是更清晰、更明确地选择度量标准。

details.abstractOriginal: Computational biology often turns biological measurements into fitted models, embeddings, or summaries and then compares them with a distance chosen largely by convention. That choice can shape the scientific question being answered, because different distances emphasize different assumptions about noise, variation, and biological similarity. This Perspective describes the hidden geometry that can arise when a probabilistic model is specified carefully enough to support local metric structure. For regular parametric models, the Fisher information defines a natural local metric, making distance choice part of model specification rather than a separate plotting or clustering preference. Rather than replacing familiar heuristics, information geometry helps explain when common transformations, such as variance stabilization for RNA-seq, approximate a model-implied distance; when dependence or latent nuisance structure limits that approximation; and when misspecification makes empirical, nonparametric, or sensitivity-based comparisons more appropriate. The goal is a clearer, more explicit practice of metric choice.

items.title: Semi-metric optimal transport enables robust spatial multi-omics integration
items.summary: 采用总变差松弛的Fused Partial Gromov-Wasserstein策略，处理组成、技术和分辨率差异。 作者报告多研究中的对齐、整合与分层，并构建代表性组织重心。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
摘要：整合异构空间多组学数据以揭示潜在的生物学和病理机制仍然是一个重大挑战，而现有方法通常缺乏用于比较复杂空间组织的数学上合理的距离。我们介绍了空间最优传输（SpaOT），这是一种空间多组学集成框架，基于不平衡最优传输的理论基础半度量公式。 SpaOT 利用总变差松弛融合部分 Gromov-Wasserstein 策略，建立了数学上一致的距离几何结构，可实现稳定的生物比较、代表性组织重心和稳健的下游分析，同时适应细胞组成、测量技术、空间分辨率和噪声的差异。在具有不同空间组学的多项研究中，SpaOT 能够在复杂的疾病相关生物系统中跨样本、分辨率和组学模式进行稳健且准确的对齐、集成和分层。这些功能有助于识别具有生物学意义的细胞组织、分子特征和空间关系，将 SpaOT 建立为空间多组学集成和比较分析的通用基础。

details.abstractOriginal: Abstract    Integrating heterogeneous spatial multi-omics data to uncover underlying biological and pathological mechanisms remains a major challenge, while existing approaches generally lack mathematically justified distances for comparing complex spatial tissues. We introduce Spatial Optimal Transport (SpaOT), a spatial multi-omics integration framework based on a theoretically grounded semi-metric formulation of unbalanced optimal transport. Utilizing a total-variation-relaxed Fused Partial Gromov-Wasserstein strategy, SpaOT establishes a mathematically consistent distance geometry that enables stable biological comparison, representative tissue barycenters, and robust downstream analyses while accommodating differences in cellular composition, measurement technologies, spatial resolution, and noise. Across multiple studies with diverse spatial omics, SpaOT enables robust and accurate alignment, integration, and stratifications across samples, resolutions, and omics modalities in complex disease-related biological systems. These capabilities facilitate the identification of biologically meaningful cellular organization, molecular signatures, and spatial relationships, establishing SpaOT as a general foundation for spatial multi-omics integration and comparative analysis.

items.title: Detecting cell segmentation errors using doublet methods
items.summary: 在16个空间数据集评测8种doublet方法，把分割误差建模为相邻细胞转录本损失与混入的连续谱。 混入程度及相邻表达差异越大越易检测；cxds2、scDblFinder.score和unique_genes基线表现较好。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
在空间转录组学中，细胞分割用于绘制细胞周围的边界。位于细胞边界内的分子被分配给它，使其基因表达谱依赖于分割精度。为了识别潜在有问题的细胞，研究越来越多地使用双联体检测方法，这是一类为在 scRNA-seq 中识别两个细胞的分子混合物而开发的算法。为了评估它们在空间数据中的适用性，我们将细胞分割错误建模为相邻细胞之间部分分子混合物的连续体，这是通过改变细胞自身转录本的损失和来自其邻居的转录本的增益而产生的。我们评估了 16 个空间数据集的 8 种双峰方法，描述了它们表现良好的条件并确定了它们的失效模式。随着相邻细胞之间分子混合物和转录差异的增加，检测效果得到改善，其中 cxds2、scDblFinder.score 和简单基线 (unique_genes) 表现最佳。这些模式在跨越不同基因组、技术平台、染色技术、分割算法和错误频率的数据集中是一致的。在不受干扰的空间数据中，升高的双峰分数定位于与分割问题一致的区域，这表明它们可以帮助优先考虑细胞或区域以进行检查、分割细化或转录本重新分配。我们的结果表明，双联体方法何时可以为细胞分割提供有用的质量控制信号，支持其在空间转录组学中的使用。

details.abstractOriginal: In spatial transcriptomics, cell segmentation is used to draw boundaries around cells. Molecules located within a cell's boundary are assigned to it, making its gene expression profile dependent on segmentation accuracy. To identify potentially problematic cells, studies increasingly use doublet detection methods, a class of algorithms developed to recognize molecular admixture from two cells in scRNA-seq. To evaluate their suitability in spatial data, we model cell segmentation errors as a continuum of partial molecular admixture between neighboring cells, generated by varying the loss of a cell's own transcripts and the gain of transcripts from its neighbor. Evaluating 8 doublet methods across 16 spatial datasets, we characterize the conditions under which they perform well and identify their failure modes. Detection improves with increasing molecular admixture and transcriptional dissimilarity between neighboring cells, with cxds2, scDblFinder.score, and a simple baseline (unique_genes) performing best. These patterns are consistent across datasets spanning different gene panels, technological platforms, staining techniques, segmentation algorithms, and error frequencies. In unperturbed spatial data, elevated doublet scores localize to regions consistent with segmentation problems, suggesting that they can help prioritize cells or regions for inspection, segmentation refinement, or transcript reassignment. Our results establish when doublet methods can provide useful quality control signals for cell segmentation, supporting their use in spatial transcriptomics.

items.title: Trace-n-Seq combines retrograde fluorescent tracing with sorting and single-cell sequencing of innervating peripheral neurons
items.summary: 结合Fast Blue逆行示踪、神经节解离、荧光分选与单细胞RNA测序，完整流程约两周。 可识别器官相关神经元亚型及表达，减少同神经节中未参与支配的细胞背景。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
神经元神经支配在体内平衡和再生过程中以及在炎症、自身免疫性疾病、纤维化和癌症等病理情况下控制组织功能中发挥着关键作用。在分子水平上理解神经元-组织相互作用的一个主要障碍是神经元细胞体驻留在周围神经节中，通常远离感兴趣的器官，因此通常被排除在常见的组织单细胞数据集中。在这里，我们开发了 Trace-n-Seq 来解决这个问题——一种将逆行追踪与荧光激活细胞分选和单细胞测序相结合的方法，以对支配健康或患病组织的单个神经元进行分子分析。 Trace-n-Seq 可用于以单细胞分辨率探索外周神经元的特定基因表达特征。该方法利用固蓝逆行轴突追踪、神经节解离和荧光激活细胞分选，然后进行单细胞 RNA 测序，以实现神经节的分离和转录组分析。与不带逆行标记的批量或全神经节单细胞 RNA 测序不同，Trace-n-Seq 允许以单细胞分辨率表征器官特异性神经元，消除来自同一神经节中不相关神经元和不相关细胞类型的背景。该程序使研究人员能够获得组织支配神经元的分子转录组，并研究它们的可塑性、亚型身份以及与组织微环境的潜在相互作用。完整的 Trace-n-Seq 工作流程可在 2 周内完成，适合具有分子生物学、神经元组织处理、测序技术和生物信息分析经验的研究人员。

details.abstractOriginal: Neuronal innervation plays a pivotal role in controlling tissue function during homeostasis and regeneration, as well as in pathological contexts such as inflammation, autoimmune disorders, fibrosis and cancer. A major obstacle in understanding neuron-tissue interactions at the molecular level is that neuronal cell bodies reside in peripheral ganglia often far outside the organ of interest and are therefore typically excluded in common single-cell datasets of tissues. Here we developed Trace-n-Seq to address this issue-a method that combines retrograde tracing with fluorescence-activated cell sorting and single-cell sequencing to molecularly profile individual neurons innervating healthy or diseased tissues. Trace-n-Seq can be used to explore the specific gene expression signatures of peripheral neurons at single-cell resolution. The method utilizes retrograde axonal tracing using Fast Blue, ganglia dissociation and fluorescence-activated cell sorting followed by single-cell RNA sequencing to enable the isolation and transcriptomic analysis of ganglia. Unlike bulk or whole-ganglia single-cell RNA sequencing without retrograde labeling, Trace-n-Seq allows the characterization of organ-specific neurons with single-cell resolution, eliminating background from uninvolved neurons and unrelated cell types located in the same ganglion. The procedure allows researchers to obtain molecular transcriptomes of tissue-innervating neurons and to study their plasticity, subtype identity and potential interactions with the tissue microenvironment. The complete Trace-n-Seq workflow can be performed in 2 weeks and is suitable for researchers with experience in molecular biology, neuronal tissue handling, sequencing techniques and bioinformatic analysis.

items.title: iPscDB: a comprehensive platform for plant single-cell transcriptomic data integration and analysis
items.summary: 汇集946项实验、4688428个细胞及288139个标记；有原始数据时统一重处理并评测整合和注释。 提供标记置信等级、在线分析及跨物种和轨迹探索功能。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
单细胞技术的快速进步显着增强了我们研究植物组织内细胞异质性的能力。然而，破译这些复杂的细胞景观需要处理高维基因表达矩阵并整合不同的数据集，以实现准确的标记选择、细胞识别和其他复杂的计算操作。这些过程通常需要广泛的编程专业知识，这对计算背景有限的研究人员构成了挑战。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了集成植物单细胞数据库（iPscDB），这是一个集成的多功能平台，有助于植物单细胞数据的集成和分析。 iPscDB 结合了来自 38 个植物物种的 946 个实验的 4 688 428 个细胞和 288 139 个整理细胞标记。只要有原始数据，数据集就通过单一统一的分析流程进行重新处理，并对集成质量和自动细胞类型注释进行定量基准测试。该平台引入了标记置信度方案，根据支持证据的强度和独立性（从人工整理的经典标记到数据库衍生的关联）对每个细胞类型标记进行分级，允许用户直接判断标记的可靠性。该平台还提供用户友好的在线分析分析流程和模块，能够处理原始 FASTQ 文件或 Cell Ranger 处理的文件。用户可以通过直观的界面配置参数，并利用集成图像编辑器定制可视化输出。此外，iPscDB 支持各种分析，包括跨物种基因表达、电子单细胞象形图和发育轨迹。通过简化单细胞转录组学的复杂工作流程，iPscDB 为具有不同技术背景的研究人员提供了实用且易于访问的资源。 iPscDB 可通过 https://www.tobaccodb.org/ipscdb/homePage 访问。

方法与数据：汇集946项实验、4688428个细胞及288139个标记；有原始数据时统一重处理并评测整合和注释。

结果及适用范围：提供标记置信等级、在线分析及跨物种和轨迹探索功能。

details.abstractOriginal: The rapid advancement of single-cell technologies has significantly enhanced our ability to investigate cellular heterogeneity within plant tissues. However, deciphering these intricate cellular landscapes requires processing high-dimensional gene expression matrices and integrating diverse datasets to enable accurate marker selection, cell identification, and other complex computational operations. These processes typically require broad programming expertise, posing a challenge for researchers with a limited computational background. To address this, we present integrated Plant single-cell Database (iPscDB), an integrated and multifunctional platform that facilitates the integration and analysis of plant single-cell data. iPscDB combines 4 688 428 cells and 288 139 curated cell markers derived from 946 experiments across 38 plant species. Wherever raw data were available, datasets were reprocessed through a single uniform pipeline, and both integration quality and automated cell-type annotation were benchmarked quantitatively. The platform introduces a Marker Confidence Level scheme that grades each cell-type marker by the strength and independence of its supporting evidence (from manually curated classic markers to database-derived associations), allowing users to judge marker reliability directly. The platform also provides a user-friendly online analysis pipeline and modules capable of processing raw FASTQ files or Cell Ranger-processed files. Users can configure parameters via an intuitive interface and utilize an integrated image editor to customize visualization outputs. Additionally, iPscDB supports various analyses, including cross-species gene expression, electronic Single-Cell Pictograph, and developmental trajectory. By streamlining the complex workflows of single-cell transcriptomics, iPscDB offers a practical and accessible resource for researchers with diverse technical backgrounds. iPscDB is accessible at https://www.tobaccodb.org/ipscdb/homePage.

items.title: Post‐Hoc Long‐Read Sequencing Links Leukemic Mutation Status to Single‐Cell Transcriptomes
items.summary: 利用10x 3端流程的扩增cDNA进行PacBio靶向测序，在KIT/BCR::ABL1混合细胞系及原代CML样本评估。 可关联部分突变和细胞表达；靶标特异阈值减少误分类，治疗期间样本未检出BCR::ABL1阳性细胞。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
基于单细胞 RNA 测序的肿瘤克隆细胞特征是恶性和正常细胞共存的血液肿瘤的主要挑战。可靠的分子分析需要同时分析单个细胞中的基因表达和基因突变，而标准 10X Genomics 工作流程不支持这种能力。在这里，我们系统地评估了将 10X Genomics 3' 工作流程中生成的扩增 cDNA 重新用于单个细胞事后基因分型的潜力和局限性。我们首先建立了一个混合白血病细胞系系统，其中包括一个具有 KIT 点突变的细胞系和另一个具有 BCR::ABL1 融合基因的细胞系。靶向长读长 PacBio 测序能够将突变数据事后分配给转录分析的细胞，但目标之间的恢复情况不同。与基于微流体的单细胞工作流程中的环境 RNA 一致，在预计不会携带相应突变的细胞中检测到了与突变相关的转录本，这说明了转录本恢复如何使细胞水平基因型分配变得复杂。特定目标的阈值减轻了这种错误分类的根源。在原发性慢性粒细胞白血病样本中，事后方法在诊断时检测到了 BCR::ABL1 阳性细胞，但在伊马替尼治疗期间未检测到。我们共同提出了一个框架，用于向已使用 10X Genomics 工作流程分析的细胞添加突变状态，并强调基于转录本的单细胞基因分型的更广泛的考虑因素。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：基于单细胞 RNA 测序的肿瘤克隆细胞特征是恶性和正常细胞共存的血液肿瘤的主要挑战。可靠的分子分析需要同时分析单个细胞中的基因表达和基因突变，而标准 10X Genomics 工作流程不支持这种能力。

方法与数据：利用10x 3端流程的扩增cDNA进行PacBio靶向测序，在KIT/BCR::ABL1混合细胞系及原代CML样本评估。

结果及适用范围：可关联部分突变和细胞表达；靶标特异阈值减少误分类，治疗期间样本未检出BCR::ABL1阳性细胞。

环境RNA和靶标恢复差异影响分型；未检出不能直接解释为无残留恶性细胞。

details.abstractOriginal: Single-cell RNA-sequencing-based characterization of cells that belong to the neoplastic clone is a major challenge in hematologic neoplasms, where malignant and normal cells coexist. Confident molecular profiling requires simultaneous analysis of gene expression and genetic mutations in individual cells, an ability that is not supported by the standard 10X Genomics workflow. Here, we systematically evaluated the potential and limitations of repurposing amplified cDNA generated during the 10X Genomics 3' workflow for post hoc genotyping of individual cells. We first established a mixed leukemic cell line system comprising one cell line with KIT point mutations and another with the BCR::ABL1 fusion gene. Targeted long-read PacBio sequencing enabled post hoc assignment of mutation data to transcriptionally profiled cells, but recovery differed between targets. Consistent with ambient RNA in microfluidics-based single-cell workflows, mutation-associated transcripts were detected in cells not expected to carry the corresponding mutations, illustrating how transcript recovery complicates cell-level genotype assignment. Target-specific thresholds mitigated this source of misclassification. In primary chronic myeloid leukemia samples, the post hoc approach detected BCR::ABL1-positive cells at diagnosis, but not during imatinib treatment. Together, we present a framework for adding mutation status to cells already profiled using the 10X Genomics workflow and highlight broader considerations for transcript-based single-cell genotyping.

items.title: ConvexGating infers gating strategies from clusters in single cell cytometry data
items.summary: 由多标记聚类推导低污染门控，分选CD8亚型与脂肪祖细胞后用单细胞测序验证。 作者展示已知和未知群体的分选策略，且可迁移到CyTOF及CITE-seq并辅助标记面板设计。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
手动专家门控仍然是定义流式细胞术数据中特定细胞群的常见做法，但测量参数数量的增加和评估者之间的高变异性限制了研究的一致性。基于聚类的方法使用完整的标记空间来更一致地定义细胞群，但它们的输出不能直接在细胞分选仪上实现。在这里，我们开发了 ConvexGating，一种人工智能工具，通过自动学习可解释的门控策略来解决这一差距，以无偏见、数据驱动的方式进行分类，为已知和以前未知的细胞群（包括仅被识别为 CD57-CD13-CD45RA+ CD123+ 细胞的浆细胞样树突细胞）生成低污染策略。我们展示了 ConvexGating 衍生出针对 CD8+ 亚型和脂肪祖细胞群的分选策略，我们通过分选细胞的单细胞测序进行实验验证。我们还证明，该方法可以通过飞行时间有效地转移到细胞计数法，并通过测序数据对转录组和表位进行细胞索引，并改进细胞分选的标记面板设计。

方法与数据：由多标记聚类推导低污染门控，分选CD8亚型与脂肪祖细胞后用单细胞测序验证。

结果及适用范围：作者展示已知和未知群体的分选策略，且可迁移到CyTOF及CITE-seq并辅助标记面板设计。

details.abstractOriginal: Manual expert gating remains common practice for defining specific cell populations in flow cytometry data, but increasing numbers of measured parameters and high inter-rater variability limit consistency across studies. Cluster-based approaches use the full marker space to define cell populations more consistently, but their outputs cannot be directly implemented on a cell sorter. Here we develop ConvexGating, an artificial intelligence tool to address this gap by automatically learning interpretable gating strategies for sorting in an unbiased, data-driven manner, generating low-contamination strategies for both known and previously unknown cell populations, including plasmacytoid dendritic cells identified solely as CD57-CD13-CD45RA+ CD123+ cells. We show that ConvexGating derives sorting strategies for CD8+ subtypes and adipose progenitor cell populations, which we validate experimentally by single-cell sequencing of sorted cells. We also demonstrate that the method transfers effectively to Cytometry by Time of Flight and Cellular Indexing of Transcriptomes and Epitopes by Sequencing data and improves marker panel design for cell sorting.

items.title: Benchmarking Active Spot Selection for Cost-Efficient Spatial Transcriptomics
items.summary: 在两个已完整测量的公开空间转录组队列上进行回顾性池式模拟；比较MC-dropout、TOD、CoreSet和TypiClust启发式策略与随机选点，在患者级交叉验证下测试5%、10%、30%和50%预算，共160个完成配置。 作者以逐基因切片内PCC、表达聚类一致性及Moran's I保真度评估；HER2阳性乳腺癌中各策略与随机采样的平均PCC差异随预算变动，cSCC中多个策略在小预算下低于随机，整体结论为固定训练时长下主动策略不能稳定改善小预算表现，且排名依赖指标。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
空间转录组学 (ST) 测量组织环境中的基因表达，但密集的捕获网格可能成本高昂，并且可能会重复对形态相似的区域进行采样。大多数主动学习策略都是针对分类标签和独立样本开发的。我们对 ST 的主动学习与统一随机抽样进行了基于回顾性池的基准测试，其中表达向量是高维且连续的，并且候选者在空间上相关。使用两个完全描述的公共 ST 队列，我们​​掩盖候选表达向量并通过基于不确定性的蒙特卡罗辍学（MC-dropout）和时间输出差异（TOD）以及基于多样性的 CoreSet 和 TypiClust 启发的选择来模拟多轮选择。我们在患者级交叉验证下比较了 160 个已完成的配置，占折叠宽度训练点池的 5%、10%、30% 和 50%，并具有单独的全标签参考。在每个预算中，策略共享选择时间表、形态到表达预测器和优化方案。我们评估幻灯片内每个基因的平均 Pearson 相关系数 (PCC)、表达簇一致性和 Moran's I 保真度。对于 HER2 阳性乳腺癌，四种主动策略与随机的汇总平均 PCC 差异分别为 -0.0176、-0.0117、+0.0056 和 +0.0057，分别为 5%、10%、30% 和 50%。对于皮肤鳞状细胞癌 (cSCC)，三种策略均低于随机策略的 5%，所有四种策略均低于随机策略的 10%。对于 HER2 阳性乳腺癌，在两个最小预算下，CoreSet 和 MC-dropout 的 PCC 较低，但表达簇一致性高于 Random；这种模式在 cSCC 上没有重现。在报告的固定训练范围内，评估的主动策略在小预算下并不能持续改进随机策略，并且排名取决于评估措施。

方法与数据：在两个已完整测量的公开空间转录组队列上进行回顾性池式模拟；比较MC-dropout、TOD、CoreSet和TypiClust启发式策略与随机选点，在患者级交叉验证下测试5%、10%、30%和50%预算，共160个完成配置。

details.abstractOriginal: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) measures gene expression in tissue context, but dense capture grids can be costly and may repeatedly sample morphologically similar regions. Most active learning strategies were developed for categorical labels and independent samples. We conduct a retrospective pool-based benchmark of active learning versus uniform Random sampling for ST, where expression vectors are high-dimensional and continuous and candidates are spatially correlated. Using two fully profiled public ST cohorts, we mask candidate expression vectors and simulate multi-round selection with uncertainty-based Monte Carlo dropout (MC-dropout) and temporal output discrepancy (TOD), and diversity-based CoreSet and TypiClust-inspired selection. We compare 160 completed configurations at 5%, 10%, 30%, and 50% of the fold-wide training spot pool under patient-level cross-validation, with a separate full-label reference. Within each budget, strategies share the selection schedule, morphology-to-expression predictor, and optimization protocol. We assess mean per-gene within-slide Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC), expression-cluster agreement, and Moran's I fidelity. On HER2-positive breast cancer, pooled mean PCC differences from Random across the four active strategies were -0.0176, -0.0117, +0.0056, and +0.0057 at 5%, 10%, 30%, and 50%, respectively. On cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC), three strategies were below Random at 5%, and all four were below Random at 10%. On HER2-positive breast cancer, CoreSet and MC-dropout had lower PCC but higher expression-cluster agreement than Random at the two smallest budgets; this pattern did not reproduce on cSCC. Under the reported fixed training horizons, the evaluated active strategies do not consistently improve on Random at small budgets, and rankings depend on the evaluation measure.

items.title: PRAXIS-VirtualCell: A Programmable and Trustworthy Framework for Agentic Virtual Cell Experiments
items.summary: 模块化组织生物数据、预测模型、扰动、适配器、执行环境和验证证据，并用生物学契约和证据感知执行处理跨物种任务；覆盖大肠杆菌、酵母与人K562细胞。 作者称该系统可将自然语言问题转为可追溯的虚拟实验，并区分有证据支持的预测、外推与弃答。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
虚拟细胞正在从单任务预测模型向可编程生物模拟系统发展，但异构数据、模型和验证证据仍然缺乏统一的组织框架。在这里，我们介绍 PRAXIS-VirtualCell，这是一个模块化框架，用于组织生物数据、预测模型、扰动、适配器、执行环境和验证证据，以实现可重复和可审核的虚拟实验。该系统支持涵盖大肠杆菌、酿酒酵母和人类 K562 细胞的跨物种任务，同时使用生物契约和证据感知执行来区分支持的预测与外推和弃权。通过进一步集成代理编排，PRAXIS-VirtualCell 自动将自然语言问题转换为可追踪的虚拟实验，为值得信赖且可扩展的 Virtual Cell 系统提供统一的运行时基础。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：虚拟细胞正在从单任务预测模型向可编程生物模拟系统发展，但异构数据、模型和验证证据仍然缺乏统一的组织框架。在这里，我们介绍 PRAXIS-VirtualCell，这是一个模块化框架，用于组织生物数据、预测模型、扰动、适配器、执行环境和验证证据，以实现可重复和可审核的虚拟实验。

方法与数据：模块化组织生物数据、预测模型、扰动、适配器、执行环境和验证证据，并用生物学契约和证据感知执行处理跨物种任务；覆盖大肠杆菌、酵母与人K562细胞。

结果及适用范围：作者称该系统可将自然语言问题转为可追溯的虚拟实验，并区分有证据支持的预测、外推与弃答。
details.findings: 结果解读：作者称该系统可将自然语言问题转为可追溯的虚拟实验，并区分有证据支持的预测、外推与弃答。
details.limitations:
预印本；摘要未报告统一的预测精度、比较基线或各任务数据规模，不能据此认定其已验证跨物种通用性或实验可靠性。
简报证据边界：本次补充依据原始摘要；原文未报告的输入输出细节、完整基线、切分和训练设置均未补造。摘要译文采用机器辅助翻译并作术语、数值和身份检查；未逐篇全文精读。原有局限为简报分析，不能一概视为作者自述。
details.abstractOriginal: Virtual cells are evolving from single-task predictive models toward programmable biological simulation systems, yet heterogeneous data, models, and validation evidence still lack a unified organizational framework. Here, we present PRAXIS-VirtualCell, a modular framework that organizes biological data, predictive models, perturbations, adapters, execution environments, and validation evidence to enable reproducible and auditable virtual experiments. The system supports cross-species tasks spanning Escherichia coli, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, and human K562 cells, while using biological contracts and evidence-aware execution to distinguish supported predictions from extrapolation and abstention. By further integrating agentic orchestration, PRAXIS-VirtualCell automatically translates natural-language questions into traceable virtual experiments, providing a unified runtime foundation for trustworthy and scalable Virtual Cell systems.

items.title: Discover, Falsify, Revise: Auditing Input-Use Claims from Source Code to Predictive Contribution in Agent-Discovered Cell Models
items.summary: 从代码可达性、拟合预测依赖性和预测贡献三个层面审计输入；在BBBC047形态—转录组扰动基准、48个候选模型及sci-Plex搜索中测试。 作者报告一个模型虽获0.3153全局PCC但对化合物替换不变；48个候选中仅20个在两折中显示正的目标损失贡献区间，按审计反馈修订可恢复正贡献。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
人工智能虚拟细胞旨在预测细胞对特定干预措施的反应，但仅提供预测性能并不能建立对所提供的扰动信息的使用。这种预测与声明之间的差距在代理模型发现中很重要，其中语言模型代理使用基于分数的反馈生成和修改预测变量。我们引入了 CELLAUDIT，它通过询问输入是否可以进入引用的计算、拟合预测是否依赖于它以及这种依赖性是否改善了观察到的响应的预测来审核输入使用声明。在配对的形态学转录组扰动基准 (BBBC047) 上，代理选择的预测器获得平均保留全局皮尔逊相关系数 (PCC) 0.3153，但对化合物替换保持不变；仅控制剖面的预测器达到 0.3142。源检查识别出被单键值关注阻塞的复合查询路径，并且在使用不相交的控制井重新拟合后，不变性仍然存在。在对两个相关任务中的 48 名候选者进行的分层审核中，在两个保留折叠上的复合替换下，47 个改变了预测，但只有 20 个显示两个折叠上的间隔均大于零的目标损失增益。在 BBBC047 上，伪造引导的修正恢复了正的平均复合贡献，同时保留了仅控制配置文件基线的收益。在匹配的 sci-Plex 搜索中，尽管配对间隔跨度为零，但经过审计丰富的反馈会在五个轨迹上产生更高的保留性能和更大的平均化合物和剂量贡献。在独立获得的队列上重新调整固定设计表明，预测概括并不意味着输入使用声明的概括：剂量贡献持续存在，而对化合物同一性的支持则不然。 CELLAUDIT 在代理模型发现中添加了一个伪造层，从生成-评分-修改转向发现-伪造-修改。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：人工智能虚拟细胞旨在预测细胞对特定干预措施的反应，但仅提供预测性能并不能建立对所提供的扰动信息的使用。这种预测与声明之间的差距在代理模型发现中很重要，其中语言模型代理使用基于分数的反馈生成和修改预测变量。

方法与数据：从代码可达性、拟合预测依赖性和预测贡献三个层面审计输入；在BBBC047形态—转录组扰动基准、48个候选模型及sci-Plex搜索中测试。

结果及适用范围：作者报告一个模型虽获0.3153全局PCC但对化合物替换不变；48个候选中仅20个在两折中显示正的目标损失贡献区间，按审计反馈修订可恢复正贡献。
details.findings: 结果解读：作者报告一个模型虽获0.3153全局PCC但对化合物替换不变；48个候选中仅20个在两折中显示正的目标损失贡献区间，按审计反馈修订可恢复正贡献。
details.limitations:
预印本；部分配对区间跨零，且独立队列中化合物身份贡献未保持；审计不能代替实验因果验证。
简报证据边界：本次补充依据原始摘要；原文未报告的输入输出细节、完整基线、切分和训练设置均未补造。摘要译文采用机器辅助翻译并作术语、数值和身份检查；未逐篇全文精读。原有局限为简报分析，不能一概视为作者自述。
details.abstractOriginal: AI virtual cells aim to predict cellular responses to specified interventions, yet held-out predictive performance alone does not establish use of the supplied perturbation information. This prediction-claim gap matters in agentic model discovery, where language-model agents generate and revise predictors using score-based feedback. We introduce CELLAUDIT, which audits input-use claims by asking whether an input can enter the cited computation, whether fitted predictions depend on it, and whether that dependence improves prediction of observed response. On a paired morphology-transcriptomics perturbation benchmark (BBBC047), an agent-selected predictor attains a mean held-out Global Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) of 0.3153 but remains invariant to compound replacement; a control-profile-only predictor reaches 0.3142. Source inspection identifies a compound-query pathway blocked by singleton key-value attention, and the invariance persists after refitting with disjoint control wells. In a stratified audit of 48 candidates across two linked tasks, 47 change predictions under compound replacement on both held-out folds, but only 20 show target-loss gains with intervals above zero on both folds. On BBBC047, falsification-guided revisions recover positive mean compound contributions while retaining gains over the control-profile-only baseline. In matched sci-Plex searches, audit-enriched feedback yields higher held-out performance and larger mean compound and dose contributions across five trajectories, although paired intervals span zero. Refitting fixed designs on an independently acquired cohort shows predictive generalization need not imply generalization of input-use claims: dose contribution persists, whereas support for compound identity does not. CELLAUDIT adds a falsification layer to agentic model discovery, moving from generate-score-revise toward discover-falsify-revise.

items.title: SpaFactor: Lightweight Spatial Context-Aware Gene Program Modeling for Histology-to-Transcriptomics Inference
items.summary: 融合中心spot的图像表征与多尺度邻域，再以残差MLP映射至低维基因程序，并用共享基因载荷重建协调的多基因表达。 作者在5个公开队列报告总体表现最佳，尤其改善空间变异基因预测并更好恢复有组织的空间图样。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
空间转录组学（ST）分析组织结构内的基因表达，但其成本和实验复杂性限制了常规使用。因此，从常规可用的苏木精和曙红 (HE) 图像预测空间表达提供了一种可扩展的替代方案。然而，传统方法通常将高维基因输出作为独立目标，忽视了基因之间的生物协调，同时仍然容易受到高维噪声和过度拟合的影响。解决这一限制的现有尝试通常依赖于计算量大的图网络或复杂的辅助监督。因此，我们引入了 SpaFactor，一个轻量级且高效的低阶形态-程序-基因分解框架。在输入端，SpaFactor 有效地将中心点的视觉表示与多尺度局部和区域邻域背景融合在一起，产生捕获细胞形态和微环境异质性的组织学表示。对于建模，残差 MLP 稳定地学习从组织微环境到低维潜在基因程序的非线性映射。这些活动通过共享基因加载被解码为协调的多基因表达预测。在五个公共队列中，SpaFactor 实现了最佳的总体性能，对空间可变基因的改进尤其明显，并且更忠实地恢复了生物组织的空间模式。这些结果表明，组织背景和基因程序的轻量级联合建模可以提高预测准确性和生物保真度。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：

details.abstractOriginal: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) profiles gene expression within tissue architecture, but its cost and experimental complexity limit routine use. Predicting spatial expression from routinely available hematoxylin and eosin (HE) images therefore offers a scalable alternative. However, conventional methods often fit high-dimensional gene outputs as independent targets, overlooking the biological coordination among genes while remaining vulnerable to high-dimensional noise and overfitting. Existing attempts to address this limitation often rely on computationally heavy graph networks or complex auxiliary supervision. We therefore introduce SpaFactor, a lightweight and efficient low-rank morphology-program-gene factorization framework. At the input, SpaFactor efficiently fuses the visual representation of the central spot with multiscale local and regional neighborhood context, yielding a histologic representation that captures cellular morphology and microenvironmental heterogeneity. For modeling, a residual MLP stably learns a nonlinear mapping from the tissue microenvironment to low-dimensional latent gene programs. These activities are decoded through shared gene loadings into coordinated multi-gene expression predictions. Across five public cohorts, SpaFactor achieves the best aggregate performance, with particularly clear improvements for spatially variable genes, and more faithfully recovers biologically organized spatial patterns. These results demonstrate that lightweight joint modeling of tissue context and gene programs can improve both predictive accuracy and biological fidelity.

items.title: Pheno-GS: Phenoscape-scale Geodesic Sinkhorn
items.summary: 结合图连通正则、KL边际惩罚的非平衡最优传输及批量热扩散矩阵算法，计算所有患者分布的成对距离。 作者在模拟和CyTOF扰动数据中验证，并报告对500个分布较Geodesic Sinkhorn快超过200倍。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
现在可以在大型患者群体中收集高通量单细胞数据。从细胞水平数据了解患者水平的异质性激发了表型分析：将每个单细胞分布嵌入为“数据点”，距离由最佳传输（OT）给出。在所有成对的患者数据集之间计算这种规模的几何感知 OT 仍然是一个开放的挑战，因为现有的方法要么依赖于扭曲流形结构的欧几里得基础度量，要么在稀疏、不均匀采样或大规模数据下失败。我们提出了 Pheno-GS （Phenoscape-scale Geodesic Sinkhorn），它通过三个组件在嘈杂、不平衡、大规模设置下计算准确的、可扩展的测地线传输距离： ($1$) 稀疏/断开流形上定义明确的测地线的图连接正则化； ($2$) 通过 KL 边际惩罚形成不平衡的 OT 公式； ($3$) 一种批处理矩阵算法，用于计算一次热扩散中的所有成对距离（对于 $500$ 分布，比测地线 Sinkhorn 快超过 $200 倍）。我们在合成基准和 CyTOF 扰动数据集上验证 Pheno-GS。

details.abstractOriginal: High-throughput single-cell data is now collected across large patient cohorts. Understanding patient-level heterogeneity from cellular-level data motivates phenoscaping: embedding each single-cell distribution as a "datapoint," with distances given by optimal transport (OT). Computing geometry-aware OT at this scale, between all pairs of patient datasets, remains an open challenge, since existing methods either rely on Euclidean ground metrics that distort manifold structure or fail under sparse, unevenly sampled, or large-scale data. We present \textbf{Pheno-GS} (Phenoscape-scale Geodesic Sinkhorn), which computes accurate, scalable geodesic transport distances under noisy, unbalanced, large-scale settings via three components: ($1$) graph connectivity regularization for well-defined geodesics on sparse/disconnected manifolds; ($2$) an unbalanced OT formulation via KL marginal penalties; and ($3$) a batched matrix algorithm computing all pairwise distances in one heat diffusion (over $200 \times$ faster than Geodesic Sinkhorn for $500$ distributions). We validate Pheno-GS on synthetic benchmarks and a CyTOF perturbation dataset.

items.title: SPECTRA: predicting cellular perturbation responses with Graph Learning over Gene Regulatory Networks
items.summary: 以变分对照细胞编码器和有向异嗜图解码器整合单细胞表达、预训练转录组上下文及先验调控拓扑，并在大规模单细胞CRISPRi基准评测DEG恢复。 作者报告其在precision、F1和AUPRC的DEG分类中改善稀疏扰动效应恢复，并以已知敲除生物学检查预测。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
由于单细胞转录反应的稀疏性、扰动效率的异质性以及识别扰动后真正差异表达的一小部分基因的困难，预测细胞扰动的转录组后果具有挑战性。当前的方法通常将干预编码为从不受干扰的细胞状态到受干扰的细胞状态的潜在转变，使得模型难以解释。在这里，我们介绍 SPECTRA（SPEctral CRISPR 转录组调控自动编码器），这是一种基于图的模型，它将 CRISPR 扰动视为可解释的局部信号，注入基因调控网络并通过有向图神经网络传播。 SPECTRA 结合了变异控制细胞编码器和定向异嗜性图解码器，将单细胞表达、预训练的转录组背景和先前的调控拓扑集成到单个节点级表示中。我们在大规模单细胞 CRISPRi 基准上评估 SPECTRA，通过精度、F1 评分和基于 AUPRC 的 DEG 分类来测量差异表达基因的恢复。由于 SPECTRA 中的扰动是可以解释的，因此我们根据已知的生物学测试了模型的预测，在正交实验中反复证明了基因敲除的影响的情况下。我们的结果表明，基于图的信号传播是潜移扰动模型的一种基于生物学的替代方案，并且可以改善稀疏扰动引起的转录效应的恢复。

details.abstractOriginal: Predicting the transcriptomic consequences of cellular perturbations is challenging due to the sparsity of single-cell transcriptional responses, heterogeneous perturbation efficiency, and the difficulty of identifying the small subset of genes that are truly differentially expressed after perturbation. Current approaches typically encode interventions as latent shifts from unperturbed to perturbed cellular state, making the models hard to interpret. Here we introduce SPECTRA (SPEctral CRISPR Transcriptome Regulatory Autoencoder) a graph-based model that treats CRISPR perturbations as interpretable, localized signals injected into a Gene Regulatory Network and propagated through directed graph neural networks. SPECTRA combines a variational control-cell encoder and a directed heterophilic graph decoder, integrating single-cell expression, pretrained transcriptomic context, and prior regulatory topology into a single node-level representation. We evaluate SPECTRA on a large-scale single-cell CRISPRi benchmark, measuring differentially expressed gene recovery through precision, F1 score, and AUPRC-based DEG classification. Since perturbations in SPECTRA are interpretable, we tested the predictions of the model against known biology, in cases where the effects of a gene knock out have been repeatedly demonstrated with orthogonal experiments. Our results show that graph-based signal propagation is a biologically grounded alternative to latent-shift perturbation modeling and can improve the recovery of sparse perturbation-induced transcriptional effects.

items.title: DeepSCENIC: transfer learning from sequence-to-function models enables causal gene regulatory network inference
items.summary: 从Enformer、Borzoi等序列到功能模型迁移至单细胞multiome图谱，联合预测表达和染色质可及性，并以CRISPRi、时间序列和报告基因实验评测。 作者报告TF—区域和增强子—基因联系优于相关性基线，预测黑色素瘤状态转变及敲低效应，并分析鼠—人皮层保守GRN。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
序列到功能（S2F）深度学习模型已成为破译基因组顺式调控密码的重要辅助工具。然而，当前的 S2F 模型没有考虑转录因子 (TF) 的细胞跨环境。相反，基因调控网络（GRN）推理方法通常依赖于启发式或简单的位置权重矩阵（PWM），而不利用基因组增强子的组合语法。在这里，我们介绍了 DeepSCENIC，这是一个深度学习框架，它通过执行从 S2F 模型到单细胞多组图谱的迁移学习来实现因果 GRN 推理。我们首先在 ENCODE 细胞系上测试和验证 DeepSCENIC，证明该框架通过利用 Enformer 和 Borzoi 等预训练的 S2F 模型准确预测单细胞基因表达和染色质可及性。我们证明 DeepSCENIC 以高保真度恢复 TF 区域 (TF-RE) 相互作用，并在无需事先了解 PWM 知识的情况下从头捕获 TF 结合基序。当以大规模 CRISPRi 筛选为基准时，该模型在基于相关性的基线上改进了增强子-基因关联 (RE-TG)。训练 DeepSCENIC 模型后，它可以通过充当机械模拟器来预测细胞状态变化期间的扰动效应。在黑色素瘤细胞系图谱中，该模型准确地概括了从黑色素细胞状态到间充质状态的转录转变，并且预测的敲低效应与实验时间序列数据高度一致。最后，我们使用 DeepSCENIC 来识别小鼠-人类皮层保守的 GRN，在匹配的神经元亚类的 TF 活动程序中发现高度的跨物种一致性，并根据实验报告分析验证排名最高的增强子。通过将 S2F 增强子表示与单细胞多组学相结合，DeepSCENIC 为联合建模和模拟顺式序列和跨细胞扰动提供了新的范例。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：序列到功能（S2F）深度学习模型已成为破译基因组顺式调控密码的重要辅助工具。然而，当前的 S2F 模型没有考虑转录因子 (TF) 的细胞跨环境。

方法与数据：从Enformer、Borzoi等序列到功能模型迁移至单细胞multiome图谱，联合预测表达和染色质可及性，并以CRISPRi、时间序列和报告基因实验评测。

结果及适用范围：作者报告TF—区域和增强子—基因联系优于相关性基线，预测黑色素瘤状态转变及敲低效应，并分析鼠—人皮层保守GRN。

details.abstractOriginal: Sequence-to-function (S2F) deep learning models have become an important aid to decipher the genomic cis-regulatory code. However, current S2F models do not take the cellular trans-environment of transcription factors (TF) into account. Conversely, methods for gene regulatory network (GRN) inference often rely on heuristics or simple position weight matrices (PWMs), without exploiting the combinatorial grammar of genomic enhancers. Here, we present DeepSCENIC, a deep learning framework that enables causal GRN inference by performing transfer learning from S2F models to single-cell multiome atlases. We first test and validate DeepSCENIC on ENCODE cell lines, demonstrating that the framework accurately predicts single-cell gene expression and chromatin accessibility by leveraging pretrained S2F models like Enformer and Borzoi. We show that DeepSCENIC recovers TF-region (TF-RE) interactions with high fidelity, and captures de novo TF binding motifs without prior PWM knowledge. The model improves enhancer-gene associations (RE-TG) over correlation-based baselines when benchmarked against large-scale CRISPRi screens. After training a DeepSCENIC model, it enables the prediction of perturbation effects during cell state changes by acting as a mechanistic simulator. In a melanoma cell line atlas, the model accurately recapitulates the transcriptional shift from melanocytic to mesenchymal states, and predicted knock-down effects show high concordance with experimental time series data. Finally, we use DeepSCENIC to identify mouse-human cortex conserved GRNs, finding high cross-species concordance in TF activity programs across matched neuronal subclasses and validating top-ranked enhancers against experimental reporter assays. By unifying S2F enhancer representations with single-cell multiomics, DeepSCENIC provides a new paradigm for jointly modeling and simulating cis-sequence and trans-cellular perturbations.

items.title: Speciesformer learns conserved cellular states for cross-species generative virtual cell modeling
items.summary: 在SpeciesCorpus上预训练跨物种生成式单细胞基础模型；该语料包含11个物种、154种组织、逾923种细胞类型的1.31亿个细胞，并把物种特异基因映射到演化信息驱动的共享基因空间。 作者称编码器支持保守与情境特异程序的表示探测和跨物种迁移；统一生成架构可在转录组状态与生物文本间双向生成，并从初始状态和干预描述预测扰动后转录组，涵盖未见细胞情境。

details.methods:
摘要中文翻译：
跨物种的细胞受到进化上保守的生物程序的控制，但它们的分子状态和反应却受到物种、组织和细胞环境的重塑。因此，虚拟细胞建模的一个核心挑战是学习细胞状态和状态转换，将可转移的生物学原理与特定环境的变化分开。现有的单细胞基础模型具有先进的细胞表示学习，但大多数仍然专注于单物种分析、判别任务或专门的生成形式。在这里，我们介绍 Speciesformer，一种跨物种生成单细胞基础模型，它将进化表示学习与虚拟细胞状态生成相结合。 Speciesformer 在 SpeciesCorpus 上进行了预训练，该数据库包含来自 11 个物种、154 个组织和超过 923 种细胞类型的 1.31 亿个细胞，并将物种特异性基因映射到共享的进化信息基因空间中。它的编码器学习可转移的细胞和基因表示，支持生物表示探测和跨物种知识转移，为解决保守和上下文相关的细胞程序提供公共状态空间。基于这种共享表示，Speciesformer 使用统一的生成架构对语义和干预条件下的细胞状态和状态转换进行建模，从而实现转录组状态和生物文本描述之间的双向生成，以及根据初始细胞状态和干预描述预测扰动后转录组，包括在以前未观察到的细胞环境中。通过统一进化变异、生物语义和条件状态转换，Speciesformer 将跨物种基础建模扩展到生成虚拟细胞框架，用于表示、描述和预测跨生物环境的细胞状态。

研究解读（依据摘要，未逐篇精读全文）：
研究问题与设计：跨物种的细胞受到进化上保守的生物程序的控制，但它们的分子状态和反应却受到物种、组织和细胞环境的重塑。因此，虚拟细胞建模的一个核心挑战是学习细胞状态和状态转换，将可转移的生物学原理与特定环境的变化分开。

方法与数据：在SpeciesCorpus上预训练跨物种生成式单细胞基础模型；该语料包含11个物种、154种组织、逾923种细胞类型的1.31亿个细胞，并把物种特异基因映射到演化信息驱动的共享基因空间。

结果及适用范围：作者称编码器支持保守与情境特异程序的表示探测和跨物种迁移；统一生成架构可在转录组状态与生物文本间双向生成，并从初始状态和干预描述预测扰动后转录组，涵盖未见细胞情境。
